title: We Summon the Darkness
tagline: It's going to be one HELL of a party.
overview: Three best friends attending a heavy-metal show cross paths with sadistic killers after they travel to a secluded country home for an after party.
plot:
In Indiana, July 1988, Alexis Butler and her two friends Val and Bev are driving to a heavy metal show, when a milkshake is thrown from a blue van onto their windshield. Once they arrive at the concert, they find the same blue van, and Val throws a small firecracker into it, causing the three boys inside to climb out. Ivan owns the van and his buddies Kovacs and Mark, who is said to be leaving for Los Angeles soon, are interested in the girls. After the show, Alexis invites the boys to her father's empty mansion. Bev and Mark seem to like each other, yet Bev seems to almost avoid him. As they play a game of Never Have I Ever, the girls drug the boys' drinks and reveal they are going to murder them and make it look like a Satanic cult killing.
The Daughters of the Dawn, the church the girls are a part of, has murdered eighteen other people in the same way in order to create fear and send more people to their religion. Alexis is shown to be the most insane and stabs Ivan after he criticizes her religious belief in Christ, and he bleeds to death. Mark and Kovacs briefly escape, hiding in a pantry. Susan, Alexis's soon-to-be ex-stepmother, comes home to retrieve a passport and reveals she has called the police because she saw the strange blue van and the house lights on. Susan then discovers Ivan's body and Alexis stabs her to death.
A police officer arrives and becomes suspicious, so Alexis runs from him and back into the house where he chases her. The officer finds the injured Kovacs and Mark who pleads for help, but Val sneaks up on him, takes his gun, and shoots him, killing him. As Alexis and Val fight over the gun, Bev appears, threatening her friends with an electric outboard trolling motor. Val and Alexis tell Bev they are doing the Lord's work, but Bev declares she will let Mark and Kovacs go.
Bev tries to help Mark and Kovacs, the latter who is bleeding out and will not last much longer unless he makes it to a hospital. Alexis has the car keys, so Mark goes after her; he obtains the keys, but Alexis attacks him and they fight. Val attacks Bev and tries to kill her, but Bev lights Val on fire (her hair being full of hairspray). Meanwhile, Kovacs sees car lights and struggles outside to find John Henry Butler, Alexis's father and the pastor of the Daughters of the Dawn. John Henry shoots Kovacs, who makes it back into the house where Bev finds him. Just before Kovacs dies, he tells Bev to save Mark.
While strangling Alexis, Mark is shot by John Henry, who then berates his daughter, Alexis, for doing a terrible job murdering and covering it up. He tells her that they have to make some sacrifices to get out of the predicament she has caused and attempts to strangle her to death when Bev comes up and knocks him out. A crazed Alexis grapples with Bev but trips on Mark’s outstretched arm and falls out the window. Mark is still alive, and he drives away with Bev, only to find Alexis standing in the road. Off-camera, Bev runs Alexis over.

title: Auntie Edna
overview: Taking place during the events of Incredibles 2, Edna Mode babysits Jack-Jack.
plot:
Auntie Edna is a 2018 American computer-animated short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and Walt Disney Pictures as a "mini-movie" for the home entertainment release of Incredibles 2. Written and directed by Ted Mathot, a Pixar story artist since 1999 who had worked on The Incredibles, Cars, Ratatouille and WALL-E and served as story supervisor on Incredibles 2, and produced by Marc Sondheimer, it runs about five minutes. Brad Bird, director of both Incredibles features, again voices the superhero costume designer Edna Mode, with Craig T. Nelson and Eli Fucile also in the voice cast.

The short fills in an event that happens off-screen during Incredibles 2. In the feature, Edna volunteers to babysit Jack-Jack after learning that the infant has developed a wide range of superpowers, and returns him to his family with a suit designed to accommodate them. Auntie Edna reveals what happened that night at her mansion. Bob drops Jack-Jack off, and in her workshop Edna lets the baby loose so she can observe his many abilities, which include teleportation, shrinking, anti-gravity and multiplying into several copies, as well as his "demon baby" form; the short also accounts for elements set up in the film, such as the Mozart music and the cookies. In a lab sequence, the roles are reversed: Jack-Jack takes charge while Edna watches from inside an observation chamber, first fascinated even as her lab is wrecked, then bored and restless, until she simply waits for things to calm down. Once the baby is worn out, she sets about designing the seemingly impossible: a super suit that can harness all of his powers.

Mathot said he wanted to push the always-in-control Edna out of her comfort zone without losing the essence of a character very close to Bird, using time cuts and classical music for the lab sequence; Bird encouraged him to add more powers and quicken the timing. The film was completed in about four and a half months by a crew of roughly 40 artists. Following the precedent of Jack-Jack Attack, the short included on the home video release of The Incredibles, it was released with Incredibles 2 on digital platforms on 23 October 2018 and on Blu-ray and DVD on 6 November 2018. Reviewers welcomed it as a fun bonus for fans, praising its colorful animation, Jack-Jack's imaginative powers and the rare sight of Edna losing her composure, and enjoying the glimpse into her mansion and workspace.

title: The Old Guard
tagline: Forever is harder than it looks
overview: Four undying warriors who've secretly protected humanity for centuries become targeted for their mysterious powers just as they discover a new immortal.
plot:
The Old Guard is a 2020 American superhero film directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood and written by Greg Rucka, based on his own comic book series. Charlize Theron stars as Andy, leader of a band of immortal mercenaries, with KiKi Layne as Nile Freeman, Matthias Schoenaerts as Booker, Marwan Kenzari as Joe, Luca Marinelli as Nicky, Harry Melling as Steven Merrick, Veronica Ngo as Quỳnh and Chiwetel Ejiofor as James Copley.

Andy, Booker, Joe and Nicky heal from any wound. Breaking their rule against repeat clients, they accept a job from Copley to rescue kidnapped girls in South Sudan. It is a trap, and Copley films them dying and recovering. At the same time, U.S. Marine Nile Freeman has her throat cut in Afghanistan and revives without a scar. The immortals dream of each new member until she is found, and Andy extracts Nile before the military can study her. Copley shows his footage to the pharmaceutical executive Merrick, who sends operatives after them. At a safe house in France, the others reveal to Nile that their healing eventually stops without warning. They also tell her about Quỳnh, Andy's companion, who was condemned as a witch about 500 years ago and cast into the sea in an iron maiden, drowning ever since.

Merrick's forces capture Joe and Nicky, who are tortured in his London lab, and Andy secretly finds that a wound is not healing. When Andy and Booker confront Copley, Booker shoots her, revealing that he betrayed them, hoping Merrick's research might end the immortality he has grown tired of. Copley, seeing that Merrick is driven by greed and cruelty rather than medicine, changes sides and helps Nile storm the building. She frees the others, and she and the now-mortal Andy kill Merrick when Nile drags him out of a high-rise window. The group sentences Booker to a century of exile. Copley, who shows them the good their past missions achieved, agrees to cover their tracks. Six months later, a drunken Booker returns to his Paris apartment to find Quỳnh waiting.

Netflix released the film on July 10, 2020. Netflix reported that 78 million households had watched it. Reviews were generally positive, with praise for the action sequences and Theron's performance. Rotten Tomatoes reported 80% approval, and its consensus said Prince-Bythewood brought a sophisticated vision to the superhero genre. A sequel, The Old Guard 2, directed by Victoria Mahoney, followed in July 2025.

title: Shirley
overview: A famous horror writer finds inspiration for her next book after she and her husband take in a young couple.
plot:
Fred and Rose Nemser are newlyweds relocating to Bennington College for Fred's job as a lecturer. Fred is about to work for Stanley Hyman while Rose, still a student, is already enthralled by the work of Stanley's wife, Shirley Jackson, writer of "The Lottery", the dark short story which shocked readers of The New Yorker when it was published on June 26, 1948.
Minutes after their first meeting, Shirley asks Rose about her (not yet announced) pregnancy, saying "I'm a witch, didn't you know?" Soon after, Stanley asks Rose to help with menial jobs around the house because Shirley is struggling to write after suffering another bout of agoraphobia. Fred and Rose reluctantly assent and move into the house. Rose realizes that she has unwittingly agreed to serve as the family housekeeper. She also sees the pathology of Stanley and Shirley's marriage: in his worship of Shirley's genius as a writer, Stanley enables her drinking and her lethargy; in turn, Shirley tolerates Stanley's posturing and pomposity, and she winks at his serial love affairs.
The Nemsers move into the Jackson-Hyman house. Shirley is deliberately dismissive of and even cruel to Rose, who has apparently given up on her studies in order to manage the household. Shirley begins to write again, announcing a new work based on Paula Jean Welden, a young woman who recently disappeared from Bennington's campus. Stanley is obsessive and controlling about Shirley's writing process; he asserts that she is a genius, but he wheedles and cajoles her to stay on task. Despite her initial harsh treatment of Rose, Shirley begins to think of the younger woman as somewhat of a muse. Shirley opens up to Rose, having her do research for the new book, including stealing the medical files for Paula Jean Welden. As the two grow closer, Rose falls more and more under Shirley's spell. She is enraptured by and protective of Shirley. A sexual flirtation builds between them, but is never acknowledged or consummated by the two.
In the meantime, the relationship between Stanley and Fred deteriorates as Stanley seeks to tamp down Fred's ambitions and to torpedo his career as an academic.
Rose's baby is born, yet Shirley remains wrapt in the cocoon of her writing; the arrival of a baby has little effect on life in the Jackson/Hyman household. Now feeling that the Nemsers have served their purpose, Stanley arranges for them to move out. Desperate to stay, Rose writes the name of Paula Jean Welden in a Bennington College library book and gives it to Shirley, hoping she'll infer that Paula had been Stanley's student and had been having an affair with him. To Rose's shock, Shirley is unaffected, saying that she's well aware of Stanley's love affairs and that she knows Paula was not one of his lovers. She also reveals that Rose's husband Fred is just the same as Stanley — that he too has been having sex with his students.
After confronting Fred about his infidelity, Rose runs off.

The Night House is a 2021 American supernatural horror film written and directed by David Bruckner. The movie stars Rebecca Hall as Beth, a widow who discovers her recently deceased husband's dark secrets.

The story begins with the death of Beth's husband, Owen (played by Evan Jonigkeit), in a car accident. Beth is devastated by his loss and struggles to cope with the grief. As she sorts through their belongings, she discovers a mysterious manuscript written by Owen, which reveals that he was involved in some sinister activities.

As Beth delves deeper into the manuscript, she begins to uncover disturbing secrets about her husband's past. She learns that Owen was part of a cult-like organization called "The Order," which worshipped an ancient deity known as "The Night House." The group believed that by sacrificing themselves, they could achieve immortality and transcendence.

Beth becomes increasingly obsessed with understanding the true nature of Owen's involvement with The Order. She starts to experience strange and terrifying events, which she initially attributes to grief and stress. However, as the occurrences escalate, she begins to suspect that something more sinister is at play.

As Beth digs deeper, she discovers a dark history about The Night House and its followers. She learns that Owen was one of the most devoted members of the group, and that he had become increasingly unhinged in his final days. The manuscript reveals that Owen's ultimate goal was to summon The Night House, a malevolent entity that would grant him immortality.

As Beth gets closer to the truth, she realizes that she is now being hunted by The Order. She must navigate a complex web of secrets and lies to uncover the truth about her husband's death and the mysterious forces at work.

The climax of the movie takes place in an abandoned house, where Beth confronts Owen's dark past and the true nature of The Night House. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Owen had become possessed by The Night House, which had been manipulating him from the beginning.

In the end, Beth manages to escape the clutches of The Order and destroy the manuscript, which holds the key to unlocking the secrets of The Night House. However, as she walks away from the abandoned house, she can't shake off the feeling that The Night House is still watching her, waiting for its next victim.

The Night House is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of grief, obsession, and the dangers of blindly following a charismatic leader. Rebecca Hall delivers a standout performance as Beth, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and terrifying character.

It is based on a concept by authors Chuck Wendig and Sam Sykes. Fran Kranz stars as Sam and Alyson Hannigan as his friend Chuck, with Brittany S. Hall, Patrick Reginald Walker and Keith David in supporting roles.

At Camp Clear Vista, Sam, the panicked head counselor, hides in a cabin and calls Chuck, a horror movie enthusiast. He tells her that a masked killer is murdering the counselors. As Chuck questions him, Sam pieces together the past few days, including the arrival of his ex-girlfriend Imani and the discovery of bodies that left the group trapped at the camp. He keeps blacking out, and when he comes to, he finds the cabin on fire. The evidence piles up: Sam is covered in blood and holding the killer's machete and a strange wooden mask. Chuck concludes that Sam is the killer, and that his blackouts are the moments when the mask takes control.

Flashbacks explain the legend. Long ago, settlers brought dark magic to the land and released an evil entity, which was later sealed inside an oak tree. Centuries later, a woodcarver made a mask from the tree and went on a killing spree before he was stopped and buried with it. Bored counselors went looking for the grave, and a friend named Drew dug up the mask and put it on Sam as a joke. Sam, possessed, killed Drew first. Chuck applies the rules of slasher movies, trying to identify the survivors and warning Sam about Jamie, who may be the "final girl". Sam's feelings for Imani help him remove the mask, but the curse keeps drawing him back. Imani, who faked her death, joins Jamie, and the two lock Sam away, but he escapes. Imani, believing she must be the final girl, turns on Jamie and is killed. At the woodcarver's grave, Sam persuades Jamie to help him bury the mask, but Jamie touches it, falls under its power and stabs Sam to death before walking away with it. Two years later, Chuck receives a call from Sam, now undead.

The idea came from a July 2017 Twitter exchange between Sykes and Wendig about slasher movie clichés, and both served as producers. The film was shot in Louisiana in 2018, premiered at Fantastic Fest and screened at Toronto After Dark and other festivals. Shudder released it on December 6, 2018, and it later came out on DVD and Blu-ray. Rotten Tomatoes reported 60% positive reviews.

title: River Runs Red
overview: When the son of a successful judge is killed by two police officers and the system sets them free, a hardened veteran detective finds some incriminating files on the officers and the judge teams up with another mourning father to take the law into his own hands.
plot:
River Runs Red is a 2018 American crime thriller written and directed by Wes Miller. Taye Diggs stars as Judge Charles Coleman Jr., with John Cusack, George Lopez, Luke Hemsworth and Gianni Capaldi in supporting roles. The film is a revenge drama about a judge who loses faith in the legal system after his son is killed by police officers, and it addresses themes of racism, police violence and the limits of justice.

The film opens with a flashback in which Charles's father, also a judge, teaches his young son about standing up for principle, citing the example of Muhammad Ali. As an adult, Charles has become a respected judge and one of the few prominent Black legal figures in his city. He lives with his wife Marilyn and their son CJ, who is about to begin training at the police academy. Charles believes deeply in the law and has built his life around it.

On his way to his first day at the academy, CJ crosses paths with two police officers, Rory and Von. Rory, a hot-tempered racist, mistakes a harmless gesture from CJ for an insult and pulls him over. During the tense traffic stop, he wrongly believes CJ is reaching for a weapon and opens fire, and both officers shoot. CJ is killed, and when the officers realize he was unarmed, they plant a gun in his car to justify the shooting. An investigation clears them, leaving Charles devastated and his faith in the system shattered. With quiet help from Horace, an older detective who respects him, Charles uncovers a pattern of earlier suspicious shootings by the same officers that city officials have ignored. His inquiry leads him to Javier, a father whose son was killed by the pair years before, and when the mayor and other leaders refuse to act on their evidence, the two grieving fathers decide to take justice into their own hands, setting off a chain of violence and a manhunt.

The film was released in limited theaters and on demand in November 2018. It received generally negative reviews, with critics acknowledging its timely subject but faulting its script and execution.

title: Percy
overview: Percy Schmeiser, a third-generation farmer, gets sued by a corporate giant for allegedly using their patented seeds. With little resources to fight a legal battle, Percy joins forces with up-and-coming attorney Jackson Weaver and environmental activist Rebecca Salcau for a monumental case that leads all the way to the Supreme Court.
plot:
Percy, also known as Percy vs Goliath, is a 2020 Canadian, American and Indian biographical drama directed by Clark Johnson from a screenplay by Garfield Lindsay Miller and Hilary Pryor. Christopher Walken stars as Percy Schmeiser, a 70-year-old Saskatchewan farmer who takes on a multinational corporation, with Christina Ricci, Zach Braff, Luke Kirby, Adam Beach, Martin Donovan, Roberta Maxwell and Peter Stebbings in supporting roles. It premiered at the 2020 Quebec City Film Festival and was released in Canada by Mongrel Media on October 9, 2020.

Based on the legal case Monsanto Canada Inc v Schmeiser, the film follows Percy, a canola farmer who receives legal action from the agribusiness giant Monsanto, which claims that his fields contain its patented Roundup-resistant crops and accuses him of intellectual property theft. Monsanto demands his seed and the profits from his harvest. Percy, a lifelong seed saver, insists that he never bought or planted the company's product and that his fields were contaminated by seed from neighboring farms. He hires local lawyer Jackson Weaver, played by Braff, but it soon becomes clear that the law favors the corporation.

The case takes a heavy toll. Percy and his family are shunned by parts of their community and their debts mount. Rebecca Salcau, played by Ricci, an activist with an environmental organization, offers support on the condition that Percy speak out publicly to draw attention and raise funds. Reluctant at first, he changes his mind after discovering that Monsanto has had him followed and branded a thief. His speeches gain international attention and bring donations and letters from around the world. On a trip to India he witnesses the devastating impact of industrial agriculture on indebted farmers, many of whom have taken their own lives. Back home, his wife is injured, his appeals fail and his backers withdraw, but encouraged by her, Percy takes his fight all the way to the Supreme Court of Canada, which ultimately upholds Monsanto's patent but rules that he owes the company nothing because he did not profit from the gene.

Principal photography took place in Winnipeg beginning in September 2018. Rotten Tomatoes reports a 76% approval rating from 49 reviews, with a consensus noting the film's heavy-handed messaging but crediting Walken's performance with keeping it upright. Schmeiser, gravely ill with Parkinson's disease, died on October 13, 2020, days after the film's release.

title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
tagline: No one promised them a fair fight.
overview: Jake Carter and another former Marine, Luke Trapper,  join forces to rescue a young kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals.
plot:
In a park, a young girl named Sarah Dillon is kidnapped by Irish criminal Maddy Hayes. Maddy calls Sarah's father, Patrick, a juror, and she threatens to kill Sarah if Patrick doesn't force a mistrial on her father, Horace, who is on trial in a court case.
Meanwhile, former US Marines, Jake Carter and Luke Trapper, later meet up with a man named Graham at a disused brewery. They hear a scream inside and bust into the room where it came from, where they encounter Maddy and her henchmen holding Sarah hostage. Graham wanders in, and ends up getting killed by Maddy. Jake and Luke get into various fights with the henchmen throughout the brewery as they try to rescue Sarah, while Patrick struggles with settling on his verdict for Horace.
Jake, Luke and Sarah are later confronted by more henchmen in an underground tunnel system and are eventually pinned down. Jake is shot and fatally wounded in the chaos, while Maddy snatches Sarah back. Trusting Luke to rescue Sarah, Jake sacrifices himself by running toward the henchmen, killing as many as he can, taking many hits. Maddy bids Jake farewell and throws a knife into his heart, killing him.
Luke follows Maddy and her remaining men outside towards a boat. Maddy learns that the mistrial has been confirmed, which then makes Sarah a loose end. Luke kills the remaining henchmen on land, and jumps onto the boat, where he kills her last henchman. Luke and Maddy then engage in hand-to-hand combat, and Luke manages to overpower Maddy with a rope and throw her overboard. An anchor connected to the rope later falls into the water, forcing Maddy to become submerged in the water and drown. Police and paramedics show up and Sarah reunites with Patrick who guarantees that Horace will be put to justice. Luke says his final goodbyes to Jake; his corpse is escorted away by paramedics. The film ends with a tribute to Jake Carter, showing everything he did throughout the franchise.

title: Last Christmas
tagline: Who doesn't have a little Christmas baggage?
overview: Kate is a young woman who has a habit of making bad decisions, and her last date with disaster occurs after she accepts work as Santa's elf for a department store. However, after she meets Tom there, her life takes a new turn.
plot:
Last Christmas is a romantic comedy film released in 2019, directed by Paul Feig and written by Bryan Cox and Emma Thompson. The movie stars Emilia Clarke as Kate, a young woman who struggles to find purpose after her mother's death.

The story begins with Kate (Emilia Clarke) working at a Christmas shop, where she is surrounded by festive decorations and holiday music. Despite her efforts to be cheerful, Kate feels unfulfilled and disconnected from the world around her. She spends most of her time alone, lost in thought, and struggling to find meaning in her life.

One day, while working at the shop, Kate meets Tom (Henry Golding), a charming and handsome stranger who enters the store looking for a gift for his blind date. As they strike up a conversation, Kate is drawn to Tom's kindness and warmth, and he becomes an instant distraction from her melancholy mood.

As Kate and Tom spend more time together, they begin to form a connection that goes beyond their initial encounter. They bond over their shared love of Christmas music, and Tom introduces Kate to the magic of the holiday season. Through their interactions, we see glimpses of Kate's past, including her complicated relationship with her mother, who died of cancer.

As the story unfolds, we learn more about Kate's struggles to cope with her loss. Her mother was a kind and caring person who always put others before herself, and Kate feels guilty for not being able to live up to her expectations. Tom, sensing Kate's emotional pain, becomes a source of comfort and support for her.

As the holiday season progresses, Kate and Tom grow closer, and their relationship deepens. They share laughter, tears, and moments of vulnerability, and we see them navigate the ups and downs of romance together. Through their interactions, we are reminded that love can be found in unexpected places and that it's never too late to find happiness.

The movie takes a poignant turn when Kate reveals her past to Tom, sharing stories about her mother and the pain she has been carrying for years. Tom listens with empathy and understanding, and his presence helps Kate confront her grief and find closure.

In the end, Kate and Tom share a romantic kiss under the mistletoe, surrounded by the festive decorations of the Christmas shop. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that love can heal even the deepest wounds and bring joy back into our lives.

Overall, Last Christmas is a heartwarming and uplifting film that explores themes of grief, loss, and the power of love to transform our lives. With its witty dialogue, charming performances, and festive atmosphere, it's a holiday classic that will leave you feeling merry and bright.

title: Synchronic
overview: Two New Orleans paramedics' lives are ripped apart after encountering a series of horrific deaths linked to a designer drug with bizarre, otherworldly effects.
plot:
Steve, a womanizing New Orleans paramedic, and his devoted partner, Dennis, face a string of deaths all linked to a new designer drug, Synchronic. When Steve is accidentally pricked by a contaminated needle during a call, tests reveal not only possible infection but also an aggressive cancer in his underdeveloped pineal gland.
Driven to uncover the truth about Synchronic, Steve tracks down the drug's creator. He learns it warps the pineal gland's perception of time, sending users backwards through history. Children experience full time travel, while adults exist only as ghost-like figures in the past.
Meanwhile, Dennis's teenage daughter, Brianna, vanishes. His marriage collapses and he misjudges Steve, whose declining health and painkiller use he mistakes for drug addiction. Their conflict turns into a physical fight.
Fueled by his diagnosis and a desire to find Brianna, Steve experiments with Synchronic. He witnesses Louisiana's past, escaping encounters with a conquistador and the Ku Klux Klan. Using his dog, Hawking, he discovers the location of pill consumption dictates the destination year. But Hawking is lost in the 1920s, unable to return with Steve.
Steve deduces that physical contact with objects can anchor someone in a specific time. Returning to the park where Brianna disappeared, he encounters prehistoric tribesmen but learns Brianna might have simply wandered off before taking Synchronic.
Reconciling with Dennis, Steve reveals his cancer diagnosis. They review Steve's time-travel footage and go to the cemetery where Steve's family is buried. From there, they journey back to the park.
Within the chaos of the Battle of New Orleans, Steve locates a terrified Brianna. When a looter, mistaking Steve for a runaway slave, threatens them, Steve sacrifices himself as a distraction so Brianna can use his last pill to return to the present. Fatally injured and the looter killed by a landmine, Steve carves the word "ALLWAYS" into a boulder. This act casts him as the originator of the symbol found there in the present.
Dennis embraces a safely returned Brianna, as Steve's spectral form lingers. Dennis and Steve acknowledge each other. The film ends on a close-up of their hands clasped together.

title: Christmas at Pemberley Manor
overview: As Christmas approaches, Elizabeth Bennett, a New York event planner is sent to a quaint, small town to organize a holiday festival. When she arrives, she finds William Darcy, a high-profile billionaire lacking in holiday spirit, in the process of selling the charming estate she hoped to use as a venue. Elizabeth persuades the reluctant Darcy to let her hold the festival on the historical estate and, before long, the unlikely pair begins falling for each other.
plot:
Christmas at Pemberley Manor is a 2018 American Christmas romance television film directed by Colin Theys and written by Rick Garman, produced by Johnson Production Group and Synthetic Cinema International. A loose holiday riff on characters from Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice, it stars Jessica Lowndes and Michael Rady, with Cole Gleason, Maddie McCormick, Ben Estus, Steve Larkin and Elaine Hendrix. It premiered on the Hallmark Channel on 27 October 2018 as the opening film of the network's Countdown to Christmas season.

Elizabeth Bennett (Lowndes), a New York event planner, is invited by her college friend George (Gleason), now the young mayor of the small Connecticut town of Lambton, to organise its Christmas festival. George secretly hopes to rekindle a romance, as his assistant Jane (McCormick) can plainly tell. On arriving, Elizabeth clashes with Travis (Estus), an assistant who cuts the coffee line for his boss, and then scolds the man waiting in the car, the high-profile billionaire William Darcy (Rady). When a water main break sends the town gazebo into a sinkhole, Elizabeth proposes holding the festival at Pemberley Manor, the picturesque estate she drove past on her way into town, only to discover that it belongs to Darcy, who lacks holiday spirit and is in the process of selling it to developers who plan to replace it with condos. After she persuades the buyers to back the idea, Darcy agrees to help on condition that his name is kept out of the publicity and funds the decorations. Elizabeth brings Christmas into the long-empty house, and a montage of tree trimming, cookie decorating and a sleigh ride reveals that Darcy, who lost his parents, once loved the season. When the festival soloist falls ill, Elizabeth steps in to sing "O Holy Night", and the unlikely pair begin to fall for each other, while new complications arise from a rival suitor in George and someone trying to take over the festival planning.

Reviews were generally warm. Paul Carlson of Escape Into Film gave it four out of five, praising Lowndes and Rady's chemistry and the way the film plays with two iconic literary characters without forcing in the plot of the novel. 18 Cinema Lane scored it 8.2 out of 10, appreciating that both of Elizabeth's suitors are good people, while finding little resemblance to Pride and Prejudice. Very Merry Movies thought the love story felt flat and the Austen connection confusing, though it enjoyed the side romance between Jane and Travis.

title: Christmas at the Palace
overview: Katie, a former professional ice skater, is hired by the king of San Senova, Alexander, to help his daughter in a Christmas ice skating performance. As Katie spends time in the castle and with the king, she and Alex begin to develop feelings for each other and ultimately fall in love. plot:
Christmas at the Palace is a 2018 Christmas romantic comedy television film produced for Hallmark Channel by Motion Picture Corporation of America and Brad Krevoy Television. It stars Merritt Patterson as Katie, a former professional figure skater, and Andrew Cooper as Alexander, the widowed king of the fictional nation of San Senova, with Brittany Bristow, Nicholas Banks, India Fowler and Geraldine Fitzgerald in supporting roles. It premiered on Thanksgiving, 22 November 2018, as part of Hallmark's Countdown to Christmas season.

Katie, who once came close to competing at the Olympics, now manages a touring Christmas ice show starring her friend Jessica, and the two hope that the earnings from the tour will let them buy an ice rink back home in New Jersey. Their final stop is San Senova, whose king, Alexander, is struggling to live up to the legacy of his late father, who founded the kingdom's beloved holiday traditions, and has been nicknamed a Grinch after the press criticized his lack of Christmas spirit. Katie literally bumps into him at the Christmas market without realizing who he is. After the show, Princess Christina, a talented but insecure young skater, asks the two women for lessons and persuades her father to let her stage a Christmas skating pageant at the palace rink. Alexander hires Katie and Jessica for a large fee that would fund their dream, and invites them to stay at the palace. As Katie prepares the pageant, encourages Christina and helps the king rediscover the joy of the season, from decorating a tree to making handmade gifts for his staff and baking cookies for the royal Christmas tea, she and Alexander fall in love, while Jessica and Nicholas begin their own romance. But the tradition-loving people of San Senova may not accept a foreigner as their queen, and when Jessica is injured and their rink deal is threatened, Katie must choose between her plans and the family she has come to love.

The fictional kingdom was created in Romania. Filming took place in October 2018 with Castel Film Studios in Bucharest, at locations including Snagov Palace on Lake Snagov, while the town of San Senova was built on a studio lot. Reviews were mixed. The Avocado's recap found the leading couple bland and Cooper's king monotone, preferring the secondary romance and pitying the moping princess, while other viewers enjoyed the warm chemistry between the leads and the Romanian palace scenery.

title: Christmas Wonderland
overview: Heidi, who initially left her small town of Pleasant Valley with the dream of one day becoming a successful painter, has put her own art on hold to excel as an art gallery curator. plot:
Christmas Wonderland is a heartwarming holiday romance film that explores the transformative power of love and second chances. The story revolves around Holly, a successful businesswoman who has lost touch with her Christmas spirit, and Nick, a widowed father who is struggling to balance his work and family life.

As Holly and Nick's paths cross, they embark on a journey of self-discovery and healing, learning to let go of their past heartaches and rediscover the magic of Christmas. Through their blossoming romance, the film highlights the importance of human connection, forgiveness, and the redemptive power of love.

The movie also touches on themes of grief, loss, and the challenges of single parenthood, showcasing Nick's unwavering dedication to his daughter and his own journey towards healing and finding happiness again. As Holly and Nick navigate their feelings for each other, they must confront their own emotional baggage and learn to trust themselves and others.

Ultimately, Christmas Wonderland is a feel-good film that celebrates the joy, hope, and renewal of the holiday season, reminding viewers that it's never too late to rediscover the magic of love and Christmas.

title: Christmas Made to Order
overview: When architect and Christmas amateur Steven finds himself hosting his family for Christmas, he recruits holiday coordinator Gretchen to bring holiday joy to his home. Gretchen’s expert Christmas spirit brings Steven’s family together, but neither expected it to bring them closer to each other. After a great opportunity presents itself to Gretchen, she and Steven must decide what’s really important in life.
plot:
Christmas Made to Order is a 2018 American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Sam Irvin and written by Matt Marx and Anna White, produced by Hybrid and Production Media Films for Hallmark and first broadcast in December 2018. It stars Alexa PenaVega and Jonathan Bennett, with Jo Marie Payton, Jacob Young, Chelsea Gilson, Andrew Roach and Bailee Michelle Johnson in supporting roles.

Steven (Bennett) is an all-business architect who is about to make partner at his firm if he can win over a major new client, and who even questions a colleague's festive tie. He has a painful meet-cute in his office lobby with Gretchen (PenaVega), a stager for a catalogue company who dreams of turning her hobby of holiday decorating into a business of her own, and who has covered the lobby in garlands and fake snow. When Steven learns that emergency construction work on his sister's house means his whole family will spend Christmas at his place, he panics: he does not even own a string of lights, and they are expecting a perfectly decorated home. He hires Gretchen to transform his bare house, and when the family arrives and is delighted, he persuades her to stay on as his family's Christmas activity coordinator, dangling the chance to become the official decorator for his company's properties. While Steven retreats into his work, Gretchen leads the family through picking out a tree, decorating, making mulled cider at her aunt's inn, personalised stockings and cookie decorating. Her expert Christmas spirit brings the family together; she mediates a squabble between Steven, his sister and her husband and his parents, and counsels his niece, who wants to be a singer rather than a doctor as her father expects. Gradually Steven is drawn back into family life, and he and Gretchen, both single and with her parents no longer living, grow closer. Meanwhile a demanding client rejects Steven's designs, and when a great opportunity presents itself to Gretchen, the two must decide what is really important in life.

Reviewers found it light, feel-good holiday fare. Fits of Fury thought the premise of hiring a "Christmas ambassador" bizarre, but singled out PenaVega for the film's best and funniest moments and her character's gumption, and credited the easy chemistry between the leads as a large reason the film works. The Avocado's tongue-in-cheek recap poked fun at the décor, the fake Christmas tree and the clichéd plot.

title: Wish Dragon
tagline: Three magical wishes. One life changing adventure.
overview: Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a wish-granting dragon who shows him the magic of possibilities.
plot:
Wish Dragon is a 2021 American animated fantasy comedy film produced by Columbia Pictures Animation. The movie follows the story of a young boy named Ethan, who lives with his mother in a small town in China.

Ethan's life takes a dramatic turn when he befriends a magical dragon named Wishing, who has been trapped inside a magical lantern for centuries. According to Chinese legend, if you make three wishes on the lantern, your deepest desires will come true. However, each wish comes with an unintended consequence that can have devastating effects.

As Ethan and Wishing spend more time together, they form a strong bond, and Ethan learns about the importance of being careful what he wishes for. They embark on a series of adventures to uncover the secrets behind the lantern and break the curse that has been cast upon it.

Throughout their journey, Ethan and Wishing encounter various obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, fierce creatures, and rival treasure hunters who seek to claim the lantern's power for themselves. Along the way, Ethan learns valuable lessons about friendship, responsibility, and the true meaning of happiness.

One of the most significant challenges they face is the villainous General Li, a ruthless and cunning adversary who will stop at nothing to possess the magical lantern. As tensions rise, Ethan and Wishing must use all their wits and courage to outsmart General Li and his minions.

As the story unfolds, Ethan comes to realize that the true magic of the lantern lies not in its power to grant wishes but in the connections and experiences it brings people together. With the help of Wishing, Ethan learns to appreciate the beauty of simplicity and finds a new sense of purpose in life.

In the end, Ethan and Wishing successfully break the curse, and the magical lantern is freed from its centuries-long slumber. The movie concludes with Ethan returning home, forever changed by his incredible adventure with Wishing. Though he no longer has the magical powers of the lantern, he knows that the true magic lies within himself and the friendships he's made along the way.

Overall, Wish Dragon is a heartwarming and visually stunning film that celebrates the beauty of Chinese culture and the power of friendship and self-discovery.

title: Christmas with a View
overview: This Christmas, Thunder Mountain Ski Resort is abuzz when celebrity chef Shane Roarke is named the new head chef. Clara Garrison isn't as excited and is instead focused on getting resettled after her failed attempt at opening a restaurant in the city. With their paths constantly crossing, will their shared passion for cooking bring them together or will secrets keep them apart?
plot:
Christmas with a View is a 2018 Canadian romantic holiday television film directed by Justin G. Dyck from a screenplay by David Finley, based on a novel by Teresa Southwick. Produced by Brain Power Studio, it was released on 1 November 2018 and distributed on Netflix. It stars Kaitlyn Leeb as Clara Garrison and Scott Cavalheiro as Shane Roarke, with Vivica A. Fox as Clara's mother Lydia, Patrick Duffy and Jess Walton as Frank and Jackie Haven, Mark Ghanimé as Mr. Peters, Joseph Cannata as Clive and Genevieve Kang as Darlene. It runs about 90 minutes.

Clara is the manager of the restaurant at the Thunder Mountain Ski Resort, a job she took after her attempt at running her own restaurant in Chicago failed. This Christmas the resort is abuzz because her boss, Mr. Peters, has hired Shane, a celebrity chef who won the reality cooking competition Can You Stand the Heat?, as the new head chef. Clara is not especially excited at first and is focused on getting resettled, but with the encouragement of her pushy best friend Bonnie she and the soft-spoken Shane quickly connect over their shared passion for cooking. Both, however, are keeping secrets. Shane has his own mysterious reason for taking the job, linked to a photograph he keeps and to the place where his parents once spent a happy Christmas. Clara still dreams of having her own kitchen, and Mr. Peters asks her to persuade Frank and Jackie Haven, the couple who run the nearby Mountain View Inn and treat her like the daughter they never had, to sell their property to him. When Clara, Bonnie and Clive break in to find the real plans for the inn, she discovers that her boss may not be as kindly as she believed, and her ambitions and Shane's revelation threaten their new romance.

The film was poorly received by reviewers of holiday movies. Jeffrey Lyles called it perhaps the laziest Christmas film of the year, faulting a generic script, weak chemistry between the leads, obvious green-screen work, slow pacing and the stunt casting of Fox, although he noted the director's attention to beautifully shot food. Very Merry Movies found it dull, with a central conflict that emerges far too late and almost nothing about Christmas, while acknowledging the appeal of Bonnie as a sidekick and the real snowy location. Dynamite Review likewise judged it bad, citing the leads' lack of chemistry.

title: Timmy Failure: Mistakes Were Made
overview: An 11-year old boy believes that he is the best detective in town and runs the agency Total Failures with his best friend, an imaginary 1,200 pound polar bear.
plot:
Timmy Failure: Mistakes Were Made is a 2020 American comedy film directed by Tom McCarthy, who co-wrote it with Stephan Pastis and Benjamin Pestana, based on Pastis's children's book series Timmy Failure. Produced by Walt Disney Pictures, it stars Winslow Fegley as Timmy, Ophelia Lovibond as his single mother Patty, Craig Robinson as the school counselor Mr. Jenkins, Wallace Shawn as Timmy's teacher Mr. Crocus and Kyle Bornheimer as Patty's boyfriend Crispin.

Timmy Failure is an eleven-year-old boy in Portland, Oregon, who runs a detective agency, Total Failure Inc., with his partner Total, an imaginary polar bear. Supremely confident but clueless, Timmy roams the city "solving" cases and battling imaginary enemies such as the "Russians", who are actually bearded hipsters. His small social circle includes his best friend Rollo, a former member of the agency, and Molly Moskins, a cheerful girl who has a crush on him. Timmy considers his archenemy a classmate named Corrina Corrina, who is in fact friendly toward him.

When the Segway that Timmy uses as his "Failure-Mobile", which actually belongs to his mother, is stolen, he drops all other cases to investigate, convinced that Corrina Corrina is behind a plot to destroy his agency. His odd behavior at school lands him in sessions with Mr. Jenkins, who gradually wins his trust. Meanwhile, Timmy's mother starts dating Crispin, whom Timmy dislikes, and the family faces financial trouble that forces them to move. On a school trip to the Bonneville Dam, Timmy's wild theories lead to a disastrous incident, and he must eventually face the reality behind his fantasies and the people who care about him.

The film celebrates imagination and childhood while gently exploring loneliness and a child's way of coping with change.

Timmy Failure: Mistakes Were Made premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 25, 2020, and was released on Disney+ on February 7, 2020. It received positive reviews, with 84 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it a fun, fast-paced film that celebrates the power of imagination. It was removed from Disney+ in May 2023 as part of a cost-cutting content purge.

title: Free Guy
tagline: Life's too short to be a background character.
overview: A bank teller called Guy realizes he is a background character in an open world video game called Free City that will soon go offline.
plot:
Free Guy is a 2021 American science fiction action comedy directed by Shawn Levy from a screenplay by Matt Lieberman and Zak Penn. It stars Ryan Reynolds as Guy, a cheerful bank teller who discovers that he is a non-player character in a massively multiplayer online game, with Jodie Comer as the game developer Millie Rusk, Lil Rel Howery as his best friend Buddy, Joe Keery as programmer Walter "Keys" McKey, Utkarsh Ambudkar as Mouser and Taika Waititi as Antwan Hovachelik, the narcissistic head of a game studio.

In the online game Free City, human players wearing sunglasses spend their time robbing, shooting and causing mayhem, while non-player characters like Guy follow the same daily routine without realizing that their world is a game. Millie, an unemployed developer, plays Free City in search of proof that its publisher, Soonami Studios, stole the code for Life Itself, a game she created with her former partner Keys, who now works for Soonami.

When Guy sees Millie's avatar, MolotovGirl, he becomes infatuated and begins to break from his programming. He takes a player's sunglasses, sees the game as players do, and starts leveling up by doing good deeds instead of committing crimes, becoming a worldwide sensation known as Blue Shirt Guy. As Keys realizes that Guy is an artificial intelligence that has developed self-awareness, and other characters begin to change too, Antwan prepares to launch Free City 2, which will wipe the original game and everyone in it. Guy and Millie race to find evidence hidden in the game's code before the servers are reset, while Guy rallies his fellow characters to stand up for their existence.

The film combines romantic comedy and action with ideas about artificial intelligence, free will and the meaning of a life lived by someone else's script, along with satire of gaming culture and franchise-driven entertainment.

Delayed repeatedly by the COVID-19 pandemic, Free Guy was released by 20th Century Studios on August 13, 2021. It grossed 331.5 million dollars worldwide and received positive reviews, with 80 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 62. It was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects.

title: Medieval
tagline: For honor. For justice. For freedom.
overview: The story of 14th century Czech icon and warlord Jan Zizka who defeated armies of the Teutonic Order and the Holy Roman Empire.
plot:
Medieval (also known as Jan Žižka or Warrior of God) is a 2022 English-language Czech historical drama film directed by Petr Jákl about the early life of Jan Žižka, the Bohemian military commander who never lost a battle. Set before the Hussite Wars, it stars Ben Foster as Žižka, Michael Caine as the fictional Lord Boreš, Matthew Goode as King Sigismund, and Sophie Lowe and Til Schweiger. With a budget of about 500 million koruna, it is the most expensive Czech film ever made.

In the late 14th century, Bohemia is ruled by the weak, indebted King Wenceslaus IV, while real power lies with the nobleman Henry of Rosenberg. Žižka leads a band of mercenaries who fight for money. After rescuing Lord Boreš from brigands hired by Rosenberg, he escorts him to Prague, where Wenceslaus's supporters hope to secure his coronation as Holy Roman Emperor in Rome. To force Rosenberg's support, Žižka is hired to kidnap his fiancée, Katherine, and smuggles her out of a cathedral on a cart of corpses. Rosenberg and Wenceslaus's half-brother Sigismund respond by sending Cuman warriors under Žižka's former mentor, Torak, and Rosenberg's guard. Torak raids Žižka's home village of Trocnov, captures his brother Jaroslav and mortally tortures his nephew, whom Žižka kills to end his suffering.

Žižka trains local rebels, exchanges Katherine for his brother, then recaptures her through superior tactics despite being outnumbered, losing several men and an eye in the fighting. Katherine, having witnessed Rosenberg's cruelty, chooses not to return to him and falls in love with Žižka, but his men betray him and take her to Wenceslaus's hunting castle to collect their reward. A dying Boreš reveals that Sigismund has seized the king and the castle. Žižka rallies the peasants and storms it; his men are killed in an ambush, and Katherine throws herself from the walls into the river to save him from Torak. Žižka kills Torak underwater, but Katherine dies after giving him her ring. An epilogue tells how Sigismund became king of Bohemia and launched crusades against the rebels, with Žižka leading the outnumbered Hussites.

Medieval premiered in Prague on 5 September 2022 and was released three days later, with one of the year's best Czech openings; in the United States it grossed $821,991. Reviews were mixed, praising some set pieces but criticizing a thin, confusing plot; Rotten Tomatoes reported 38% approval and Metacritic a score of 46.

title: The Two Popes
overview: Frustrated with the direction of the church, Cardinal Bergoglio requests permission to retire in 2012 from Pope Benedict. Instead, facing scandal and self-doubt, the introspective Pope Benedict summons his harshest critic and future successor to Rome to reveal a secret that would shake the foundations of the Catholic Church.
plot:
In April 2005, Cardinal Jorge Mario Bergoglio, Archbishop of Buenos Aires, is called to the Vatican after the death of Pope John Paul II to elect a new pope. Cardinal Joseph Ratzinger, a prominent German prelate, is elected Pope Benedict XVI; Cardinal Bergoglio receives the second-highest vote count. Seven years later, the Catholic Church is embroiled in the Vatican leaks scandal, and Benedict's tenure has been tainted by public accusations regarding his role in the coverup.
Bergoglio has submitted his resignation as archbishop, but the Vatican has not responded.
As he prepares to go to Rome and personally deliver his resignation, he is summoned to the Vatican. Bergoglio and Benedict meet at the Palace of Castel Gandolfo, the Pope's summer residence. The two debate the roles of God and the Church. Benedict recounts what led him to the priesthood and talks about his interests. The two watch Benedict's favorite TV show, Inspector Rex, which further delays their discussion about Bergoglio's resignation.
Bergoglio recounts his early life and path into the church. He ended his marital engagement and joined the Jesuits. He was met by Father Franz Jalics and Father Orlando Yorio, who become his spiritual friends. Benedict rejects Bergoglio's resignation, saying the world would perceive it as a vote of no confidence in his leadership and weaken the Catholic Church. Benedict and Bergoglio put aside their differences and chat informally, gradually warming to each other.
The next day, the two go to the Vatican by helicopter. Benedict continues to avoid discussing Bergoglio's resignation. Benedict meets with Bergoglio in the Room of Tears within the Sistine Chapel, where he confides his intention to resign the papacy. Shocked, Bergoglio objects and argues for church tradition and continuity. Benedict says his opinions regarding tradition are different now and believes change is essential. Benedict says Bergoglio could be his successor, but Bergoglio rejects the idea, citing the perception that he had collaborated with the Argentine military dictatorship, and his failure to protect his friends and confront the junta may have damaged his reputation. Following the "Dirty War", Bergoglio was removed as head of the Argentine Society of Jesus and exiled to serve as an ordinary parish priest to the poor for the next ten years.
Over time, Bergoglio reconciled with Father Jalics, but regrets never reconciling with Father Yorio. Memories of his actions and inaction during the dictatorship continually haunt him. Benedict comforts Bergoglio, reminding him that the freedom to choose to help is often stifled; he gives Bergoglio absolution. Then Benedict confesses he was aware of Father Marcial Maciel's long-term sexual misconduct and regrets staying silent, implying that this is the reason why he wants to resign: Benedict no longer hears God's words and affirms his wish to abdicate. Bergoglio comforts Benedict and offers him absolution as well.

title: Freaky
overview: A mystical, ancient dagger causes a notorious serial killer to magically switch bodies with a 17-year-old girl.
plot:
Freaky is a 2020 American body-swap horror-comedy film directed by Christopher Landon and written by Michael Leeson. The movie stars Vince Vaughn, Kathryn Newton, and Utkarsh Ambudkar.

The story begins with Millie Kessler (Kathryn Newton), a high school student who has always been bullied and belittled by her peers due to her awkwardness and social anxiety. One day, while walking home from school, she is attacked by a serial killer named Kevin Darnell (Vince Vaughn). However, just as the killer is about to stab her, Millie's body suddenly switches with that of Kevin's.

Initially, Millie is thrilled to be in Kevin's body, which is more confident and charismatic. She uses this new body to exact revenge on her tormentors and gain popularity at school. Meanwhile, Kevin's body is trapped inside Millie's, leading to a series of comedic misunderstandings as he tries to navigate his new surroundings.

As the story progresses, Millie/Kevin starts to develop feelings for her best friend, Mitch (Utkarsh Ambudkar), who has always had a crush on her. However, their budding romance is complicated by Kevin's presence in Millie's body, leading to some awkward and humorous moments.

Meanwhile, the police are investigating a series of murders committed by a serial killer known as "The Bliss Killer." As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Kevin Darnell is the mastermind behind these killings. However, with his body trapped inside Millie's, he must find a way to switch back and take responsibility for his actions.

In the end, Millie/Kevin comes up with a plan to switch bodies permanently by using a combination of magic and science. In a thrilling finale, she manages to trap Kevin's spirit in her own body, freeing herself from his influence and allowing her to live a more authentic life.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of twists and turns that keep the audience guessing. The film's blend of horror and comedy makes it a unique and entertaining watch. Vince Vaughn's performance as the villainous Kevin Darnell is particularly noteworthy, bringing a level of depth and complexity to the character that adds to the overall tension and suspense.

Overall, Freaky is a fun and engaging movie that explores themes of identity, empowerment, and the complexities of human relationships. With its clever plot twists and witty humor, it's sure to delight fans of horror-comedies and body-swap movies alike.

title: Black Christmas
overview: During Christmas break, the women at Hawthorne College start being preyed upon by an unknown stalker. Riley, a girl dealing with her own trauma, decides to take matters into her own hands before her and her friends are murdered too.
plot:
Black Christmas is a 2019 slasher film directed by Sophia Takal, who co-wrote it with April Wolfe. A loose remake of the 1974 Bob Clark film and the second after the 2006 version, it was produced by Jason Blum's Blumhouse Productions with Divide/Conquer as a United States–New Zealand–Canada co-production and shot over 27 days in Otago. Takal aimed for a feminist take and sought a PG-13 rating to reach young female horror fans. Universal Pictures released it on Friday, December 13, 2019.

At Hawthorne College, a student named Lindsay is murdered by a masked figure. Riley Stone, a member of the Mu Kappa Epsilon sorority, is still traumatized after being raped by Brian Huntley, president of the Delta Kappa Omicron fraternity. Her sorority sister Kris has angered the fraternity and Professor Gelson with petitions to remove the bust of college founder Calvin Hawthorne from the main building and to have Gelson fired for refusing to teach books by women. At the fraternity's talent show, Riley sees new pledges performing a ritual around the bust, then takes the stage with her sisters to call out the frat's rape culture in song. Soon the women receive threatening messages from an account posing as Hawthorne, their friend Helena disappears, and sister Fran is killed. Campus police refuse to help.

During a night of attacks, Jesse, Marty and Marty's boyfriend Nate are killed, and Riley and Kris recognize one attacker as a DKO pledge. Riley comes to suspect that Hawthorne, who practiced black magic, is behind the killings through his bust, which leaks a black liquid. With help from her new friend Landon she enters the fraternity house, where she is captured. Gelson reveals that the liquid allows Hawthorne's spirit to possess the pledges and send them to kill women considered unruly, and that Helena has secretly been helping them. Helena is killed as Kris and other sorority sisters storm the house. Riley overpowers Brian and smashes the bust, Kris sets Gelson ablaze, and the women and Landon escape, leaving the brothers to burn.

Imogen Poots plays Riley, with Aleyse Shannon as Kris, Lily Donoghue as Marty, Brittany O'Grady as Jesse, Caleb Eberhardt as Landon and Cary Elwes as Gelson. Reviews were mixed to negative, with Rotten Tomatoes at 41% and criticism of its departures from the original, its overt politics and its PG-13 rating, although Poots was praised. It grossed about $18.5 million worldwide against a $5 million budget.

title: PAW Patrol: Mighty Pups
overview: When their latest scheme goes awry, Mayor Humdinger and his nephew Harold accidentally divert a meteor towards Adventure Bay. The meteor's golden energy grants the PAW Patrol superpowers. The heroic Mighty Pups are on a roll to super-save the day.
plot:
PAW Patrol: Mighty Pups is a 2018 Canadian animated superhero adventure film, a 44-minute special of the preschool series PAW Patrol and the show's first double-length television movie. Directed by Charles E. Bastien, written by Andrew Guerdat and Steven Sullivan and animated by Guru Studio, it belongs to the series' fifth season and introduces Mayor Humdinger's nephew Harold. It premiered in the United States in July 2018, was issued on DVD that September and reached further markets from October 2018, including Canadian cinemas and, in December 2019, Italian ones. The voice cast includes Jaxon Mercey as Ryder, Max Calinescu as Chase, Devan Cohen as Rubble, Drew Davis as Marshall, Samuel Faraci as Rocky, Kallan Holley as Skye, Carter Thorne as Zuma, Berkley Silverman as Everest, Chance Hurstfield as Harold and Ron Pardo as Mayor Humdinger, Cap'n Turbot and Farmer Al.

Determined to become the "First Mayor on the Moon", Mayor Humdinger prepares a rocket launch on Adventure Beach with Harold's help, but the boy accidentally fires the rocket without his uncle. It misses the moon, strikes a passing meteor and sends it hurtling towards Adventure Bay. Alerted by Everest and Jake, Ryder and the pups clear the town before the meteor crashes harmlessly into the sand, and Chase, whom Ryder has put in charge of a team, doubts his own leadership. The meteor's golden energy soon gives the pups superpowers, from Chase's super speed and Rubble's super strength to Marshall's mighty heat and Everest's freezing sneeze, and Mayor Goodway puts the rock on display at City Hall. Harold, who has also gained powers that let him build gadgets, joins his uncle in a plan to steal the meteor and take over the city. After a first attempt is foiled, Ryder trusts Chase to lead the newly named Mighty Pups, but Harold uses a tractor beam to lift the meteor, carries it to the Lookout, traps Ryder inside and sends the tower soaring into the sky, then attacks in a giant robot. Under Chase's command the pups free one another, retrieve the meteor from the robot's backpack and, when the Lookout plunges back to Earth, use whirlwinds and a sand tornado to cushion its fall, saving Ryder. Their powers fade as the meteor loses its glow, and the rock is stored beneath the Lookout.

The Mighty Pups concept returned in later specials of the series, such as Mighty Pups, Super Paws and Mighty Pups, Charged Up.

title: The Head Hunter
overview: On the outskirts of a kingdom, a quiet but fierce medieval warrior protects the realm from monsters and the occult. His gruesome collection of heads is missing only one - the monster that killed his daughter years ago. Driven by a thirst for revenge, he travels wild expanses on horseback. When his second chance arrives, it’s in a way far more horrifying than he ever imagined.
plot:
The Head Hunter, first screened as The Head, is an American independent fantasy horror film directed, produced and edited by Jordan Downey, who wrote it with his longtime collaborator Kevin Stewart. Norwegian actor Christopher Rygh, in his feature debut, plays a lone medieval warrior known only as the Father, with Cora Kaufman as his murdered daughter and Aisha Ricketts voicing the creature he hunts. Made on a low budget with a small cast and very little dialogue, it was shot mainly around Bragança in northern Portugal, with additional scenes filmed in Norway and California. The filmmakers cited Quest for Fire, The Witch, The X-Files and Tales from the Crypt as inspirations.

In the Dark Ages, the Father lives alone in a remote cabin with only his horse, Jakke, for company. He earns his living killing the monsters that menace a nearby kingdom: each new bounty is announced by a horn and posted outside the castle walls, and he mounts the heads of his kills on the walls of his cabin. Between hunts he mends his armor, sets traps, tends his daughter's grave and brews a healing elixir from the blood and organs of the beasts he slays.

After Jakke is killed on a hunt, a new bounty is posted for the very creature that killed his daughter. The Father journeys north to an island, finds the monster in a cave, cuts off its head and brings it home. But a jar of the elixir spills onto the severed head, reviving it, and it drags itself into the forest in search of a new body. As night falls, the hunter is drawn into a battle of wits with the creature, which digs up his daughter's grave and attaches itself to her corpse. He tracks it to a cave and, after a long fight, tears its head from her body and stabs it repeatedly. The next morning he reburies her and returns to his chores, until a sudden cry is followed by silence. A figure that looks like the Father returns carrying a severed head and pins it to the wall: it is the Father's own. The creature, now wearing his body, leaves with the elixir.

The film premiered at the Sitges Film Festival in October 2018 and was retitled at the suggestion of its distributor, Vertical Entertainment, after lukewarm reactions to the original name. Reviews were positive, with 94% of 17 critics on Rotten Tomatoes recommending it; critics praised its atmosphere, cinematography and Rygh's performance, though some noted the limits of its budget.

title: Promare
overview: Galo and the Burning Rescue Fire Department face off against BURNISH, a group of mutants who are able to control and wield flames, and the fire disaster they have unleashed on Earth.
plot:
Promare is a 2019 Japanese animated science fiction action film directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi and written by Kazuki Nakashima, co-produced by Studio Trigger and XFLAG. It features character and mecha designs by Shigeto Koyama, 3D computer animation by Sanzigen and music by Hiroyuki Sawano. The film was the first feature produced by Trigger, a studio founded by former staff of Gainax, and reunites Imaishi and Nakashima, the director and writer of Gurren Lagann and Kill la Kill.

Thirty years before the story begins, a catastrophe known as the Great World Blaze saw outbreaks of spontaneous human combustion kill half of the world's population. Some survivors developed the ability to create and control flames and became known as the Burnish, a minority feared and persecuted by the rest of society. In the city of Promepolis, Galo Thymos, a hot-headed young member of the firefighting team Burning Rescue, battles fires caused by the Mad Burnish, a radical Burnish group branded as terrorists, and defeats their leader, Lio Fotia, who is then arrested by the Freeze Force, the police force serving the city's governor, Kray Foresight.

Lio and the other prisoners escape, and Galo follows them to a hideout where he sees Lio trying to save a dying Burnish and learns that Kray has been capturing Burnish people for human experiments. Galo, who idolizes Kray for having saved his life as a child, confronts the governor, who reveals that the Earth will soon be destroyed by a surge of magma from its core and that he plans to use the Burnish's power to fuel a warp drive and escape the planet with a select few. Arrested for opposing the plan, Galo must join forces with his former enemy Lio to uncover the true nature of the Burnish flames and save both peoples.

The film is known for its bold, neon-colored, geometric visual style and over-the-top action, while its story deals with themes of discrimination and prejudice.

Promare was released in Japan by Toho Animation on May 24, 2019, and in North America by GKIDS. It received widespread critical acclaim, with 97 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, was selected for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, and was nominated for the Annie Award for Best Animated Feature – Independent.

title: Honest Thief
tagline: Never steal a man's second chance.
overview: A bank robber tries to turn himself in because he's falling in love and wants to live an honest life...but when he realizes the Feds are more corrupt than him, he must fight back to clear his name.
plot:
Honest Thief is a 2020 American action comedy film directed by Mark Williams Jardine and written by Chris Bremner. The movie stars Will Poulter, Lily Collins, and Damson Idris.

The story begins with Nick (Will Poulter), an ex-con who has just been released from prison after serving time for a string of high-profile art thefts. Despite his tough exterior, Nick is haunted by the memories of his past and struggles to find work or connect with people. He lives in a small apartment and spends most of his days sleeping on the couch.

One day, Nick receives an offer from a wealthy collector, Frank Cook (Damson Idris), who wants him to steal a valuable painting from a museum in Los Angeles. The catch is that the painting belongs to Frank's estranged father, and stealing it would be a betrayal of his family's trust.

Despite his reservations, Nick agrees to take on the job, hoping to earn enough money to pay off his debts and start fresh. As he plans the heist, Nick begins to develop feelings for Frank's sister, Emma (Lily Collins), who is working as a museum curator.

As the day of the heist approaches, Nick becomes increasingly anxious about the risks involved. He knows that if he gets caught, he'll be sent back to prison and lose his chance at redemption. Meanwhile, Frank becomes suspicious of Nick's intentions and starts to investigate him.

On the night of the heist, Nick successfully steals the painting, but things don't go according to plan. Emma discovers his true identity and confronts him about his past mistakes. Despite this, she chooses to believe in Nick and help him escape from the museum.

As they make their way through the city, Nick and Emma form a bond, and Nick begins to open up about his past traumas. Frank, however, is hot on their heels, determined to catch Nick and reclaim the stolen painting.

The movie culminates in an action-packed chase sequence as Nick, Emma, and Frank engage in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. In the end, Nick manages to outsmart Frank and return the painting, but not before revealing his true identity and confessing his past mistakes.

As the dust settles, Nick and Emma share a moment of intimacy, suggesting that they may have found love amidst the chaos. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Nick finally finding redemption and a chance to start anew.

Overall, Honest Thief is a tense and entertaining thriller that explores themes of redemption, trust, and the power of human connection. Will Poulter delivers a standout performance as the complex and troubled Nick, while Lily Collins shines as the compassionate and understanding Emma.

title: Return to Christmas Creek
overview: As Christmas approaches, Amelia Hughes, a career-focused Chicago app developer lacking in holiday spirit, returns to her small hometown of Christmas Creek to rediscover the meaning of Christmas. There, she reunites with her childhood best friend Mike and her estranged uncle Harry, whose mysterious rift with Amelia’s father divided her family during the holiday season when she was a child.
plot:
Return to Christmas Creek is a 2018 Canadian-American romantic holiday television film directed by Don McBrearty from a screenplay by Kirsten Hansen, made for Hallmark Movies & Mysteries by companies including the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Brad Krevoy Television, Hideaway Pictures and All Canadian Entertainment. It stars Tori Anderson as Amelia, Stephen Huszar as Mike Ruggles and Steven Weber as her uncle Harry, with Kari Matchett as Pamela, Stuart Hughes as Amelia's father Dan, Janet Porter, Lyla Elliott as Scout and Byron Abalos. It runs about 86 minutes, with music by Sean Nimmons-Paterson.

Amelia is a career-focused Chicago app developer with little holiday spirit, who usually escapes the season with a solo trip to Turks and Caicos. When investors reject her new app, Christmas Assist, which automates gift-buying and card-sending, on the grounds that it lacks the true spirit of Christmas, and her boyfriend Brad breaks up with her because she will not spend the holidays with his family, she sees her childhood photo with Uncle Harry on an invitation to the Fly By Santa anniversary in her hometown, Christmas Creek. Harry, a pilot who runs the family inn, flies over the town dressed as Santa every Christmas Eve to deliver toys to children in remote communities, and Amelia was once his co-pilot, until a quarrel between Harry and her father over the family business split the family and led her parents to move away. Back in town without telling her parents, Amelia reunites with her childhood best friend Mike, now in search and rescue and Harry's new co-pilot, and with his young niece Scout. As she and Mike grow close through tree hunting, stargazing, gingerbread and snowball fights, Harry tentatively rekindles his romance with his ex-girlfriend Pamela. When Amelia's parents arrive, a tense family dinner reopens the feud, but her heartfelt appeal about family helps the brothers reconcile, inspires her to rethink her app around charity, and leads her and Mike to confess their love before the Christmas Eve flight.

Reviewers found it pleasant but conventional. Fits of Fury praised Anderson's expressive, gentle performance and Weber's portrayal of Harry's shame and regret, and found the Harry and Pamela storyline more satisfying than the central romance, but judged the decades-long family feud underdeveloped and its climax quickly dissipated, calling the film perfectly fine yet very forgettable. Lifetime Uncorked rated it three Christmas trees.

title: Tod@s Caen
overview: A pair of seducers try to prove who has the best techniques while trying not to fall in love with each other.
plot:
Tod@s caen is a 2019 Mexican romantic comedy directed by Ariel Winograd from a screenplay by Martha Higareda and Cory Brusseau. Higareda, who also produced the film, stars opposite Omar Chaparro, her co-star in the No manches Frida films, with a supporting cast including Claudia Álvarez, Miri Higareda, Mauricio Barrientos "El Diablito", Consuelo Duval, Edgar Vivar, Anabel Ferreira, Tiaré Scanda, Eugenio Siller and Santiago Michel. Although it was made before No manches Frida 2, its release was postponed for several years.

Adán is a charming seducer convinced that he knows how to win over any woman, and he sets out to teach his friends his array of supposedly infallible rules of seduction. Mía, worn out by bad dates, has devised her own set of rules to avoid falling into men's traps. An ambitious television producer, she dreams of hosting her own show about female empowerment called "Todos caen", a strategic guide to dating that promises to teach women how to hook a man and have him eating out of their hand. When she is offered the chance to make that dream come true on condition that she seduces Adán and breaks his heart, the two meet at a bar and the game begins. Each having been hurt in the past, they test their carefully honed strategies on one another in a battle of the sexes full of tricks, mishaps and power struggles in which whoever falls in love first loses, until both discover that playing hard to get can make them fall all the harder. At times the leads break the fourth wall to address the men and women in the audience directly.

The film opened in the United States before reaching Mexican cinemas on September 20, 2019. In Mexico it debuted at number one, earning 48.4 million pesos from 872,000 admissions in its opening weekend, and it had taken about US$2.5 million in the United States after four weeks. It became one of the highest-grossing Mexican films of the year.

Critical reception was generally unfavourable. Cine Premiere gave it one and a half stars out of five, calling it a product rather than a bold or original proposal and arguing that it borrowed shamelessly from Hollywood comedies such as Hitch and How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days, with clichés, contrived coincidences and blatant product placement. Cinemedios was kinder, finding it an entertaining popcorn film thanks to Winograd's direction and the chemistry between Higareda and Chaparro, while faulting its uneven pacing and some sexist jokes.

title: No Manches Frida 2
overview: Ex-con Zequi and company come back for a new adventure.
plot:
No Manches Frida 2 is a Spanish comedy film directed by David Pablos and starring Karra Elejalde, Clara Lago, and Antonio de la Torre. The movie is the sequel to the 2016 film No Manches Frida.

The story begins with Álvaro Molina (Karra Elejalde), a former professional soccer player who has retired from the sport due to an injury. Álvaro is now working as a coach for a local youth soccer team, but he's struggling to connect with his players and find his place in life.

One day, Álvaro receives an offer to become the new coach of the national under-20 soccer team, which is led by the charismatic and confident captain, Iván (Antonio de la Torre). However, there's a catch: the team has been struggling on the field, and the players are not motivated. Álvaro sees this as an opportunity to redeem himself and prove his coaching skills.

As Álvaro takes over the team, he faces resistance from the players, who are skeptical of his abilities. However, with the help of Iván's sister, Frida (Clara Lago), a talented young player who becomes Álvaro's protégée, he starts to win them over.

Meanwhile, Álvaro also has to deal with the pressure from the team's sponsors and the media, who are expecting him to deliver results quickly. As the team prepares for an important tournament, Álvaro must navigate the challenges of coaching a young team while dealing with his own personal demons.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of comedic moments as Álvaro tries to connect with his players and find his place in the world. The film also explores themes of identity, redemption, and the importance of finding one's passion in life.

In the end, Álvaro and his team face off against their toughest opponents yet, but with Frida's help, they're able to overcome their challenges and achieve success on the field. The movie ends on a high note, with Álvaro finally finding his place as a coach and a person.

Overall, No Manches Frida 2 is a heartwarming and hilarious comedy that explores themes of identity, redemption, and the power of sports to bring people together. With its talented cast and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for fans of Spanish cinema.
