title: The Final Wish
tagline: Once you wish, your soul is bound.
overview: Following the passing of his father, Aaron Hammond returns to his hometown to help his devastated mother and to confront his past demons. Sifting through his father’s belongings, Aaron comes upon a mysterious item that is far more than it seems.
plot:
The Final Wish is a 2018 American supernatural horror film directed by Timothy Woodward Jr. and written by Jeffrey Reddick, William Halfon and Jonathan Doyle, with Reddick also serving as co-producer. Michael Welch stars as Aaron Hammond, a young man who unwittingly unleashes a wish-granting evil, and Lin Shaye plays his grieving mother, Kate, with Melissa Bolona, Spencer Locke and Tony Todd in supporting roles.

The film opens with a girl coming home from a date to find her mother hacked in half and her blood-soaked father holding a samurai sword. Years later, after his father's death, Aaron, a struggling law school graduate, returns to his small hometown, where his relationship with his mother remains strained. Sorting through his father's collection of antiques, he finds a recently acquired urn and tries to sell it online for $3,000 to cover his overdue rent. Without realizing it, he has freed a malevolent spirit trapped inside, and the careless wishes he blurts out begin to come true in terrible ways. Wishing that Kate could forget his father and move on, he leaves her stripped of her memories and lost in confusion, and later finds her dancing in the barn with his father's corpse. His best friend, Jeremy, vanishes, and Aaron learns from Jeremy's mother that he died in a car accident a year earlier.

With his friend Lisa, Aaron consults an antiques dealer, who suggests the urn may be a dybbuk box, an object from Jewish folklore said to hold evil spirits. They trace its previous owner, William, the man who killed his wife in the opening scene and later cut out his own tongue; visiting him in an asylum, they learn in writing that a seventh wish will cost Aaron his soul. The djinn begins to taunt him, and Aaron finds his mother hanged in the barn. When the local sheriff warns him away from Lisa, Aaron wishes that the man would stop hurting her, only for the spirit to twist the wish into a deadly confrontation in which the sheriff is shot and Lisa is accidentally killed. With his final wish, Aaron chooses to undo his own life, and he awakens with his soul trapped in a mirror. At a yard sale, Kate, now alive and preparing to move, hands the urn to Lisa, who invites her to visit in Chicago, hinting that the curse will continue.

The Final Wish premiered at the Screamfest Horror Film Festival on October 17, 2018, and was distributed by Cinedigm. It holds a 67% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes from a small number of reviews.

title: Guillermo del Toro's Pinocchio
overview: During the rise of fascism in Mussolini's Italy, a wooden boy brought magically to life struggles to live up to his father's expectations.
plot:
In Italy, woodcarver Geppetto loses his son Carlo to an aerial bombardment by Austro-Hungarian forces during World War I. Twenty years later, he uses the pine wood planted in Carlo's grave to create a puppet in drunken despair. The Wood Sprite appears in the middle of the night and brings it to life, christening him Pinocchio due to the puppet being made of pine, and assigns Sebastian J. Cricket, who formerly lived inside the pine wood, to guide him morally, promising him a wish in exchange. Geppetto wakes up and is frightened by Pinocchio exploring and destroying his home. He becomes fed up with Pinocchio's antics due to his newborn lack of self-control, and he is told by the town that he must send the boy to school to teach him discipline. He gifts Pinocchio a schoolbook that used to belong to Carlo.
On his way, Pinocchio is intercepted by showman Count Volpe and his monkey Spazzatura, who bring Pinocchio to their circus to perform. Geppetto arrives to take him back, resulting in a confrontation that causes them to fight over him and ends with Pinocchio being fatally hit by the Podestà's truck. In the afterlife, he meets the Wood Sprite's sister, Death, who explains that he is immortal and revives when an hourglass empties, cautioning that each time he dies, he will spend longer in the afterlife before returning to life.
After Pinocchio comes back to life, an army officer hears about him and meets up with Geppetto. The officer tells Geppetto that Pinocchio may be a distraction by others and should be sent to military youth camp by law. Geppetto is conflicted over sending Pinocchio to youth camp or sending him to perform in the circus. Seeing Geppetto upset, Pinocchio decides to earn money for him by performing in the circus, and to avoid being conscripted into the Army by the Podestà, who thinks his immortality makes him the ideal soldier. A jealous Spazzatura, the former star, reveals to Pinocchio that Volpe has been lying to him about sending half their profits to Geppetto. Hearing this, Volpe viciously beats Spazzatura as a result, upsetting Pinocchio, who performs a song ridiculing Benito Mussolini while he is in attendance. Mussolini has Pinocchio executed and the circus burned down.
Once revived, Pinocchio is taken by the Podestà to military recruit training, where other boys are trained for war. He befriends the Podestà's mistreated son, Candlewick. At a training game, Pinocchio and Candlewick win in a tie; the Podestà orders Candlewick to shoot Pinocchio, but he refuses and finally stands up to his father. The training camp is then bombed by Allied aircraft, killing the Podestà, while the boys flee. Pinocchio is captured by Volpe, who tries to burn him to death as revenge for ruining his career. Spazzatura saves Pinocchio and attacks Volpe, resulting in all three falling off a seaside cliff, which kills Volpe.
Lost at sea, Pinocchio and Spazzatura are swallowed by the Terrible Dogfish.

title: The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith
original_title: The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith
overview: Missionary John H. Groberg returns to Tonga in the 1960s with his wife and their five young daughters. When their sixth child is born with a serious illness, the Grobergs face their ultimate test of faith, only to find themselves surrounded by the love and prayers of thousands of Tongans. Barriers of inter religious strife are soon broken down as all unite in hopes of a miracle that will save the baby's life, as well as the life of a Tongan minister's son.
plot:
The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith is a 2019 biographical adventure drama written and directed by Mitch Davis, a sequel to The Other Side of Heaven (2001). It is based on The Fire of Faith, the second memoir of John H. Groberg. Christopher Gorham returns as Groberg, with Natalie Medlock replacing Anne Hathaway as his wife Jean, Ben Baker as the minister Sione Paletu'a, Alex Tarrant as his son Toutai and Russell Dixon as Thomas S. Monson.

In the 1960s, ten years after his service as a young missionary in Tonga, Groberg is called to lead the Tonga–Fiji mission of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He returns with Jean and their five daughters. Sione, a Tongan minister, is enraged to learn that his son Toutai plans to join the Church and become a missionary, and he sets out to thwart the missionaries. He punishes Toutai by burying him up to his neck in the sand on a beach as a storm approaches from the sea. When Toutai's brother tries to dig him out, he is struck by lightning, but Toutai survives against the odds.

Jean gives birth to the family's sixth child, a son who is born gravely ill. The baby is too sick to be taken off the island for the medical care he needs, and while she stays in the hospital, local people bring her gifts and fruit. In the same hospital, Sione's son lies in a coma. As both sons fight for their lives, the two fathers set aside their differences and comfort each other.

Davis had long refused to make a sequel, fearing a cheap imitation of the first film. He changed his mind after Groberg told him that the late Church president Thomas S. Monson had wanted both of his memoirs filmed, and after learning that Fiji offered a 47 percent film incentive. Cyclones Josie and Keni struck during filming. Hathaway was replaced for budget reasons. The film opened in U.S. theaters on June 28, 2019, deliberately released against Toy Story 4 and Spider-Man: Far From Home. It was the top faith-based film at the box office and grossed about $1.8 million. Critics were divided. The Deseret News called it a more thoughtful examination of its subject than the original, and The Salt Lake Tribune found it quietly powerful. Variety dismissed it as tedious and bland, and RogerEbert.com was largely negative despite praising its production values. It won the 2019 AML Award for narrative feature film.

title: The Holiday Calendar
overview: A talented photographer stuck in a dead-end job inherits an antique Advent calendar that may be predicting the future -- and pointing her toward love.
plot:
Abby Sutton, a struggling photographer receives an Advent calendar from her grandfather. Abby isn't impressed at first, but she decides to take it home anyway. The calendar opens up on December 1. Abby begins to connect what is inside each day to what happens in real life, believing that the calendar is magical.
Meanwhile, Abby's friend Josh has been away around the world to focus on his photography but has come back to see Abby.
On December 1, Abby's calendar reveals a pair of boots, and Josh gifts her a pair of boots he bought for her in Italy. On December 2, Abby receives a Christmas tree in her calendar, and she meets a guy named Ty Walker after his tree falls off the roof of his car into her path. On December 3, Abby's calendar reveals a nutcracker, the costume of which Ty's daughter wears in the play put on by Abby's niece's school. The two run into each other again when Abby sprains her wrist and Ty is the doctor who treats her at the clinic. He asks her out, and she agrees to go on a date with him.
Abby continues dating Ty, which Josh is struggling with even though he has never expressed his feelings for Abby before. After dating Ty for a couple of weeks, Abby questions his feelings for her and shares her beliefs about the calendar with him. Ty admits he doesn't know Abby very well and criticizes her feelings about the calendar, causing Abby to break up with him.
While working taking pictures of kids meeting Santa, Abby is asked to take some pictures of the local mayor who is participating in a tree-lighting ceremony nearby. Josh inadvertently erases her pictures from the event, and Abby is fired. She and Josh get into an argument and stop seeing each other. Josh leaves to visit his parents in Florida.
Abby's sister puts up a number of her pictures in a school auction, and they are very popular. Her parents finally realize how talented a photographer she is, and the mayor herself won the bid for a photo session. Unfortunately, the Advent calendar was inadvertently sold at the auction as well. The very next day, however, her calendar appears at her front door. Inside, she finds a note from Josh asking her to meet him on Christmas Day.
Josh surprises Abby by telling her he bought the studio so they can do photography together. Abby confesses her feelings for Josh, saying he has always been the guy for her, but she just didn't know it. Josh asks Abby what she got in her calendar that day - which turns out to be a snowflake - and the two share a kiss under the falling snow. title: Brahms: The Boy II
overview: After a family moves into the Heelshire Mansion, their young son soon makes friends with a life-like doll called Brahms.
plot:
Brahms: The Boy II is a 2018 American supernatural horror film directed by William Brent Bell and written by Christopher Bubley. It was released on February 2, 2018, not in 2020 as mentioned.

The movie serves as a sequel to the 2016 film Brahms: The Boy. The story follows Elizabeth Brenner (Linda Cardellini), who has moved away from the haunted house with her husband Steve (Auggie Maturo) and their young son Josh (Jacob Tremblay). However, they soon discover that the malevolent spirit of Brahms, a German dollmaker, is still present in the house.

As the family tries to rebuild their lives, strange occurrences start to happen again. The dollmaker's presence becomes more pronounced, and Elizabeth begins to experience terrifying visions and nightmares. She starts to suspect that Brahms has followed her and her family to their new home.

The movie takes a darker turn as Josh becomes increasingly possessed by Brahms' spirit. As the events escalate, Elizabeth realizes that she must find a way to stop Brahms once and for all before it's too late. The film builds up to a thrilling climax as Elizabeth confronts the evil dollmaker in a desperate bid to save her family.

Throughout the movie, the atmosphere is tense and foreboding, with a sense of dread that permeates every scene. The special effects are impressive, bringing Brahms to life in a way that's both terrifying and mesmerizing.

One of the standout aspects of the film is its exploration of themes such as grief, trauma, and the supernatural. Elizabeth's character is particularly well-developed, as she struggles to come to terms with her past and find a way to move on from the horrors she experienced in the first film.

Overall, Brahms: The Boy II is a chilling horror movie that will keep you on the edge of your seat. With its creepy atmosphere, impressive special effects, and well-developed characters, it's a must-see for fans of the supernatural genre.

title: Hamilton
overview: Presenting the tale of American founding father Alexander Hamilton, this filmed version of the original Broadway smash hit is the story of America then, told by America now.
plot:
Hamilton is a 2020 American filmed stage production of the Broadway musical Hamilton, written by Lin-Manuel Miranda and inspired by Ron Chernow's 2004 biography of Alexander Hamilton. Directed by Thomas Kail, who staged the original production, and co-produced by Kail, Jeffrey Seller and Miranda, it was recorded over three performances at the Richard Rodgers Theatre in New York in June 2016 with the show's original Broadway cast. Miranda stars as Hamilton, with Leslie Odom Jr. as Aaron Burr, Phillipa Soo as Eliza Hamilton, Renée Elise Goldsberry as Angelica Schuyler, Christopher Jackson as George Washington, Daveed Diggs as the Marquis de Lafayette and Thomas Jefferson, Jonathan Groff as King George III, Anthony Ramos and Okieriete Onaodowan.

Told almost entirely through song, blending hip hop, R&B, jazz and traditional show tunes, and performed by a deliberately diverse cast portraying the Founding Fathers, the musical follows Hamilton's life in two acts, with Burr serving as the principal narrator. The first act traces Hamilton's arrival in New York as an ambitious, penniless immigrant from the Caribbean, his friendships with revolutionary figures, his service as aide-de-camp to George Washington during the American Revolutionary War, his marriage to Eliza Schuyler and his close bond with her sister Angelica, and his rise as a lawyer and one of the authors of The Federalist Papers.

The second act follows Hamilton's tenure as the first Secretary of the Treasury, his political clashes with Thomas Jefferson and James Madison, and his affair with Maria Reynolds, which becomes a public scandal. Tragedy strikes when his son Philip is killed in a duel, and the family must reckon with grief. Meanwhile, Hamilton's long rivalry with Burr intensifies as their political ambitions collide, culminating in the 1804 duel in which Burr fatally shoots him. The finale reflects on legacy and on Eliza's decades of work preserving her husband's memory.

Disney originally planned a theatrical release in 2021 but, because of the COVID-19 pandemic, released the film on Disney+ on 3 July 2020, where it drew a large audience. It received universal acclaim for its performances and for Kail's filming, which used multiple cameras and close-ups to capture the stage show. It won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Variety Special (Pre-Recorded), among other honors.

title: Emma.
overview: In 1800s England, a well-meaning but selfish young woman meddles in the love lives of her friends.
plot:
Emma is a 2020 period romantic comedy-drama film directed by Autumn de Wilde, based on the novel of the same name by Jane Austen. The screenplay was written by Deborah Moggach.

The story takes place in the early 19th century and revolves around Emma Woodhouse (played by Anya Taylor-Joy), a young, wealthy, and somewhat spoiled woman living with her father, Mr. Woodhouse (played by Bill Nighy), at their estate in Highbury, Surrey. Emma is determined to play matchmaker for her friends, but often ends up causing more harm than good.

The film begins with Emma's attempts to set up Harriet Smith (played by Florence Pugh), a young and impressionable woman from a lower social class, with the wealthy Mr. Elton (played by Johnny Flynn). However, Emma's meddling leads to misunderstandings and hurt feelings among the characters.

As the story unfolds, Emma becomes infatuated with the charming but socially awkward Mr. Knightley (played by Johnny Flynn), who is also Harriet's mentor. Despite their initial dislike for each other, they develop a close relationship, which helps Emma to see herself in a different light and understand the consequences of her actions.

Meanwhile, Harriet finds herself caught between her growing feelings for Mr. Elton and her loyalty to Emma, who has been trying to set them up. The situation becomes complicated when Mr. Elton's true intentions are revealed, and Harriet is forced to reevaluate her relationships with both him and Emma.

Throughout the film, Austen's witty dialogue and commentary on social class, love, and personal growth are expertly woven into the narrative. The cast delivers outstanding performances, bringing depth and nuance to their characters.

As the story reaches its climax, Emma comes to realize that she has been blind to her own flaws and biases. With Mr. Knightley's guidance, she learns to let go of her need for control and to appreciate the beauty of genuine relationships. The film concludes with a heartwarming moment of redemption and growth for Emma, as she finally finds love and acceptance.

Overall, Emma is a delightful adaptation that stays true to Austen's original novel while also offering fresh insights into the timeless themes of love, class, and personal growth.

title: Three Thousand Years of Longing
overview: A solitary scholar discovers an ancient bottle while on a trip to Istanbul and unleashes a djinn who offers her three wishes. Filled with reluctance, she is unable to come up with one, so the djinn tries to inspire her with his stories.
plot:
Three Thousand Years of Longing is a 2022 romantic fantasy drama film directed and produced by George Miller, who wrote it with Augusta Gore, based on A. S. Byatt's 1994 short story "The Djinn in the Nightingale's Eye". Tilda Swinton stars as a scholar who releases a djinn, played by Idris Elba, from a bottle, and the cast also includes Aska Karem, Matteo Bocelli, Aamito Lagum, Sarah Houbolt, Lachy Hulme and Ece Yüksel. The film is dedicated to Miller's mother Angela and to Rena Mitchell, a relative of producer Doug Mitchell.

Alithea Binnie, a British scholar of narratology who sometimes hallucinates demonic figures, buys an antique nightingale's eye bottle during a trip to Istanbul and unwittingly releases the Djinn trapped inside. He offers her three wishes, as long as each reflects her heart's true desire, but Alithea suspects him of being a trickster and is reluctant to wish for anything. To win her trust, the Djinn tells her the story of his long existence and how he came to be imprisoned. Once the lover of the Queen of Sheba, he was trapped in a brass bottle by the jealous King Solomon and cast into the Red Sea. Centuries later, freed by Gülten, a concubine in the palace of Suleiman the Magnificent, he helped her win the love of Suleiman's son Mustafa, only for both to be killed amid palace intrigues before her final wish could be made. Trapped again for many years, he watched the reigns of later sultans until a concubine accidentally freed him and, mistrusting him, wished him back to the bottom of the Bosporus. In the 19th century the bottle came to Zefir, a merchant's wife hungry for knowledge, with whom the Djinn fell deeply in love, until her own feelings of entrapment led to another heartbreaking end. Moved by his tales of love and loss, Alithea finally makes her first wish, a choice that changes both their lives.

The film premiered out of competition at the 75th Cannes Film Festival on May 20, 2022, and was released in the United States by MGM through United Artists Releasing on August 26 and in Australia on September 1. Critics praised its visuals and performances, but it was a box-office bomb, grossing $20.3 million against a $60 million budget.

title: The Princess Switch
overview: When a down-to-earth Chicago baker and a soon-to-be princess discover they look like twins, they hatch a Christmastime plan to trade places.
plot:
A week before Christmas, Stacy’s assistant and best friend, Kevin tells her that he has secretly entered her in a prestigious baking competition in the Kingdom of Belgravia. Initially reluctant, Stacy agrees to go there with Kevin and his daughter Olivia after a brief encounter with her ex-boyfriend and his new girlfriend.
At the competition space, Stacy runs into her culinary school rival Brianna, who deliberately stains her apron. In the dressing room, she then runs into Lady Margaret Delacourt, Duchess of Montenaro and fiancée of Crown Prince Edward of Belgravia. They are both shocked to realize they look exactly like each other.
Desperate for time out of the spotlight and to try an ordinary life, Margaret suggests to Stacy that they switch places for two days, then switch back before the competition and her and Edward's wedding. Initially reluctant, Stacy eventually accepts. This is because Lady Margaret agrees to sponsor Olivia as a student in Belgravia's acclaimed summer ballet program.
Stacy and Margaret quickly teach each other about their lives and behavior to minimize suspicion, and part ways. Olivia quickly discovers the switch but helps keep the secret while bonding with Margaret. Meanwhile, Prince Edward – who was supposed to be away on business for the two days of the switch – changes his plans to spend time with his fiancée.
King George senses something is afoot, so tasks his butler Frank to watch her. Stacy adapts to court life and begins falling in love with Prince Edward, while Margaret falls in love with Kevin and realizes that she loves living a normal life. Despite this, the women switch back as planned. Meanwhile, Brianna sneaks into the TV station one night and sabotages Stacy's mixer.
Frank photographs Margaret and Stacy together, and shows that they swapped identities to the Queen. She then fakes illness to send Edward and Margaret to attend the competition in her place. There, due to Brianna's vandalism, Stacy is forced to mix her ingredients by hand.
Despite the setback, Stacy and Kevin win first prize, with medals presented by Lady Margaret and Prince Edward, where their switch is discovered. Margaret professes her love for Kevin, while Stacy walks away, feeling out of place in Edward's royal life. Edward stops her and proposes, suggesting a Christmas wedding in a year if they are still in love.
One year later, Stacy marries Prince Edward and becomes Princess of Belgravia, and Margaret catches the bouquet.

plot:
Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans is a 2019 American animated superhero comedy film that brings together the casts of two television series, the comedic Teen Titans Go! and the earlier Teen Titans, both based on the DC Comics team. It serves as a sequel to both Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018) and Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo (2006). Scott Menville, Hynden Walch, Khary Payton, Tara Strong and Greg Cipes voice both versions of their characters, with Kevin Michael Richardson as Trigon and Rhys Darby as the Master of Games. It premiered at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2019 before its home release.

A year after defeating Slade, the light-hearted 2013 Titans foil a bank robbery by the Gentleman Ghost, who possesses Robin and Starfire before trying to take over Raven. In the process he cracks the gem on Raven's forehead, which keeps her demonic power in check, and she defeats him with a burst of dark energy. Her father, the demon Trigon, offers to take her demon half away, but she refuses.

The team is then abducted by the Master of Games, who is travelling the multiverse with a device called the Worlogog. He forces the comedic Titans to fight their more serious 2003 counterparts, threatening to destroy both their worlds. Raven is goaded into unleashing her demonic power, and the older Raven realises that the Master of Games is draining it. He is revealed as the 2013 Trigon, who uses the stolen power to partly revive his 2003 counterpart. The two Trigons seize both Ravens and escape to the 2003 Earth.

The two teams join forces. Deducing that their own dimension must also contain a Worlogog, the 2013 Titans realise it belongs to Santa Claus, and they steal it after a battle with Santa and Mrs. Claus. Travelling across the multiverse, they visit worlds of other Teen Titans incarnations, but arrive too late: the 2013 Trigon has absorbed the 2003 Trigon and become a monstrous being called Hexagon.

Robin summons Titans from across the multiverse to fight Hexagon, but they are overwhelmed until the 2013 Raven absorbs the power of her many counterparts and transforms into a giant black dragon. The Titans destroy Trigon's Worlogog and help Raven defeat him; the 2003 Trigon is sent to limbo and the 2013 Trigon to a dimension of zombie Titans. Having accepted her demonic side, Raven returns home with her team, who are too tired to fight Darkseid when he attacks Jump City. Reviews were positive, IGN rating it 8 out of 10.

title: Mainstream
overview: A young woman thinks she’s found a path to internet stardom when she starts making YouTube videos with a charismatic stranger  – until the dark side of viral celebrity threatens to ruin them both.
plot:
Mainstream is a 2020 American comedy-drama directed by Gia Coppola, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tom Stuart. Andrew Garfield, Maya Hawke and Nat Wolff star, with Johnny Knoxville and Jason Schwartzman in supporting roles. A satire of internet celebrity and social media, the film premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2020 and was released by IFC Films in May 2021.

Frankie is a young woman in West Hollywood who has dropped out of school to pursue her artistic ambitions, but she is stuck working at a bar with her friend Jake and posting videos to a YouTube channel that few people watch. One day at a shopping mall she films Link, an eccentric young man working as a costumed mascot. When she claims she was recording a painting behind him rather than him, Link grabs the painting and delivers a rambling, passionate speech urging passersby to look up from their phones and pay attention to art. Frankie uploads the footage, and it quickly becomes her most popular video.

Frankie runs into Link again and befriends him. He is manic, charismatic and loudly opposed to the establishment and to social media. He agrees to appear in more of her videos on the condition that she quits her job, and she persuades Jake to join them as a writer. Together they create an online persona for Link called "No One Special," a provocateur who mocks the vapid culture of social media influencers, and his anarchic content quickly makes him an online star. But as his fame and followers grow, Link becomes increasingly egotistical, cruel and unpredictable, embracing the very culture he claimed to despise, and his stunts become more outrageous and offensive. Frankie, who has developed feelings for him, and Jake, who resents being sidelined, must confront what they have helped create as Link's behavior spirals toward a public disaster.

The film received generally negative reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 42 percent rating, with a consensus stating that it makes a vain attempt to satirize viral fame and settles for obvious commentary that feels dated, and it has a Metacritic score of 36. Garfield's committed, manic performance was frequently singled out as the most memorable element of the film.

title: Deadpool: No Good Deed
overview: Deadpool sees an opportunity to save the day, but it doesn't go entirely as planned.
plot:
No Good Deed, often billed as Deadpool: No Good Deed, is a 2017 American superhero short film featuring the Marvel Comics character Deadpool. It was directed by David Leitch from a script by Rhett Reese and Paul Wernick, the writers of the 2016 film Deadpool, and stars Ryan Reynolds as Wade Wilson, with Stan Lee appearing in a cameo in the online version. The short was produced as a teaser for the feature Deadpool 2, which Leitch went on to direct, although it is not a trailer for that film.

The story is a brief comic vignette. Walking down a city street, Wade Wilson notices an elderly man being threatened by a mugger in an alley. Rather than intervening immediately as an ordinary person, Wade decides that the situation calls for his superhero alter ego and dashes into a nearby phone booth to change into his red Deadpool costume, in a nod to the classic image of Superman changing clothes. The transformation turns out to be a long and awkward process, and while Wade struggles with his suit, the robbery in the alley takes a fatal turn. When Deadpool finally emerges, fully dressed and ready for action, he finds that the mugger is long gone and the man he meant to rescue is dead. Undeterred, Deadpool reacts with his characteristic irreverence and fourth-wall-breaking commentary.

The short plays on Deadpool's trademark humor, including jokes at the expense of Superman, self-aware asides to the audience and references to the X-Men film Logan, which it originally accompanied. It was filmed in December 2016 and was kept secret until its release.

No Good Deed was first shown in cinemas in March 2017 before screenings of Logan, extending that film's running time by several minutes, in place of a traditional post-credits scene, and was later released online. Collider's Chris Cabin described it as dark, funny and a bit punkish, comparing it to a Saturday Night Live sketch, and praised the studio's decision to give fans a taste of what they loved about the first film after director Tim Miller had been replaced by Leitch on the sequel. He also found it clever that the studio managed to keep the short a surprise for general audiences to discover in theaters.

title: Echo Boomers
overview: Five post grads figure the best way to get back at the unfair economy and live the life they've always wanted is to steal from the rich and give to themselves.
plot:
Echo Boomers is a 2020 American crime drama directed by Seth Savoy in his feature directorial debut. Patrick Schwarzenegger, Alex Pettyfer and Michael Shannon star, with Gilles Geary, Oliver Cooper, Hayley Law and Lesley Ann Warren in supporting roles. Set largely in Chicago, the film frames its heist story as a commentary on a generation of college graduates burdened by debt and shut out of the economy.

Lance Zutterland finishes college in the middle of an economic downturn, owing money and with no prospects. He joins Jack and a group of other graduates, led by the charismatic and volatile Ellis and including Stewart, Chandler and Ellis's girlfriend Allie, who make a living robbing the homes of Chicago's wealthiest residents. They work for Mel Donnelly, a fence who pays well for valuable paintings and other goods but only if they arrive undamaged. The thieves see their burglaries as a form of protest against the rich, and they often trash the houses they break into, a habit that puts them at odds with Mel.

To find targets, the group buys expensive suits and poses as financial advisers, meeting affluent clients and getting them to reveal their addresses. Lance grows close to Allie, which provokes Ellis's jealousy and threats. Their luck begins to run out when Chandler is seen during a job and a composite sketch of his face is circulated by police. When the crew learns of a rich man's house containing a vault, they plan their biggest score yet, while Mel tightens his grip on them and warns of what will happen to anyone who talks. Tensions grow after Allie overdoses at a nightclub and Lance defies the others to stay with her, and the fragile loyalties holding the group together begin to crack as the stakes rise.

Critics' reviews were mostly negative, with a 36 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, although audience reactions on the same site were considerably more positive. The Chicago Tribune gave the film three stars out of four, praising its energy, while Common Sense Media awarded it two stars out of five.

overview: A three-person crew on a mission to Mars faces an impossible choice when an unplanned passenger jeopardizes the lives of everyone on board.
plot:
Stowaway is a 2021 science fiction thriller directed by Joe Penna, who co-wrote it with Ryan Morrison. A German and American co-production, it stars Anna Kendrick as the ship's doctor Zoe Levenson, Toni Collette as commander Marina Barnett, Daniel Dae Kim as the biologist David Kim and Shamier Anderson as the stowaway Michael Adams. Netflix, which acquired the rights in December 2020, premiered it on April 22, 2021, in most territories, with a later release in German-speaking countries.

Barnett, Kim and Levenson launch aboard the spacecraft MTS-42 on a two-year mission to a Martian colony. Once in transit, the ship generates artificial gravity by rotating against the spent upper stage of its rocket, linked by long tethers. Soon after launch, Barnett discovers Michael Adams, a launch support engineer, unconscious and injured inside a panel, where he had been trapped by accident. As he falls free, he wrecks the CO2 scrubbing system essential to the crew's survival.

Emergency lithium hydroxide canisters cannot cope with four people, and David's algae experiment, rushed into action as an oxygen source, only partly survives. Mission control can offer no rescue, and the only option, a dangerous climb up the tethers to recover liquid oxygen from the upper stage, is judged too risky. Barnett and David begin to accept that Michael must die, but Zoe persuades them to wait. David eventually tells Michael the truth and offers him a lethal injection, which Michael almost uses before Zoe stops him. When the rest of the algae dies, David agrees to join Zoe on the climb.

The two make the spacewalk and improvise a way to fill two oxygen cylinders, but a solar storm forces them to retreat with only one, which is then lost. They realise that someone must go back out through the lethal radiation to retrieve the cylinder left behind. Barnett must stay to pilot the ship, and since Michael is untrained and both he and David have families, Zoe insists on going. She recovers the oxygen and saves the others, but succumbs to radiation, spending her last moments gazing at the distant red point of Mars.

The film received generally positive reviews, with 76% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, though critics noted pacing problems.

title: The Green Knight
overview: An epic fantasy adventure based on the timeless Arthurian legend, The Green Knight tells the story of Sir Gawain, King Arthur's reckless and headstrong nephew, who embarks on a daring quest to confront the eponymous Green Knight, a gigantic emerald-skinned stranger and tester of men.
plot:
Gawain is awakened on Christmas morning in a brothel by his lover, a commoner woman named Essel. He returns to Camelot, following a scolding by his mother.
Gawain attends a feast at the Round Table with his uncle the King, who invites Gawain to his side. In a tower, his mother performs a magic rite which summons the mysterious Green Knight, who barges into the court as they feast. He states that any knight able to land a blow on him will win his green axe, but must travel to the Green Chapel the following Christmas and receive an equal blow in return. Gawain takes up the challenge. The Knight yields and Gawain, wielding Excalibur, decapitates him. The Knight rises and lifts his severed head, reminds Gawain of the bargain and leaves.
After a year reveling, the King reminds Gawain to uphold his end of the challenge. Gawain departs on horseback for the Green Chapel, taking the green axe and a green girdle made by his mother, who claims that no harm will come to him so long as he wears it.
During his journey, Gawain meets a boy scavenging a battlefield littered with dead warriors. The boy directs Gawain to a stream that will lead him to the Green Chapel. He asks for payment and Gawain gives him a single coin. Shortly afterwards, the boy and two others ambush Gawain and steal the axe, girdle and horse, leaving him tied up. Gawain scrambles to his sword and uses it to cut the ropes binding his hands and pursues them.
By nightfall, Gawain arrives at an abandoned cottage and falls asleep in the bed. He is awakened by the ghost of a young woman named Winifred, who asks Gawain to retrieve her head from a nearby spring. He asks what he will receive in return but is rebuffed. He reunites her skull with her skeletal remains and the next morning finds the axe has been returned to him.
Gawain befriends a red fox who accompanies him on his journey where they see some giants. He reaches a castle inhabited by a Lord who informs him that the Green Chapel is nearby, and Gawain accepts his invitation to stay.
The Lady of the castle, who resembles Essel, makes seductive overtures towards Gawain. The Lord proposes they exchange what he obtains while hunting with whatever Gawain finds at the castle. The next morning, the Lady presents Gawain with the green girdle, which she claims to have made herself. Gawain accedes to her advances in exchange for it. He then flees and encounters the Lord in the forest. The Lord kisses Gawain in return for his Lady's actions, but Gawain does not give him the girdle. The Lord reveals that he has captured Gawain's fox and releases it.
Gawain reaches a stream where a boat is waiting. The fox speaks, imploring Gawain to abandon the quest. Gawain takes the boat to the chapel, where the Knight is seated in hibernation. Gawain waits through the night, and the Green Knight awakens on Christmas morning. As the Knight swings the axe Gawain flinches. The Knight chides him.

title: El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie

overview: In the wake of his dramatic escape from captivity, Jesse Pinkman must come to terms with his past in order to forge some kind of future.
plot:
In a flashback to shortly before they leave Walter White's meth business, Jesse Pinkman asks Mike Ehrmantraut where he would go to start over. Mike says if he were younger, he would go to Alaska, which Jesse finds appealing. Jesse expresses the desire to make amends for past wrongdoing, but Mike warns that starting over would make that impossible.
In the present, Jesse flees the Brotherhood compound in Todd Alquist's El Camino. He goes to the Albuquerque home of Skinny Pete and Badger, who hide the car and give Jesse a place to sleep. The next morning, Jesse calls Old Joe to dispose of the El Camino, but Joe leaves after discovering its LoJack. Pete devises a plan to make it appear Jesse fled after trading the El Camino for Pete's Ford Thunderbird. Pete and Badger give Jesse the money Walter gave them, and Badger drives south in the Thunderbird so it appears Jesse is headed to Mexico. Pete stays with the El Camino and waits for police to respond to the LoJack. Jesse departs in Badger's Pontiac Fiero. He learns from the radio news of Walter's fatal poisoning of a woman, and of Walter's death.
In a flashback to Jesse's captivity, Todd takes Jesse to Todd's apartment to help dispose of his cleaning lady, whom he killed after she discovered his hidden money. They sidestep Lou Schanzer, Todd's busybody neighbor, and bury the corpse in the Painted Desert. Jesse briefly holds the pistol Todd left unsecured, but Todd talks him into returning it.
In the present, Jesse searches Todd's apartment. He finds the new hiding place for Todd's money, but policemen Neil Kandy and Casey enter and begin searching. Jesse hides but holds Casey at gunpoint after Casey finds him. Neil disarms Jesse, who realizes they are not police but thugs also looking for Todd's money. To save himself, Jesse reveals he found the cash. Lou reports finding an old note from Todd, and Casey distracts him by feigning interest. Neil and Jesse bargain over the cash; to avoid alarming neighbors, Neil lets Jesse take a third. As they depart, Jesse recognizes Neil as the welder who built the tether that held him while he was forced to cook meth for the Brotherhood.
Jesse finds Ed Galbraith, the "disappearer," who wants $125,000 to aid Jesse, plus $125,000 for the previous occasion when Jesse hired him but failed to commit. Jesse is $1,800 short and Ed refuses to help. Knowing his parents are being surveilled, Jesse calls them and feigns willingness to surrender. After his parents and the police depart, Jesse sneaks into the Pinkman home and takes two pistols from his father's safe, a Colt Woodsman and an Iver Johnson Hammerless.
Jesse drives to Neil's shop, where Neil, Casey, and three friends celebrate with escorts and cocaine. After the escorts leave, he asks for $1,800, and Neil refuses. Seeing the Woodsman in Jesse's waistband, Neil challenges him to a duel for his share of the cash.

title: Shock Wave 2
overview: After suffering life changing injuries in the line of duty, bomb disposal officer Fung turns his back on the police. But when a devastating series of bombings sweep Hong Kong, the police suspect their former ally may be involved after he is found unconscious at a crime scene. Now faced with memory loss and recalling only fragments of his former life, Fung sets out to uncover the truth and find out who he really is.
plot:
Shock Wave 2 (Chinese: 拆彈專家2) is a 2020 Hong Kong-Chinese action film written and directed by Herman Yau and produced by and starring Andy Lau. A standalone sequel to the 2017 film Shock Wave, it features a new story and characters. Lau plays a former bomb disposal officer who loses his memory after an explosion and becomes the main suspect in a terrorist attack, with Lau Ching-wan, Ni Ni, Tse Kwan-ho and Philip Keung in supporting roles. Production took place in 2019, and the film was released in China and Hong Kong in December 2020.

Poon Sing-fung is an explosive ordnance disposal officer in the Hong Kong Police who loses part of his leg in an explosion during a rescue mission. After rehabilitation and the fitting of a prosthetic leg, he hopes to return to bomb disposal duties, but his superiors refuse, offering him only a training role and fearing that a disabled officer on the front line would damage the force's image. Bitter at this betrayal, he leaves the force. Meanwhile, a terrorist organization called Vendetta, led by Ma Sai-kwan and a mysterious figure known as Blizzard, carries out a bombing at the education bureau.

Months later, Poon is caught on security cameras planting a bomb at a hotel and is knocked unconscious when it explodes. He wakes up in hospital with no memory of recent events and learns he is suspected of being a Vendetta member. Escaping from custody during an interrogation, he sets out to piece together his past and discover whether he really is a terrorist. He is pursued by his old friend Tung Cheuk-man, a counterterrorism chief, and by his former girlfriend Pong Ling, a police officer, who are investigating the bombings and Vendetta's plans involving a mysterious contact called "Davy." As Poon uncovers the truth, the investigation reveals a plot to attack Hong Kong's airport and a planned strike with far more devastating consequences, forcing him to confront the question of where his loyalties lie.

Shock Wave 2 was one of the highest-grossing Chinese-language films of its release period, earning more than US$190 million at the Chinese box office, and it received generally positive reviews for its large-scale action sequences, visual effects and Lau's performance as the embittered former officer.

title: Over the Moon
overview: In this animated musical, a girl builds a rocket ship and blasts off, hoping to meet a mythical moon goddess.
plot:
Over the Moon is a 2020 animated musical fantasy film produced by Pearl Studio and directed by Glen Keane. The movie follows the story of a young Chinese-American girl named Luna, who dreams of reaching the moon to find her missing father.

The film begins with Luna's life in modern-day San Francisco, where she lives with her mother, Mee-Na. Luna is fascinated by the stories of her ancestors and their connections to the moon, which has been a source of inspiration for her. She spends most of her time reading about Chinese mythology and dreaming of reaching the moon.

One day, Luna discovers an ancient scroll that contains a magical map that supposedly leads to the moon. Believing this is her chance to find her missing father, who was on a mission to the moon when he disappeared, Luna sets out on a journey to follow the map.

Along the way, Luna meets a group of misfit creatures from different cultures and backgrounds, each with their own unique abilities and personalities. There's Bao, a Chinese dumpling robot; Noisemakers, a trio of Japanese drums who can create powerful sounds; and Lala, an Indian peacock who can fly.

Together, the group faces various obstacles and challenges as they journey through the sky, encountering fierce storms, treacherous mountains, and even a giant dragon. Along the way, Luna learns valuable lessons about friendship, perseverance, and believing in herself.

As they near their destination, the group discovers that the moon is actually a magical realm filled with wonders and dangers. They meet the Moon Goddess, who reveals that she has been watching over Luna's father and guiding him on his journey.

The group soon realizes that Luna's father was not just searching for the moon but also trying to find a way to bring people together across cultures and borders. The Moon Goddess tells Luna that her father's mission is complete, and it's time for her to take over.

In the end, Luna and her friends successfully reach the moon and help the Moon Goddess restore balance to the universe. Along the way, Luna discovers her own connection to the moon and finds out that she has inherited her father's determination and spirit.

The movie ends with Luna returning home to San Francisco, but not before sharing stories of her incredible journey with her mother and friends. The film concludes on a hopeful note, emphasizing the importance of cultural exchange, understanding, and unity.

Overall, Over the Moon is a heartwarming and visually stunning animated film that celebrates diversity, creativity, and the power of imagination.

title: My Father's Dragon
overview: Struggling to cope after a move to the city with his mother, Elmer runs away in search of Wild Island and a young dragon who waits to be rescued. Elmer’s adventures introduce him to ferocious beasts, a mysterious island and the friendship of a lifetime.
plot:
An unseen older woman tells the story of her father, Elmer Elevator, when he was a kid. He and his mother, Dela, owned a candy shop in a small town, but were forced to close down and move away after the people of the town moved away. They move to faraway Nevergreen City to rent an apartment from a grumpy landlady named Mrs. McClaren. Intended to open a new shop, they eventually lose all the money they saved up while getting by, presumably by three naughty street kids named Callie, Gertie, and Eugene.
Elmer soon befriends a cat and eventually gets the idea to panhandle the money needed for the store, only for his mother to tell him it is now a lost cause. Angered, Elmer runs to the docks to be alone. The Cat comes to him and speaks to him, much to his shock. She tells him that on an island, Wild Island, beyond the city lies a dragon that can probably help him. Elmer takes the task and is transported to the island on a bubbly whale named Soda. Once they make it to Wild Island, Soda explains that a gorilla named Saiwa is using the dragon to keep the island from sinking, but it remains ineffective.
Elmer frees the dragon, a goofball named Boris, who explains that his kind has been saving the island as long as anyone can remember, and after he succeeds, he will be an "After Dragon". However, they discover that Boris cannot fly due to breaking his wing when Elmer saved him, and he reveals that he is afraid of both water and fire. The two make an agreement that Boris will help Elmer raise enough cash to buy a new store and will let the dragon go free once finished, and they go on an adventure in search of a tortoise named Aratuah to find out how Boris can keep the island from sinking for the next century. Along the way, they encounter some of the island's inhabitants, like Cornelius the crocodile, the tiger siblings Sasha and George, and a mother rhinoceros named Iris all while trying to evade Saiwa and his monkey army.
They soon make it to Aratuah's shell, but Elmer finds out that he died, and leaves as the island continues to sink. While resting on a flower, they are found by Saiwa and his forces and Saiwa reveals he knew about Aratuah's death, which angers his macaque 2nd-in-command Kwan, who proceeds to use a giant mushroom as a raft to leave the island. While flying with Boris, Elmer has an epiphany; it is the roots below the island that pull it down. He convinces Boris to fly with all his might and break the roots. Boris breaks two of the roots, but has his own epiphany of how to save the island alone (without Elmer).
Elmer falls into the water but is saved by Saiwa, who is evacuating the island with the other animals. He confronts Elmer for wanting to use Boris, and not truly being a friend. He then reveals that once he found out about Aratuah's death and saw how foolish and frightened Boris was, he knew everyone would drown in fear before the ocean swallowed the island.

title: The Sea Beast
overview: The life of a legendary sea monster hunter is turned upside down when a young girl stows away on his ship.
plot:
For centuries, sea beasts have surfaced to wreak havoc against humankind. In response, crews of "hunters" venture outward on their ships to hunt the beasts. The most famous and successful being the crew of the Inevitable, led by the legendary Captain Crow, his first mate Sarah Sharpe, and his adopted son and boatswain Jacob Holland. The hunters are supported by the King and Queen of the Crown by means of the Three Bridges Society as a result of the hunters' success over the centuries. After nearly being killed during a hunt, Crow tells Jacob he will make him captain once they kill the "Red Bluster", who took his right eye years earlier.
The crew returns to Three Bridges to collect payment for their latest catch, but the King and Queen inform them that they will soon be replaced by the modern naval vessel Imperator, headed by Admiral Eric Hornagold, due to the Crown considering the hunters obsolete and not agreeing with the hunters' code of conduct, especially when Crow's crew was forced to abandon their hunt of the Red Bluster in order to save another hunter ship. This angers Crow and Sarah and nearly results in their arrest before Jacob placates them with a proposal that his crew be given one more chance to kill the Red Bluster as a test of worth. Admiral Hornagold accepts, and the Crown declares a contest between the crews of the Imperator and Inevitable with the winner being allowed to hunt the sea beasts in their name.
After they depart, the crew discovers an orphan girl named Maisie Brumble has stowed away on the ship to join them, having been inspired to do so by her late parents, who were themselves hunters. The Inevitable relocates and attacks the Red Bluster, however, the ship is in danger of being pulled under, and, against Crow's orders, Jacob hesitantly allows Maisie to cut the Bluster free, which saves the crew, but lets the monster escape and throws Jacob and Maisie into the sea. Angered, Crow holds both of them at gunpoint and demands Jacob bring Maisie to him before the Bluster emerges from the depths and swallows Maisie and Jacob whole.
Jacob and Maisie are taken to an isolated island populated by several other sea beasts. Maisie discovers that the Bluster is not malicious and befriends the beast, renaming her Red, while also befriending a smaller beast named Blue. Maisie begins to believe the monsters are really just misunderstood creatures, which Jacob initially denies. Jacob and Maisie convince Red to take them to Rum Pepper Island, so they can secure a ship to return to Three Bridges.
Believing Jacob to be dead, a grieving Crow seeks out the renowned hunter and merchant Gwen Batterbie who gives Crow a poison-tipped harpoon powerful enough to kill Red. While travelling on Red's back, Jacob and Maisie bond with the creature and each other, with Jacob growing to support Maisie's belief that the beasts are innocent. They reach Rum Pepper Island, but discover the Imperator and Hornagold are stationed there.

title: Scooby-Doo! and the Curse of the 13th Ghost

overview: Mystery Inc. withdraws from solving crimes after botching a case. plot:
Scooby-Doo! and the Curse of the 13th Ghost is a 2019 American animated direct-to-video comedy mystery film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and the thirty-second entry in the direct-to-video Scooby-Doo film series. It continues the 1985 series The 13 Ghosts of Scooby-Doo, giving that show's unfinished storyline an ending. The voice cast features Frank Welker as Scooby-Doo and Fred Jones, Grey DeLisle as Daphne Blake, Matthew Lillard as Shaggy Rogers, Kate Micucci as Velma Dinkley, Maurice LaMarche as Vincent Van Ghoul and Bernie Alan, Noshir Dalal as Flim Flam and Nolan North as Asmodeus and Mortifer Quinch.

In a flashback, the young Vincent Van Ghoul and his partner Mortifer Quinch seal the 13th Ghost in the Chest of Demons, but Mortifer is seemingly killed by minion ghosts. In the present, the Mystery Inc. gang catch the costumed "Farmer Morgan" at a shopping mall, only for the sheriff to arrive with the true culprit, scold them for nabbing the wrong suspect and order them to stop solving mysteries. At a garage sale, a customer named Bernie Alan finds a crystal ball that Shaggy and Scooby recognize from their 13 Ghosts adventures, and Van Ghoul then contacts them about the last ghost. Daphne drives everyone in her red van, the Miss-tery Machine, to Van Ghoul's castle, outmaneuvering a phantom car on the way, while Fred, watching her take charge, feels he has lost his role. At the castle they are attacked by the 13th Ghost, the winged demon Asmodeus, and when Shaggy confesses that he shipped the chest to Van Ghoul's Himalayan home, the gang flies there. In the mountains the phantom car sets off an avalanche, and Fred and Velma meet a grown-up Flim Flam, now selling Chest of Demons merchandise before being snatched away. Asmodeus chases the others through a temple until Van Ghoul destroys his crystal ball to transport them to safety. Fred raises the gang's spirits, and after they rescue Van Ghoul, Asmodeus opens the chest, which Velma notes only a living person can do. Unmasked by Daphne, the demon proves to be Mortifer, who faked his death and planned to sell the chest to Flim Flam for $10 million. Bernie reveals himself to be Interpol agent Vance Linklater and arrests him. Velma debunks the earlier ghosts as hallucinations caused by thin Himalayan air.

The film was released on DVD and digital on 5 February 2019. While it follows on from the 1985 series, it retcons most of its events, dropping Scrappy-Doo and the show's supernatural elements.

title: Skylines
tagline: To save our world she must invade theirs.
overview: When a virus threatens to turn the now earth-dwelling friendly alien hybrids against humans, Captain Rose Corley must lead a team of elite mercenaries on a mission to the alien world in order to save what's left of humanity.
plot:
Skylines, also known as Skyline 3, is a 2020 American science fiction action film directed and co-produced by Liam O'Donnell, from a story he developed with Matthew E. Chausse. The third installment in the Skyline series and a sequel to Beyond Skyline (2017), it stars Lindsey Morgan as Rose Corley, with Jonathan Howard as Leon, Daniel Bernhardt as Owens, Rhona Mitra as Dr. Mal, Alexander Siddig as General Radford and James Cosmo as Grant.

Ten years after the first invasion, Rose, a super-powered hybrid, leads Earth's fleet against the Harvesters' mothership, the Armada, orbiting the Moon. Sacrificing a ship and thousands of lives, she destroys it. Guilt-stricken, she disappears as humanity rebuilds alongside billions of Pilots, alien-human hybrids. Five years later, Rose lives in a tent city near the ruins of London, staving off accelerated aging with transfusions from her friend Dr. Mal. A virus begins killing the Pilots while returning them to their brainwashed state. The resistance brings Rose to General Radford, who says only the Armada's core drive, which warped to the Harvester homeworld Cobalt One, can save them.

Rose reluctantly joins the mission. The ship crash-lands on Cobalt One, where the team, including Rose's adoptive brother Trent, finds dead Harvesters and mutations. The Harvester Matriarch briefly controls Rose, whose wartime hesitation was caused by that influence, until Trent frees her. Rose seizes the core drive, but Owens betrays the team, infects Trent and flees with it. Rose and Leon discover that Radford had already bombed the planet with a biological weapon, the same virus ravaging the Pilots, which was meant to euthanize them and wipe out the Harvesters. Radford uses the drive to destroy Cobalt One, but the Matriarch, who has stowed away aboard, kills him. In a wormhole, Owens disintegrates, and Trent knocks the Matriarch to the same fate, losing most of his body. On Earth, Mal and the other residents fight off infected Pilots, losing Grant, until Rose arrives and uses her ship to spread Mal's cure worldwide. Mal transplants Trent's brain into a new body, and Rose sets course for a secret prison where Radford held their father, Mark Corley.

The film premiered at London's FrightFest on October 25, 2020. Vertical Entertainment released it in U.S. theaters and on Apple TV on December 18, 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic. Rotten Tomatoes reported 56% approval from 27 reviews, and Metacritic gave it 46 out of 100.

tagline: An epic Jurassic adventure for the whole family
overview: Speckles, a ferocious tarbosaurus and his young son junior, mourning the loss of their family in an epic battle, roam the lands in search of food, adventure and peace. Under the watchful eye of his dad, Junior is growing up healthy and strong, but with an overconfidence thanks to his young age. After one encounter results in Junior being kidnapped, Speckles embarks on an adventure to the ends of earth to find his son. Encountering friend and foe, ally and enemy, Speckles will stop at nothing and will take on all corners to save his offspring.
plot:
Dino King: Journey to Fire Mountain, also known as Dino King 3D: Journey to Fire Mountain and Speckles the Tarbosaurus 2: The New Paradise, is a 2018 South Korean-Chinese computer-animated action adventure family film written and directed by Han Sang-ho and produced by Chang Hoon Lee. A sequel to The Dino King, it was released in South Korea on December 25, 2018, and in other countries in 2019. The Korean voice cast includes Park Hee-soon, Ra Mi-ran and Kim Sung-kyun, while the English version features Marcello Fabrizi as Speckles, Jacqui Duncan as Junior and Erin Conner as Fang.

In the Late Cretaceous, the battle-scarred Tarbosaurus Speckles is raising his son, Junior, the last of his offspring with his late mate. Junior is kind but timid, and ever since being swept out to sea as a hatchling he has been terrified of water. When Junior freezes during his first hunt and panics in shallow water, Speckles berates him for his cowardice, and the two part in anger. The next day Junior is snatched by a pack of Deinonychus. Speckles gives chase but is knocked into a river, and a storm wipes out the trail. Junior wakes up in a desert compound where many young dinosaurs are being held captive. There he is bullied by a young Therizinosaurus, Slash, but befriended by a young female Tarbosaurus named Blue and a gentle Monoclonius named Dusty, and he learns from a greedy Dsungaripterus that the Deinonychus are offering their prisoners as sacrifices to a mysterious beast that lives in a volcano and gives them to its offspring as playthings. Meanwhile, Speckles sets out across hostile lands to find his son, joined by Cy, a Saichania seeking revenge for the loss of a friend, and Fang, a female Tarbosaurus searching for her missing daughter, who turns out to be Blue. Fang heals Speckles after he is poisoned by giant scorpions, and when the travelers come upon a herd of Pukyongosaurus whose eggs are being raided by Carnotaurus, she persuades the reluctant and single-minded Speckles to help. As father and son each face their fears, they head toward the fire mountain, where the volcano is about to erupt.

Speckles takes his name from the pattern of spotted rosettes on his muzzle and bears three scars on his collar. His journey from a stern, single-minded father who demands bravery into a more understanding parent, and Junior's struggle to find his own courage, form the emotional core of the story.

title: Angela's Christmas
overview: A trip to church with her family on Christmas Eve gives young Angela an extraordinary idea. A heartwarming tale based on a story by Frank McCourt.
plot:
Angela's Christmas is a heartwarming animated film that explores the importance of family, love, and selflessness during the holiday season. The story revolves around Angela, a young girl who sets out to find her long-lost mother on Christmas Eve. Along the way, she meets various characters who teach her valuable lessons about the true meaning of Christmas.

At its core, Angela's Christmas is a film about the power of family and the bonds that tie us together. The movie highlights the importance of being present for one another, especially during the holidays when emotions can run high. Through Angela's journey, we see how love and kindness can bring people together, even in the face of adversity.

The film also explores themes of identity and belonging. Angela's search for her mother serves as a metaphor for finding one's place in the world and understanding where one comes from. As she navigates unfamiliar landscapes and meets new characters, Angela begins to discover more about herself and her family's history.

Furthermore, Angela's Christmas touches on the idea that true happiness comes from within. The movie suggests that it's not the material gifts or external trappings of Christmas that bring joy, but rather the love and connection we share with others. Through Angela's experiences, we see how a sense of purpose and belonging can bring fulfillment and happiness.

Overall, Angela's Christmas is a beautifully crafted film that celebrates the values of family, love, and selflessness during the holiday season. Its themes are timeless and universal, making it a delightful watch for audiences of all ages.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
tagline: From The Streets Of Mumbai...To The Bloody Gold Mines Of Kolar
overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.
plot:
Journalist Anand Ingalagi's controversial book El Dorado, which documents the history of the Kolar Gold Fields (K.G.F.) from 1951 to 2018, is banned by the Government of India. Despite the prohibition, a television news channel obtains a copy and interviews Ingalagi about the events described in the book.
1951, Raja "Rocky" Krishnappa Bairya is born to Shanti, a poverty-stricken and terminally ill woman. On the very same day, government officials, accompanied by crime lord Suryavardhan, arrive in southern Mysore to investigate a strange yellow stone unearthed by labourers digging a well. Upon discovering that the stone is gold ore, Suryavardhan murders the officials and secures a 99-year lease on the land under the pretence of operating a limestone quarry named Narachi. In reality, he secretly establishes K.G.F. and builds a vast criminal empire around its wealth.
To oversee his operations, Suryavardhan appoints five trusted associates: his ruthless younger brother Adheera, who commands security within K.G.F.; Kamal, the son of Suryavardhan's late associate Bhargav, who supervises the gold refinery in Varca; Rajendra Desai, who manages the transportation of gold shipments; Andrews, who controls gold smuggling along the western coast; and Guru Pandian, leader of the DYSS party, who provides political protection and influence.
After suffering a debilitating stroke, Suryavardhan names his elder son Garuda as the heir to K.G.F., expecting Adheera to remain loyal and support his nephew. However, greed and ambition soon divide the organization, and several of Suryavardhan's associates begin plotting to eliminate Garuda. Adheera eventually attempts to assassinate him but is presumed dead after Garuda retaliates by bombing his vehicle.
Meanwhile, Rocky grows up in the streets of Bombay, driven by a promise he made to his dying mother: to attain immense wealth and power. At the age of ten, he begins working for Shetty, a gold smuggler and subordinate of Andrews, who is locked in a fierce rivalry with Dubai-based crime syndicate leader Inayat Khalil. Over the years, Rocky steadily rises through the ranks and eventually gains control over the arrival of gold shipments along the Bombay coast.
Recognizing Rocky's growing influence and ambition, Andrews offers him complete control of the Bombay underworld in exchange for assassinating Garuda. Rocky accepts the assignment and travels to Bangalore, where a grand ceremony unveiling a statue of Suryavardhan has been organized to lure Garuda out of K.G.F. Desai, Andrews, Kamal, and Andrews' secretary Daya secretly arrange for a pistol to be delivered to Rocky, but the operation fails after Garuda's guards discover the weapon. Garuda later reveals that he replaced his father's statue with one of himself, exposing the conspiracy and asserting his authority.
After witnessing the immense power and fear Garuda commands, Rocky realizes that killing him outside K.G.F. would be nearly impossible.

title: Candyman
overview: Anthony and his partner move into a loft in the now gentrified Cabrini-Green. After a chance encounter with an old-timer exposes Anthony to the true story behind Candyman, he unknowingly opens a door to a complex past that unravels his own sanity and unleashes a terrifying wave of violence.
plot:
Candyman is a 2021 supernatural horror film directed by Nia DaCosta, who wrote the screenplay with Jordan Peele and Win Rosenfeld. A direct sequel to the 1992 film and the fourth entry in the series derived from Clive Barker's short story "The Forbidden", it was produced by Peele's Monkeypaw Productions. Filming took place in Chicago in August and September 2019, and after three pandemic delays Universal released it in the United States on August 27, 2021.

In 1977, a boy at Chicago's Cabrini–Green housing project sees police beat to death Sherman Fields, a hook-handed man wrongly accused of hiding razor blades in candy. In 2019, artist Anthony McCoy, partner of gallery director Brianna Cartwright, hears the story of Helen Lyle, blamed for murders and a baby's abduction at Cabrini–Green decades earlier. There he is stung on the hand by a bee and meets laundromat owner William Burke, the boy who saw Sherman die, who tells him the legend of the Candyman: say the name five times into a mirror and the spirit will appear and kill you. Anthony builds an installation called "Say My Name" around the myth. After a gallery dealer and his girlfriend, then a critic, are murdered, and teenagers are killed after summoning the Candyman, Anthony grows obsessed, painting grisly portraits as the sting spreads over his body.

William explains that the legend began in the 1890s with Daniel Robitaille, an artist mutilated and burned alive after a white client's daughter, his lover, accused him of rape, and that other murdered innocent Black men have since joined the Candyman "hive"; these are the men Anthony has been painting. Anthony learns from his mother, Anne-Marie, that he was the baby taken the night Helen died, and that the killings blamed on Helen were the Candyman's. William, plotting revenge against gentrifiers, kidnaps Brianna, cuts off Anthony's hand, fits him with a hook and calls the police to make him the next martyr. Brianna kills William, but Anthony is shot dead by officers, who then pressure Brianna to back their story. She summons the Candyman in a car mirror; he appears as Anthony, slaughters the police and, taking Robitaille's face, tells her to "tell everyone".

Yahya Abdul-Mateen II plays Anthony, with Teyonah Parris as Brianna and Colman Domingo as William. Tony Todd and Vanessa Williams return. The film earned 84% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and grossed $77.4 million; DaCosta became the first Black female director with a US number one.

title: The Farewell
overview: A headstrong Chinese-American woman returns to China when her beloved grandmother is given a terminal diagnosis. Billi struggles with her family's decision to keep grandma in the dark about her own illness as they all stage an impromptu wedding to see grandma one last time.
plot:
Aspiring Chinese-American writer Billi maintains a close relationship with her Nai Nai (paternal grandmother) who lives in Changchun, China. After receiving a rejection letter for a Guggenheim Fellowship, she discovers from her parents, Haiyan and Jian, that Nai Nai has been diagnosed with terminal lung cancer, and is predicted to have only a few months left to live.
Through deception and manipulation of medical test results, the diagnosis is kept a secret from Nai Nai herself. She is, instead, falsely told that her recent doctor visits have only revealed benign findings. A wedding for Billi's cousin from Japan, Hao Hao, has been planned in China as an excuse to unite the family to spend what is expected to be one last time with Nai Nai. Fearing Billi will end up exposing the lie to her grandmother, Haiyan and Jian tell her to remain in New York City.
Billi disobeys her parents' orders and flies to Changchun shortly after the rest of the family arrive. She assures her parents that she will not reveal the cancer diagnosis to Nai Nai. Throughout the trip, however, she clashes with the rest of the family over their deliberate dishonesty towards her grandmother. Guilt-ridden, Billi expresses conflicted thoughts with her parents over the Chinese cultural beliefs that result in a family refusing to disclose a life-threatening disease, including the trauma of her grandfather dying without her knowledge after they moved to the United States.
One night, her uncle, Haibin, contends that the lie allows the family to bear the emotional burden of the diagnosis, rather than Nai Nai herself—a practice of collectivism that he acknowledges differs from the individualistic values common in Western culture. Billi later learns that Nai Nai also told a similar lie to her husband up until his death when he was terminally ill.
On the day of the wedding, both Haibin and Hao Hao break down in tears on separate occasions but manage to proceed through the banquet without raising Nai Nai's suspicions. Billi intercepts Nai Nai's medical test results from the hospital and has it altered to reflect a clean bill of health, helping to maintain the lie.
That night, Nai Nai gives Billi a hóngbāo, encouraging her to spend the money as she chooses. Billi admits that she wants to stay in Changchun to spend more time with Nai Nai, but Nai Nai declines, telling her that she needs to live her own life. When Billi reveals the Guggenheim Fellowship rejection to her, Nai Nai encourages Billi to keep an open mind and not get hung up on this failure, "don't be the bull endlessly ramming its horns into the corner of the room." She says that "life is not about what things one does, but more so about how one goes about doing them".
Billi keeps her promise to maintain the lie. She shares a tearful goodbye with Nai Nai as the visiting family members return to their homes in Japan and America.

title: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
original_title: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
tagline: Follow your heart like never before
overview: Lara Jean and Peter have just taken their romance from pretend to officially real when another recipient of one of her love letters enters the picture.
plot:
Now an official couple, Lara Jean Covey and her boyfriend Peter Kavinsky go on their first date together. They go out to dinner, then release a paper lantern into the sky with their initials written on it. During their date, they promise not to break each other's hearts.
Lara Jean is surprised to find that one of her former crushes and letter recipients John Ambrose McClaren has written back. She feels compelled to respond, as the letter was heartfelt. So, she informs Peter about her intention to write back to him.
For their high school's volunteer program, Peter attempts to convince Lara Jean to choose the same program as him and his lacrosse team. However, she opts to volunteer at the Belleview Retirement Home instead, following in the footsteps of her older sister Margot.
On her first day there, Lara Jean meets Stormy, an eccentric old lady whom Margot often mentioned. She also discovers that John Ambrose volunteers at Belleview, so they talk about the love letter she had written to him many years ago. He agrees to let her read the letter as long as she gives it back to him afterward. Lara Jean is unable to stop thinking about their conversation and, in addition, is constantly insecure about her relationship with Peter because she cannot stop comparing herself with her former best friend, and Peter's ex-girlfriend, Gen.
On Valentine's Day, Lara Jean witnesses her classmates being serenaded by special a capella groups and is told that Peter had sent a group to serenade Gen every period, back when they were dating. This increases her insecurity, though she forgets about this when she meets Peter later that day. He gives her a silver heart necklace and reads a poem, which she supposes is original but turns out to be two verses of an Edgar Allan Poe poem. He later apologizes and tells her he wishes he could write something like that for her, as he means everything in the poem.
While volunteering at Belleview, Lara Jean and John Ambrose grow closer and plan to throw a Star Ball party there after discovering old decorations. He appears to be developing feelings for her, who has not told him about her relationship with Peter. Lara Jean and John Ambrose hold a gathering at the treehouse where they used to hang out in middle school.
The goal of the gathering is to dig up a time capsule that they had buried years ago with their friends––including Peter, Gen, Chris, and Peter's best friend, Trevor. During their unpacking, Gen claims that she did not put anything in the time capsule. Sensing Lara Jean and John Ambrose's attraction, a jealous Peter reveals his relationship with her. He later confronts Lara Jean about hiding their relationship from John Ambrose, but they reconcile soon after.
The next day, Lara Jean apologizes to John Ambrose for not telling him about Peter, and then dresses up for Peter's game.

title: The United States vs. Billie Holiday
original_title: The United States vs. Billie Holiday
tagline: Her voice would not be silenced.
overview: Billie Holiday spent much of her career being adored by fans. In the 1940s, the government targeted Holiday in a growing effort to racialize the war on drugs, ultimately aiming to stop her from singing her controversial ballad, "Strange Fruit."
plot:
The United States vs. Billie Holiday is a 2021 biographical drama film that delves into the life of jazz legend Billie Holiday, exploring the complex and tumultuous relationship between her art and the societal norms that sought to constrain it.

At its core, the film grapples with the tension between creative expression and the oppressive forces that sought to silence it. Through Holiday's story, the movie sheds light on the ways in which racism, sexism, and homophobia intersected to limit opportunities for black women artists during the 1940s and 1950s.

The film also examines the theme of identity and how it is shaped by societal expectations. Billie Holiday's struggles with her own identity – as a black woman, an artist, and a survivor of trauma – serve as a powerful metaphor for the search for self in a world that often seeks to define and constrain us.

Furthermore, The United States vs. Billie Holiday touches on the theme of power dynamics, particularly in the context of relationships between artists and their patrons. The film highlights how those in positions of power can exploit and manipulate individuals for their own gain, often using guilt, coercion, or manipulation to silence dissenting voices.

Ultimately, the movie presents a powerful exploration of the human spirit's capacity for resilience, creativity, and resistance in the face of adversity. Through Billie Holiday's story, we see a woman who refused to be silenced, who used her art as a form of protest and defiance against the systems that sought to hold her back.

The film is a testament to the enduring power of art to challenge societal norms, to subvert expectations, and to give voice to those who have been marginalized or silenced.
