title: Palm Springs
overview: When carefree Nyles and reluctant maid of honor Sarah have a chance encounter at a Palm Springs wedding, things get complicated when they find themselves unable to escape the venue, themselves, or each other.
plot:
On November 9, in Palm Springs, Nyles wakes up and fails to consummate sex with his girlfriend Misty. That evening, Nyles attends a wedding reception for Tala and Abe. There, he bonds with the maid of honor, Tala's depressed half-sister Sarah.
Nyles and Sarah leave the party to have sex in the nearby desert. As he undresses, Nyles is hit by an arrow shot by an assailant, then he crawls into a cave, warning Sarah not to follow him. Concerned for Nyles, she follows him and is sucked into a vortex.
Sarah wakes up and realizes that it is November 9 again. She confronts Nyles, and he explains that by following him into the cave, Sarah has become stuck in a time loop with him; falling asleep or dying resets the loop, repeating November 9. Nyles reveals that the man who shot him, Roy, is from the wedding and that Nyles inadvertently trapped him in the time loop.
For revenge, Roy sometimes hunts down Nyles, as he enjoys putting him through pain even though his "deaths" are only temporary. Sarah tries various methods to escape the loop, but is unsuccessful. Nyles, having already been in the loop for a long time, has become complacent and carefree, abandoning hope of escape.
Sarah resigns herself to her fate and adopts Nyles' carefree and reckless lifestyle. Nyles and Sarah become close. They begin to look forward to their days together, where they are free to do anything without consequence.
One night, Nyles and Sarah camp out in the desert, get high, and have sex. The day after, Sarah sleeps in and is woken up by Abe, with whom she had sex on November 8, the night before the wedding. Guilt-ridden, Sarah refuses to talk to Nyles about their previous night, expressing nihilism about their life in the loop.
After being pulled over by Roy disguised as a cop, Sarah runs him over. She and Nyles argue, leading him to admit that he had sex with Sarah many times in the loop, something he previously lied about. An angry Sarah starts avoiding Nyles.
Nyles feels lost without Sarah and spends days aimlessly moping, discovering Abe and Sarah's affair in the process. One day, Nyles visits Roy at his home in Irvine. Having now experienced a painful injury at the hands of Sarah, Roy realizes what he has put Nyles through, and they reconcile.
Meanwhile, Sarah spends her days studying to become an expert in quantum physics and general relativity. After some experimentation, she believes that exploding oneself in the cave will break the time loop. Sarah offers Nyles a chance to escape with her, but he confesses his love for her and asks if they can stay in the loop together forever. She refuses, resolved to try her escape plan without him.
Sarah attends the wedding one last time, giving a heartfelt speech to Tala, and then travels to the cave with explosives. Nyles has a change of heart, and rushes to the cave to leave with her. He declares that he would rather die with her in an explosion than remain in the loop alone.

title: Tom & Jerry
tagline: Best of enemies. Worst of friends.
overview: Tom the cat and Jerry the mouse get kicked out of their home and relocate to a fancy New York hotel, where a scrappy employee named Kayla will lose her job if she can’t evict Jerry before a high-class wedding at the hotel. Her solution? Hiring Tom to get rid of the pesky mouse.
plot:
Tom and Jerry, released in some territories as Tom & Jerry: The Movie, is a 2021 American live-action/animated comedy film based on William Hanna and Joseph Barbera's cartoon cat and mouse. Directed by Tim Story, written by Kevin Costello and produced by Warner Animation Group, it is the second theatrical film featuring the pair, after Tom and Jerry: The Movie (1992). Chloë Grace Moretz stars as Kayla Forester, with Michael Peña as Terence Mendoza, Colin Jost, Pallavi Sharda, Rob Delaney and Ken Jeong.

Tom, a cat who dreams of being a jazz pianist, busks in Central Park until Jerry, a mouse looking for a new home, exposes him as a fraud. Chasing Jerry, Tom knocks down Kayla, costing her a job. Using a stolen résumé, Kayla is hired at the Royal Gate, Manhattan's fanciest hotel, to help plan the high-profile wedding of celebrities Preeta Mehta and Ben, who arrive with their bulldog, Spike, and cat, Toots. Jerry has moved into the hotel, and his presence threatens the event. Tom finally gets inside and wrecks a room chasing Jerry, and Kayla befriends him; the hotel manager hires Tom to get rid of the mouse, while Kayla's boss, Terence, threatens to fire them if he fails. Tom eventually traps Jerry outside, but Preeta's engagement ring goes missing.

Jerry returns with the ring and offers it to Kayla in exchange for being allowed to stay. A chase involving Spike, Tom and Jerry wrecks the lobby, after which Terence is suspended and Kayla promoted to event manager for recovering the ring. Kayla orders the rivals to spend a day bonding, but their outing ends with both locked in a pound after they interfere with play at a baseball game. A vengeful Terence feeds each of them lies about the other, and their renewed fight wrecks the wedding ceremony and the hotel. Kayla confesses and leaves in disgrace, and Preeta calls off the wedding. Realizing their fault, Tom and Jerry reconcile and persuade Kayla and the hotel staff, including Terence, to stage the wedding in Central Park, where Ben apologizes to Preeta for his extravagant spending. Kayla makes peace with the owner of the résumé, both get jobs at the hotel, and Tom finally performs as a jazz pianist until another mishap restarts the feud.

Filmed at Warner Bros. Studios, Leavesden in 2019, the film opened in U.S. theaters on February 26, 2021, alongside a month of streaming on HBO Max. It grossed $136.5 million worldwide, but reviews were largely negative, with 29% on Rotten Tomatoes and 32 on Metacritic.

title: Below Zero
overview: When a prisoner transfer van is attacked, the cop in charge must fight those inside and outside while dealing with a silent foe: the icy temperatures.
plot:
Below Zero (Spanish: Bajocero) is a 2021 Spanish action thriller directed by Lluís Quílez, who wrote the screenplay with Fernando Navarro. Javier Gutiérrez, Karra Elejalde, Luis Callejo and Patrick Criado lead the cast in a story about police officers whose armored prisoner transport is ambushed by an attacker demanding one of the inmates. Released on Netflix, it was viewed by 47 million accounts in its first month, according to the service.

In a night-time prologue, a wounded man is chased through a forest and, unable to say where a missing woman is, is buried alive by his pursuer. Officer Martín begins a new job driving a prison transport at night with Montesino, a partner who enjoys humiliating the prisoners, and Martín steps in to stop violence. In thick fog the van loses its escort car and radio contact, then hits a spike strip. Montesino goes out and fails to return; Martín finds him seemingly dead and the escort officers killed, is shot in the leg by a sniper and retreats into the prisoners' section. One inmate attacks him, petrol is poured into two cells and set alight, and Martín must open the cells, though one man has already died. A voice on the intercom reveals Martín's gun is empty and urges the prisoners to flee, and the hijacker, Miguel, now driving the van, threatens to kill everyone unless they give up Nano, who swallows the key.

Montesino revives, finds photographs of Miguel's missing daughter in his jeep and gives chase, but dies when he is forced off the road, while the prisoner Rei is killed during the swerving. Miguel drives the van onto a frozen lake and shoots the ice to sink it. Released by Ramis, a prisoner he recognizes from the band at his wedding, Martín escapes with Nano and Ramis, while another inmate dies of the cold. In a nearby village Martín finds Miguel shooting at Nano and learns his motive: Nano and his childhood friend Chino, the man buried in the prologue, raped and tortured Miguel's young daughter to death. Martín struggles with Miguel for the shotgun, refuses to let him kill Nano and shoots Nano in the hand to force a confession, and Nano admits they hid the girl's body in a well on a farm as a rescue helicopter arrives. Afterward, Martín empties his locker and walks away, apparently leaving the police.

Gutiérrez plays Martín, Elejalde plays Miguel, Callejo plays Ramis and Criado plays Nano. The film received favorable notices, with 88% of eight critics on Rotten Tomatoes giving positive reviews.

title: The Tomorrow War
tagline: The fight for tomorrow begins today.
overview: The world is stunned when a group of time travelers arrive from the year 2051 to deliver an urgent message: Thirty years in the future, mankind is losing a global war against a deadly alien species. The only hope for survival is for soldiers and civilians from the present to be transported to the future and join the fight. Among those recruited is high school teacher and family man Dan Forester. Determined to save the world for his young daughter, Dan teams up with a brilliant scientist and his estranged father in a desperate quest to rewrite the fate of the planet.
plot:
The Tomorrow War is a 2021 American military science-fiction action film directed by Chris McKay from a screenplay by Zach Dean, with Chris Pratt in the lead. Paramount Pictures originally planned a theatrical release, but because of the COVID-19 pandemic Amazon Studios acquired the film for around $200 million and released it worldwide on Prime Video on July 2, 2021, making it one of the most expensive films ever to debut on a streaming service.

In December 2022, biology teacher and former Green Beret Dan Forester has just been turned down for a research job when soldiers from 2051 step through a time portal onto the field of the televised World Cup final. They warn that humanity is close to extinction at the hands of alien invaders called Whitespikes. Present-day armies are sent forward in time, but fewer than a fifth survive, so a global draft follows. Dan is conscripted for a seven-day tour and fitted with a vambrace that will pull him back when it ends. He refuses help from his estranged father, James, to escape it, and realizes that the draftees are people known to have died before 2051. Dropped at the wrong coordinates high above Miami Beach, most recruits fall to their deaths, and the survivors recover research data from a dead laboratory team.

At a base in the Dominican Republic, Dan learns that the commander of the operation is his grown daughter, Colonel Muri Forester. Together they capture a rare female Whitespike and develop a toxin against it, but a huge swarm overruns their ocean platform. Before dying, Muri sends Dan back with the toxin. With the portal destroyed, Dan and his wife Emmy use volcanic ash found on a Whitespike claw to conclude that the creatures were already on Earth, buried in ice. James helps him lead a small team to Severnaya Zemlya in northern Russia, where they find a crashed alien ship whose dormant Whitespikes turn out to be bio-weapons. The team kills them, and Dan and James hunt down an escaped female, averting the war.

The supporting cast includes Yvonne Strahovski, J. K. Simmons, Betty Gilpin, Sam Richardson, Edwin Hodge and Ryan Kiera Armstrong. Reviews were mixed, praising the concept, action and performances of Pratt and Richardson while finding the execution derivative; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 52%. A limited theatrical run in China earned $19.2 million, and a sequel is in development.

title: AINBO: Spirit of the Amazon
overview: An epic journey of a young hero and her Spirit Guides, 'Dillo' a cute and humorous armadillo and "Vaca" a goofy oversized tapir, who embark on a quest to save their home in the spectacular Amazon Rainforest.
plot:
AINBO: Spirit of the Amazon is a 2021 animated adventure film directed by Daniel Robock and produced by Tunche Films. The movie follows the story of Tuki, a young boy who lives with his grandmother, Akira, in the Amazon rainforest.

The beginning of the film sets the tone for the rest of the story, showcasing the beauty and magic of the Amazonian world. Tuki is an orphan who has been living with his grandmother since his parents' death. He spends most of his days exploring the forest and learning about its secrets from Akira. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when a group of loggers, led by the ruthless and cunning hunter, Kanaq, arrive in the forest.

Kanaq's true intentions are revealed as he seeks to capture Tuki, who possesses a special gift - the ability to communicate with animals. The loggers believe that Tuki's powers can be used to control the Amazonian wildlife, allowing them to exploit its resources more easily. Akira tries to protect Tuki, but she is captured by Kanaq and his men.

As Tuki sets out on a journey to rescue his grandmother, he meets a group of animal friends who join him on his quest. There's Aibo, a wise-cracking capuchin monkey; Miko, a gentle giant tapir; and Zazu, a sassy macaw. Together, they face numerous challenges and obstacles as they navigate the treacherous Amazonian landscape.

Throughout their journey, Tuki learns valuable lessons about courage, friendship, and the importance of preserving the natural world. He also discovers more about his own powers and the true extent of his connection to the animals. The film's animation is stunning, bringing the vibrant colors and textures of the Amazon rainforest to life in a way that is both visually stunning and immersive.

As Tuki and his animal friends near Kanaq's camp, they engage in an epic battle to rescue Akira and stop the loggers' destructive plans. In the end, Tuki uses his powers to rally the animals and drive the loggers away, saving the forest and its inhabitants.

The film concludes with Tuki returning home to a hero's welcome, surrounded by his animal friends and the people of the Amazonian community. Akira is reunited with her grandson, and they share a heartwarming moment of reconciliation. The movie ends on a hopeful note, emphasizing the importance of protecting the natural world and preserving its magic for future generations.

AINBO: Spirit of the Amazon is a beautifully animated film that celebrates the beauty and wonder of the Amazon rainforest. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and stunning animation, it's a must-see for fans of adventure films and environmentalism.

title: The Photograph
overview: When famed photographer Christina Eames dies unexpectedly, she leaves her estranged daughter, Mae, hurt, angry and full of questions. When Mae finds a photograph tucked away in a safe-deposit box, she soon finds herself delving into her mother's early life -- an investigation that leads to an unexpected romance with a rising journalist.
plot:
The Photograph is an American romantic drama of 2020 written and directed by Stella Meghie. Issa Rae stars as Mae Morton, with LaKeith Stanfield as the reporter Michael Block, Chanté Adams as Mae's mother Christina Eames in her youth, Y'lan Noel and Rob Morgan as Isaac Jefferson at different ages, Courtney B. Vance as Louis Morton, and Lil Rel Howery and Chelsea Peretti in supporting roles.

In the present, Michael travels to Louisiana to interview Isaac about his life after Hurricane Katrina. A photograph of a young woman, Christina Eames, in Isaac's home intrigues him. Christina, now dead, has left her daughter Mae a safety deposit box containing the same picture and two letters, one for Mae and one to be delivered to her father. Back in New York, Michael seeks out Mae, an assistant curator, who shows him her mother's archives. Attracted to her, he engineers a chance encounter at a French film screening at her gallery, and a first date ends in a kiss. As the romance grows, Michael is offered a job in London and, unsure how to tell her so early in their relationship, begins avoiding her calls.

The story of Christina unfolds in parallel. As a young woman she shares a flirtatious friendship with Isaac and eventually moves in with him, but she longs to become a photographer and, without telling him, takes a bus to New York, where she lands a job as a photographer's assistant. At her mother's funeral, her friend Denise tells her that Isaac has married. Years later Christina returns with the young Mae; when Isaac invites them to dinner with his wife, Christina refuses and weeps after kissing his cheek, a moment Mae never forgets.

In the present, Mae visits Isaac and delivers her mother's letter, which reveals that he is her biological father; he admits he suspected as much but was too afraid to ask. Michael, arriving to finish his article, is surprised to find her there, and after a day together he tells her about London but she says a long-distance relationship is impractical. Preparing a retrospective of Christina's work, Mae finds a video in which her mother wishes she had been better at loving people. Later she invites Michael to a Kendrick Lamar concert, and when they meet in New York she declares her feelings and they resolve to make it work.

Released by Universal Pictures on Valentine's Day 2020, the film grossed $21 million and drew favourable reviews, with 75% on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Abduction
tagline: The clock is ticking for the human race…
overview: A man steps out of a park fountain in Ho Chi Minh City with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he wanders through the city, piecing together clues to his past, he is relentlessly pursued by mysterious figures.
plot:
Abduction, also known as Twilight Zodiac, is a 2019 science fiction action film directed by Ernie Barbarash and written by Mike MacLean, with cinematography by Phil Parmet and music by Marc Vanocur. A China-backed production made by Ace Films, Beijing iQIYI Technology, Pandora Culture & Media and Red Sea Media, with Roger Corman among its producers, it was shot in Vietnam and China and released on 20 March 2019. It stars Scott Adkins as Andrew Quinn, Andy On as Connor and Truong Ngoc Anh as Dr. Anna Pham, with Lily Ji, Aki Aleong, Daniel Whyte, Mike Leeder, Tom Caserto, Brahim Achabbakhe and Jai Day. Tim Man choreographed the fights, and it runs 98 minutes.

Quinn pulls himself out of a park fountain in Ho Chi Minh City, soaking wet and with no clear memory of who he is, only fragmented visions of a rotting labyrinth, cloaked figures who can bend reality and his missing daughter Lucy. He discovers that three days earlier, by his own reckoning, he was in England in 1985, but it is now 2018. Struggling to speak through a severe stammer, he wanders the city and is pursued by mysterious figures. Meanwhile Connor, a former military man working as an assassin for a local Chinese gang boss, wakes to find his wife gone; dismissing what seemed a dream of aliens taking her, he blames a rival gang and goes on the warpath. The psychiatrist Dr. Pham, who treats Quinn, brings the two men together, and they learn that an invisible alien race stationed above the fountain is abducting people with especially strong qi, the life force it needs to return home. The drones serving the aliens can only be stopped by pulling a small robotic spider from their necks. Together the trio set out to rescue the abducted and stop a portal to the aliens' world from opening.

The Blu-ray release included both a director's cut and a producer's cut. Reviews were mixed to positive. Justin Harrison of Birth.Movies.Death. called it shaky but enjoyable, praising Adkins for playing against type as a vulnerable, disoriented hero and the film's eerie atmosphere, while faulting its blunt exposition and familiar characters. Paul Bramhall of City on Fire rated it 7 out of 10, enjoying its goofy premise, Adkins's rare comedic turn, his reunion with On and the fight choreography.

title: The Last Warrior: Root of Evil
overview: Peace and tranquility have set in Belogorie. The evil was defeated and Ivan is now enjoying his well-deserved fame. He is surrounded by his family, friends and small wonders from the modern world that help him lead a comfortable life. Luckily, he has his Magic Sword to cut a gap between the worlds to get some supplies quite regularly. But when an ancient evil rises and the existence of the magic world is put to danger, Ivan has to team up with his old friends and his new rivals. They will set out on a long journey beyond the known world to find a way to defeat the enemies and to return peace to Belogorie.
plot:
The Last Warrior: Root of Evil (Russian: Последний богатырь: Корень зла, literally "The Last Bogatyr: Root of Evil"), also known as The Last Warrior 2, is a 2021 Russian fantasy comedy directed by Dmitry Dyachenko and produced by The Walt Disney Company CIS with the Russian studio Yellow, Black and White. A sequel to The Last Warrior (2017), it continues the story of the meeting between modern Moscow and the magical land of Belogorie, a fairy-tale version of ancient Rus' inhabited by the heroes of Russian folklore. Viktor Khorinyak returns as Ivan Naydenov, with Mila Sivatskaya as Vasilisa, Ekaterina Vilkova, Elena Yakovleva and Konstantin Lavronenko. It was released in Russia on 1 January 2021.

Ivan, a young Muscovite who discovered in the first film that he belongs to Belogorie, now lives there as a hero, or bogatyr. The film opens with a campaign led by Finist the Bright Falcon, the strongest of the heroes, who mocks Ivan for lacking heroic strength. After the band captures a monster that has been attacking cattle and turns out to be the folk character Kolobok, Ivan returns to his mansion, which he has filled with modern technology. Tired of life in ancient Rus', he often uses a magic sword to travel back to modern Moscow and dreams of moving there for good with Vasilisa, who does not share his wish.

When a competition is held in Belogorie to choose the best hero, all the contestants except Finist fail the obstacle course. Annoyed by Finist's jokes and his attempts to flirt with Vasilisa, Ivan decides to take part himself. Before the contest he tries to cross back to Moscow, but the sword's magic has faded and the portal will not open. Where Finist relied on strength and agility, Ivan completes the course through ingenuity. His triumph is cut short when the witches Varvara and Galina arrive to seize a magic treasure from the hero Ilya, setting off a new adventure. Ivan and his companions must journey across Belogorie to confront an ancient evil that threatens both worlds, forging unlikely alliances and learning secrets about the origins of the magical land along the way.

The film was a major box-office success in Russia, becoming one of the highest-grossing Russian films of its year, and it was followed by a third installment, The Last Warrior: A Messenger of Darkness, released later in 2021.

title: The Nutcracker and The Magic Flute
overview: It is New Year’s Eve, and Marie is in for a very unpleasant surprise: her mother is forced to marry against her will to the revolting money lender Mr. Ratter. As a token of proposition, he gives Marie a doll named Nutcracker. A miracle occurs and Marie becomes the same size as her childhood toys, who all come to life. Nutcracker turns out to be Prince George, who has been put under a spell. Marie, George and toy friends travel to the Land of Flowers with a mission to save the world from falling under the control of the rat people.
plot:
The Nutcracker and the Magic Flute (Russian: Shchelkunchik i volshebnaya fleyta) is a 2022 Russian animated Christmas musical fantasy film loosely based on Tchaikovsky's ballet The Nutcracker, mixing in elements of other fairy tales and pieces of classical music. The Russian voice cast includes Fedor Fedotov, Lyubov Aksyonova, Pyotr Ivashchenko, Aleksandr Gudkov and Elena Shulman, and an English-language version was also produced.

Marie, a talented young dancer, lives with her widowed mother in the house left to them by her late father, but the family is weighed down by his unpaid debts. Mr. Ratter, one of her father's former creditors, offers to marry Marie and cancel what they owe. She refuses, but before leaving he presents her with a wooden nutcracker carved in the shape of a soldier. That night, Marie is magically shrunk to the size of her toys, which come to life along with the nutcracker. When a rat attacks them, the soldier, who remembers that his name is George, sets off in pursuit, ignoring the others' warnings, and follows it into a tunnel leading to an underground kingdom. Marie follows him, accompanied by two of her animal toys.

George, it turns out, is a prince, and his kingdom has been overrun by rats able to take on human form. Among them is his stepmother, while his father, the king, one of the few real humans left in the castle, is held prisoner in an enchanted sleep. Marie and George join forces and, after a series of adventures, defeat the rats and free the kingdom. Marie then vanishes and wakes up at home. Believing the whole adventure was a dream, she resigns herself to marrying her creditor to save her family, but the prince arrives in person, announces that he has bought up all of her family's debts from Ratter, and asks Marie to marry him instead.

The soundtrack draws on The Nutcracker and other works by Tchaikovsky, including Swan Lake, as well as pieces by Mozart, Gluck and Brahms; despite its title, the film has little connection to Mozart's opera The Magic Flute, beyond the use of his music.

Reception in English-speaking countries was largely negative. The Guardian was highly critical, Children and Media Australia objected to what it saw as outdated gender roles, and Starburst found its mix of fantasy influences awkward and stilted, though Common Sense Media gave it a middling three stars out of five.

title: Chernobyl: Abyss
overview: The aftermath of a shocking explosion at the Chernobyl nuclear power station made hundreds of people sacrifice their lives to clean up the site of the catastrophe and to successfully prevent an even bigger disaster that could have turned a large part of the European continent into an uninhabitable exclusion zone. This is their story.
plot:
Chernobyl: Abyss (Russian: Чернобыль), also known as Chernobyl 1986, is a Russian disaster film from 2021, directed by and starring Danila Kozlovsky. It tells a fictionalised story of a firefighter who becomes one of the liquidators during the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear disaster. Oksana Akinshina, Filipp Avdeyev, Ravshana Kurkova and Nikolay Kozak co-star.

In 1986, Alexey Karpushin, a 30-year-old firefighter in the city of Pripyat, rekindles a relationship with his former lover Olga Savostina, a local hairdresser, who tells him that he is the father of her ten-year-old son. The romance falls apart when Alexey fails to show up for a picnic with Olga and the boy, and she tells him never to come back. He requests a transfer to Kyiv to start over, but just as he is about to depart, reactor number 4 at the nearby Chernobyl power plant explodes, and he climbs aboard a fire engine heading to the scene instead. He survives the radiation of the first fight against the fire.

As the true scale of the accident emerges, officials realise that an even worse catastrophe looms: the melting core could fall into a huge reservoir of water beneath the reactor, triggering a steam explosion that would hurl radioactive material high into the atmosphere and threaten the whole of Europe. Because Alexey has inspected the passages underneath the reactors, he is an obvious candidate for the near-suicidal mission to drain the reservoir by hand, though he is reluctant. When he learns that his son has been exposed to radiation and could die, he agrees to go on condition that the boy is sent to Switzerland for treatment. The first attempt fails, and his teammate Valera, an engineer, persuades him to try again. During the second, successful attempt Valera becomes trapped and cuts the line linking them so that Alexey can get out, but Alexey refuses to leave him. He is found gravely irradiated and dies in hospital after Olga embraces him. Three months later, his son returns home from his treatment abroad.

Producer Alexander Rodnyansky, who had filmed the aftermath of the disaster himself, sent the script to Kozlovsky in 2015; mindful of the 2019 HBO miniseries, the filmmakers chose to focus on the personal heroism of the liquidators. Central Partnership released the film in Russia on 15 April 2021, and it reached Netflix in July. Critics were divided: CBC News called it a missed opportunity that downplayed Soviet cover-ups, while the NME described it as a classic disaster movie.

title: Love and Monsters
overview: Seven years since the Monsterpocalypse began, Joel Dawson has been living underground in order to survive. But after reconnecting over radio with his high school girlfriend Aimee, Joel decides to venture out to reunite with her, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way.
plot:
Love and Monsters is a 2020 American post-apocalyptic romantic comedy film directed by Michael Matthews and written by Matthew Robinson. The movie stars Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, and Mike Epps.

In the beginning of the story, we see a world that has been devastated by an alien invasion known as "The Monster". This event occurred about 20 years ago, when a massive spaceship descended upon Earth, destroying most of the planet's cities. The aliens, who are referred to as "Monsters", have taken over and are now living among humans.

The story follows Joel (played by Dylan O'Brien), a young man who has grown up in this new world. He is a survivor who lives on his own terms, scavenging for food and supplies in the ruins of civilization. Joel's life takes a dramatic turn when he meets Aimee (played by Jessica Henwick), a strong-willed and independent woman who shares his desire to survive.

As they navigate this treacherous world together, Joel and Aimee develop feelings for each other. However, their budding romance is put to the test when Joel discovers that Aimee has been hiding a secret: she is pregnant with a child. This revelation sets off a chain of events as Joel must confront his own fears and insecurities about becoming a father in this harsh new world.

Meanwhile, a mysterious figure known as "The Monster" (played by Mike Epps) emerges from the shadows. The Monster is an alien who has been living among humans for years, disguising himself as one of them. He becomes a key player in Joel's journey, offering guidance and support as he navigates his new role as a father.

As the story unfolds, Joel and Aimee must confront the dangers of their world head-on. They face off against hostile creatures, including giant spiders and other monstrous beings that roam the ruins of civilization. Along the way, they discover hidden strengths and weaknesses within themselves, learning to rely on each other in order to survive.

In the end, Joel and Aimee's love becomes a beacon of hope in a world that has been ravaged by destruction. They find a way to build a new life together, one that is filled with love, laughter, and a sense of purpose. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the darkest of times, there is always the possibility for redemption and renewal.

Overall, Love and Monsters is a heartwarming and action-packed romantic comedy that explores themes of love, survival, and self-discovery. With its talented cast and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for fans of post-apocalyptic fiction and romance.

title: Jiu Jitsu
tagline: From the darkness, the ultimate fighter rises.
overview: Every six years, an ancient order of jiu-jitsu fighters joins forces to battle a vicious race of alien invaders. But when a celebrated war hero goes down in defeat, the fate of the planet and mankind hangs in the balance.
plot:
Jiu-Jitsu is a 2020 martial arts science fiction film directed by William Eubank and written by David Loughran. The movie stars Randy Couture, Scott Adkins, Alina Vasquez, and Jon Foo.

The story begins with a group of mercenaries who are hired to transport a mysterious briefcase from one location to another. Unbeknownst to them, the briefcase contains an alien artifact that has been sent to Earth as part of an intergalactic experiment. The mercenaries soon discover that they have been infected by the alien technology, which slowly transforms them into violent and aggressive creatures.

As the mercenaries begin to turn on each other, a former Marine named Beckett (Scott Adkins) is hired to protect a young girl named Ava (Alina Vasquez), who has been exposed to the alien artifact. Beckett soon discovers that he too has been infected and must fight for survival against his own kind.

The movie takes a turn when Beckett meets a mysterious woman named Lena (Linda Cardellini) who claims to be an expert in the alien technology. Together, they embark on a mission to stop the spread of the infection and find a way to reverse its effects.

As the story unfolds, Beckett and Lena face off against the infected mercenaries, including Beckett's own brother, who has been transformed into a violent and deadly creature. The movie builds up to an intense showdown between Beckett and his brother, with Beckett ultimately emerging victorious.

Throughout the movie, there are several action-packed sequences that showcase the martial arts skills of the characters. The film also explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption as Beckett struggles to come to terms with his own transformation.

In the end, Beckett and Lena succeed in stopping the spread of the infection and finding a way to reverse its effects. However, not before many lives have been lost, including those of Beckett's brother and several other characters. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Beckett and Lena emerging as heroes who have saved humanity from an alien threat.

Overall, Jiu-Jitsu is a thrilling martial arts sci-fi film that combines action, suspense, and drama to create a compelling narrative. With its talented cast and impressive fight choreography, the movie is sure to delight fans of science fiction and martial arts films.

title: The Hater
overview: A duplicitous young man finds success in the dark world of social media smear tactics — but his virtual vitriol soon has violent real-life consequences.
plot:
The Hater (Polish: Sala samobójców. Hejter) is a 2020 Polish social thriller film directed by Jan Komasa and written by Mateusz Pacewicz. Regarded as a sequel or spin-off to Komasa's 2011 film Suicide Room, it centres on an expelled university student from Warsaw who learns to manipulate the internet, unleashing widespread hatred and violence. Maciej Musiałowski stars as Tomasz Giemza, with Vanessa Aleksander as Gabriela "Gabi" Krasucka, Danuta Stenka and Jacek Koman as her parents Zofia and Robert Krasucki, Agata Kulesza as Beata Santorska, Maciej Stuhr as Paweł Rudnicki, Adam Gradowski as Stefan "Guzek" Guzkowski and Jędrzej Wielecki as Staszek Rydel.

Tomasz is caught plagiarizing and thrown out of law school, but he hides his expulsion so that he can keep receiving financial support from the Krasuckis, a progressive, upper-class family who are the parents of his childhood friend Gabi, with whom he is secretly in love and on whom he becomes fixated. When the deception comes to light, he loses the trust of his benefactors. By chance he then finds work at a public relations agency run by Beata Santorska, which turns out to be a fast-growing troll farm. Tomasz proves highly skilled at spreading fake news and online hatred aimed at celebrities, internet personalities and politicians, and his assignment is to run an online campaign against Paweł Rudnicki, a politician whose campaign the Krasuckis actively support. Over time he turns his newly acquired abilities toward the family itself, using them to stalk, harass and ultimately control the Krasuckis. Santorska provides the link to Suicide Room, as she is the mother of Dominik, the protagonist of the earlier film.

Shot in and around Warsaw between October and December 2018, The Hater opened in Polish cinemas on 6 March 2020, only days before theatres closed because of the COVID-19 pandemic, and soon became available online. Netflix streamed it worldwide from 29 July 2020. Critics responded positively, and it holds an 87% Rotten Tomatoes rating, with a consensus noting its contrivances but recommending its ambitious, frenzied style to thriller fans. Reviewers praised its examination of how easily people are manipulated and of polarization in Polish society. The film won the award for Best International Narrative Feature at the Tribeca Film Festival.

title: The Craft: Legacy
overview: An eclectic foursome of aspiring teenage witches get more than they bargained for as they lean into their newfound powers.
plot:
The Craft: Legacy is a 2020 American supernatural horror film written and directed by Zoe Lister-Jones, a legacy sequel to The Craft (1996) produced by Blumhouse. It stars Cailee Spaeny, Gideon Adlon, Lovie Simone and Zoey Luna as four teenage girls who form a coven of witches, with Nicholas Galitzine, Michelle Monaghan and David Duchovny, and a cameo by Fairuza Balk.

Lily Schechner moves to a new town with her mother, Helen, a therapist, to live with Helen's boyfriend Adam Harrison and his three sons. On her first day at school, she is humiliated when she gets her period in class, and when the bully Timmy Andrews taunts her, she telekinetically hurls him into the lockers. Three girls who witness it, Frankie, Tabby and Lourdes, reveal themselves to be witches and invite Lily to complete their coven, which allows them to perform powerful rituals such as freezing time. They cast a spell that makes Timmy kinder, and he becomes their friend, confiding to Lily that he is bisexual and has been with Adam's son Isaiah. After Lily secretly casts a love spell on him and they kiss, Timmy is found dead in an apparent suicide. Horrified by Lily's confession, her friends cut ties with her and bind themselves from using magic.

Uneasy about Adam's authoritarian manner, Lily searches his office and finds her own adoption papers, and Helen reveals that Lily's birth mother is one of her psychiatric patients. When "Helen" later asks Lily to hand over her powers, Lily realizes it is Adam in disguise; he reveals that he belongs to a pagan cult that has coveted her power from the start and knocks her out. In a forest at night, Adam admits that he murdered Timmy and plans to kill her too. Contacted by Timmy's spirit through a Ouija board, the other girls come to her rescue, and the four combine their elemental powers to burn Adam to death. Afterward, the coven reunites, and Helen takes Lily to a psychiatric hospital to meet her birth mother, who turns out to be Nancy Downs.

Sony Pictures released the film on video on demand in the United States on October 28, 2020, with theatrical runs in some international markets. Amid pandemic cinema closures it earned only $2.3 million on an $18 million budget. Reviews were mixed (47% on Rotten Tomatoes, 54 on Metacritic), and it received a GLAAD Media Award nomination.

title: The Pirates: The Last Royal Treasure
overview: A gutsy crew of Joseon pirates and bandits battle stormy waters, puzzling clues and militant rivals in search of royal gold lost at sea.
plot:
The Pirates: The Last Royal Treasure (Korean: Haejeok: Dokkaebi Gitbal, literally "The Pirates: Goblin Flag") is a 2022 South Korean period adventure film directed by Kim Jeong-hoon. A spiritual sequel to the 2014 film The Pirates rather than a direct continuation, it follows a band of pirates hunting for royal treasure that vanished without a trace. Kang Ha-neul and Han Hyo-joo lead an ensemble that includes Lee Kwang-soo, Kwon Sang-woo, Chae Soo-bin, Oh Se-hun, Kim Sung-oh and Park Ji-hwan. Kang was reported to be considering the project in March 2020, Han's casting marked her return to cinema two years after Illang: The Wolf Brigade, and the cast was complete by June 2020, with filming set for July.

The story centers on Woo Moo-chi, the leader of a band of bandits who boasts that he is the finest swordsman in Goryeo, and Hae-rang, the formidable captain of a pirate ship that rules the sea. Thrown together on one ship despite constant clashes, the two and their crews learn that a royal treasure, lost without a trace, lies hidden somewhere, and they set off on a perilous voyage in search of the greatest prize of their pirate lives. Their companions include Mak-yi, who dreams of becoming a pirate king; Hae-geum, a born swindler; the expert archer Han-goong; and Moo-chi's right-hand man, Kang-seop. They are not alone in their hunt: Bu Heung-soo, a ruthless rebel and traitor prepared to do anything to get what he wants, takes to the sea with his followers, including his subordinate Mangcho, to seize the treasure for himself.

Kang plays Moo-chi and Han plays Hae-rang, with Lee as Mak-yi, Kwon as Bu Heung-soo, Chae as Hae-geum and Oh as Han-goong. Planned for summer 2021 and then for the Chuseok holidays, the release was postponed by the COVID-19 pandemic, and the film finally opened in IMAX and other formats on January 26, 2022, during the Korean New Year holiday. It debuted at number one on 1,703 screens, held the top spot for 14 days and on its eleventh day became the first South Korean film of 2022 to pass one million admissions, ending with about 1.34 million admissions and US$10.31 million. Netflix began streaming it worldwide on March 2, 2022.

Reviews were mostly positive, with 60% approval on Rotten Tomatoes. MK Sports praised the cast and called the story predictable but never dull, Cine21 singled out its combination of naval and land battles and the three-way action between Kang, Han and Kwon, and Decider called Han a revelation as Hae-rang.

title: Fear Street: 1994
overview: After a series of brutal slayings, a teen and her friends take on an evil force that's plagued their notorious town for centuries.
plot:
Fear Street: 1994 is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by Leigh Janiak and written by Phil Graziadei. The movie is based on the first book in R.L. Stine's popular Fear Street series.

The story takes place in Shadyside, Ohio, where three high school students - Sam (Mia Goth), Deena (Jordana Brewster), and Margot (Zoey Deutch) - are struggling to cope with their respective traumas. Sam is haunted by a dark presence from her past, while Deena is dealing with the aftermath of a tragic accident that took the life of her best friend. Margot, on the other hand, is trying to navigate her complicated relationships with her friends and family.

The three girls meet at a local diner, where they share their stories and form an unlikely bond. They soon discover that Shadyside has a dark history, particularly when it comes to the infamous "Shadyside Slasher" who terrorized the town in 1994.

As the story unfolds, Sam begins to experience strange and terrifying occurrences that seem to be connected to the Shadyside Slasher. She becomes convinced that the killer is still active and is targeting her specifically. Deena and Margot try to help Sam uncover the truth behind the murders, but they soon realize that the lines between reality and myth are blurred.

Throughout the movie, Janiak expertly weaves together elements of horror, mystery, and coming-of-age drama. The film's pacing is relentless, with a steady stream of jump scares and creepy atmosphere that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

As the story reaches its climax, Sam discovers that the Shadyside Slasher was not just a random killer, but a symbol of the town's dark secrets and the trauma that has been buried for decades. The film's final act is both shocking and thought-provoking, leaving viewers to ponder the true nature of evil and the power of female friendship.

Overall, Fear Street: 1994 is a chilling and atmospheric horror film that pays homage to the classic slasher movies of the 1980s while still managing to feel fresh and modern. With its talented cast, clever plot twists, and eerie atmosphere, this movie is sure to delight fans of the genre.

title: Fear Street: 1978
overview: In 1978, two rival groups at Camp Nightwing must band together to solve a terrifying mystery when horrors from their towns' history come alive.
plot:
Fear Street: 1978 is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by Leigh Janiak and written by Phil Graziadei. The movie is based on the first book in R.L. Stine's popular Fear Street series.

The story takes place in Shadyside, Ohio, where three high school students - Casey, Deena, and Emily - are struggling to cope with their respective traumas. Casey (played by Olivia Scott Welch) has just moved back to Shadyside after a traumatic event from her past; Deena (played by Darby Stanchfield) is dealing with the aftermath of a car accident that killed her best friend; and Emily (played by Mckenna Grace) is haunted by visions of a girl who died in a fire at an abandoned house.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the three girls are connected to each other through their shared experiences. They soon discover that they are being stalked by a supernatural entity known as "The Witch" (played by Kathryn Newton), who is responsible for a series of gruesome murders and disappearances in Shadyside.

As the girls delve deeper into the mystery, they uncover a dark secret about Shadyside's history. They learn that the town was founded by a group of settlers who made a pact with a witch to ensure their prosperity. However, this pact came at a terrible cost, and the witch's spirit has been awakened, seeking revenge on the descendants of those who wronged her.

Throughout the movie, the girls face numerous challenges as they try to survive The Witch's attacks. They also uncover clues about the town's history and the identity of the witch, which is revealed to be a woman named Sarah Fier (played by Liana Liberato). Sarah was a member of the original settlement and had made the pact with the witch, but she eventually became consumed by her own darkness.

As the story reaches its climax, Casey, Deena, and Emily discover that they are all connected to Sarah through their families. They also learn that The Witch is not just a supernatural entity, but a manifestation of Sarah's spirit, who is seeking revenge on those who wronged her.

In the end, the girls manage to defeat The Witch by confronting their own traumas and weaknesses. Casey, Deena, and Emily work together to uncover the truth about Shadyside's history and the identity of The Witch, ultimately leading to Sarah's downfall. The movie ends with a sense of closure for the characters, but also leaves room for speculation about what other supernatural threats may be lurking in the shadows.

Overall, Fear Street: 1978 is a thrilling horror movie that pays homage to the classic slasher films of the 1970s and 1980s. With its strong female leads, creepy atmosphere, and shocking plot twists, it's sure to delight fans of the genre.

title: Fear Street: 1666
overview: In 1666, a colonial town is gripped by a hysterical witch-hunt that has deadly consequences for centuries to come, and it's up to teenagers in 1994 to finally put an end to their town's curse, before it's too late.
plot:
Fear Street Part Three: 1666 is a 2021 American supernatural period horror film directed by Leigh Janiak, who wrote it with Phil Graziadei and Kate Trefry, the final chapter of the trilogy based on R. L. Stine's book series, after Part One: 1994 and Part Two: 1978. It stars Kiana Madeira, Ashley Zukerman, Gillian Jacobs, Olivia Scott Welch, Benjamin Flores Jr. and Darrell Britt-Gibson, and its two halves reveal the origin of the curse on the town of Shadyside and its defeat in 1994.

After reuniting Sarah Fier's severed hand with her remains, Deena experiences the events of 1666 through Sarah's eyes in Union, the settlement that would later split into Shadyside and Sunnyvale. Sarah and her friends gather berries from a reclusive widow, where Sarah notices a book of black magic, and at a party she and Hannah Miller kiss, unaware they are being watched. Soon the food and water are poisoned, and pastor Cyrus Miller, acting strangely, murders twelve children, including Sarah's brother, before Solomon Goode kills him. Accused of witchcraft, Hannah is captured while Sarah escapes. Seeking the widow's book to save Hannah, Sarah finds the widow murdered and the book beneath Solomon's house, where he admits that after losing his wife and child he made a pact with the Devil, offering Cyrus for possession in exchange for wealth and power. In their struggle her hand is severed, and she is captured, but at the execution she saves Hannah by declaring herself the witch and swears vengeance on Solomon before she is hanged.

Back in 1994, Deena understands that the Goodes have prospered by repeating the ritual in every generation, dooming Shadyside while Sunnyvale thrives. With Josh, Ziggy and the mall janitor, Martin, she lures Sheriff Nick Goode to the shopping mall and covers him with her blood so that the Shadyside killers turn on him. In the tunnels below, Deena frees the possessed Sam from the curse's grip, and when Nick is overwhelmed by visions of the curse's victims, Deena, guided by Sarah, stabs him in the eye, ending the curse. Life in Shadyside improves, and Deena and Sam picnic at Sarah's grave, though someone steals the widow's book from the tunnels.

It premiered on July 14, 2021, and was released by Netflix on July 16, a week after Part Two. Critics responded favorably, with 89% on Rotten Tomatoes and 68 on Metacritic.

title: Game of Thrones: The Last Watch
original_title: Game of Thrones: The Last Watch
tagline: A farewell to Westeros with the people who built the realm
overview: For a year, acclaimed British filmmaker Jeanie Finlay was embedded on the set of the hit HBO series “Game of Thrones,” chronicling the creation of the show’s most ambitious and complicated season.  Debuting one week after the series 8 finale, GAME OF THRONES: THE LAST WATCH delves deep into the mud and blood to reveal the tears and triumphs involved in the challenge of bringing the fantasy world of Westeros to life in the very real studios, fields and car-parks of Northern Ireland.  Made with unprecedented access, GAME OF THRONES: THE LAST WATCH is an up-close and personal portrait from the trenches of production, following the crew and the cast as they contend with extreme weather, punishing deadlines and an ever-excited fandom hungry for spoilers.  Much more than a “making of” documentary, this is a funny, heartbreaking story, told with wit and intimacy, about the bittersweet pleasures of what it means to create a world – and then have to say goodbye to it.
plot:
Game of Thrones: The Last Watch is a 2019 documentary film directed by Jeanie Finlay that chronicles the making of the eighth and final season of HBO's fantasy series Game of Thrones. Embedded on the production for a year, Finlay followed the work from the first table read to the filming of the last scene, and the film features cast members such as Kit Harington and Emilia Clarke and David Nutter alongside many of the crew members whose work is rarely seen.

Described by HBO as revealing "the tears and triumphs involved in the challenge of bringing the fantasy world of Westeros to life" in the studios, fields and car parks of Northern Ireland, the documentary mixes behind-the-scenes footage with interviews. Rather than concentrating only on the stars and writers, it gives equal attention to production assistants, costume designers, set decorators, caterers and carpenters, revealing the scale of the effort behind the production. It opens with the cast's first reading of the final scripts and closes with the wrap of filming.

HBO approached Finlay, a casual fan of the series, after being impressed by her earlier documentaries such as The Great Hip Hop Hoax (2013) and Orion (2015). After meeting with producers David Benioff, D. B. Weiss, Bernadette Caulfield and Carolyn Strauss, she was given full autonomy and unrestricted access to the set, alternating weeks on the production with work on her documentary Seahorse. The project was kept secret from all but those directly involved, and Finlay received the season's scripts before some of the cast had read them so that she could decide whose reactions to film at the table read. Composer Hannah Peel was commissioned to write the score in late 2017. Filming wrapped alongside the season in July 2018, with more than 950 hours of footage shot over 14 months, and Finlay delivered her final cut two weeks before the season premiered.

Announced in March 2019, the documentary aired on HBO on 26 May 2019, a week after the series finale, and drew 1.63 million viewers on its first broadcast. It received mostly positive reviews, holding 100% on Rotten Tomatoes; Mashable called it "a better ending than the Game of Thrones finale", while IGN praised it as a satisfying coda but wished it had explored the writing process further. Peel received a Primetime Emmy nomination for its music.

title: The Tragedy of Macbeth
overview: Macbeth, the Thane of Glamis, receives a prophecy from a trio of witches that one day he will become King of Scotland. Consumed by ambition and spurred to action by his wife, Macbeth murders his king and takes the throne for himself.
plot:
The Tragedy of Macbeth is a 2021 American film written, directed and produced by Joel Coen, based on William Shakespeare's play Macbeth. It was the first film directed by one of the Coen brothers without the other. Denzel Washington stars as Macbeth and Frances McDormand, who also produced, as Lady Macbeth, with Bertie Carvel, Alex Hassell, Corey Hawkins, Harry Melling, Kathryn Hunter and Brendan Gleeson. Shot in black and white on stylized, minimalist soundstage sets, it premiered at the New York Film Festival in September 2021, received a limited theatrical release from A24 in December and began streaming on Apple TV+ in January 2022.

Returning from battle, where they have led King Duncan's army to victory over the traitorous Thane of Cawdor, the Scottish generals Macbeth and Banquo are met by three witches, all played by Kathryn Hunter. The witches hail Macbeth as the future Thane of Cawdor and as king, and tell Banquo that he will father a line of kings. The first prophecy is quickly fulfilled when Duncan gives Macbeth Cawdor's title, but the king then names his son Malcolm as his heir, an obstacle to Macbeth's ambition.

When Duncan stays at Macbeth's castle, Lady Macbeth persuades her hesitant husband to murder him. She drugs the king's guards, and Macbeth kills Duncan in his sleep, then executes the servants to cover the crime. Malcolm flees to England, and Macbeth becomes king. Haunted by the witches' words about Banquo's descendants, he arranges the murder of Banquo and his son Fleance, but the boy escapes. Increasingly tyrannical and tormented by visions, including the ghost of Banquo, Macbeth seeks out the witches again, who assure him that no man born of woman can harm him and that he is safe until Birnam Wood comes to his castle at Dunsinane. Lady Macbeth descends into guilt-ridden madness, and as Macduff, whose family Macbeth has slaughtered, joins Malcolm's army, the king's reign moves toward its inevitable end. The film gives an expanded role to the nobleman Ross, played by Alex Hassell.

The film received widespread critical acclaim for Coen's direction, Bruno Delbonnel's cinematography, the production design and the performances, particularly those of Washington and Hunter. It received three Academy Award nominations, for Best Actor for Washington, Best Cinematography and Best Production Design.

title: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising
original_title: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ヒーローズ：ライジング
overview: Class 1-A visits Nabu Island where they finally get to do some real hero work. The place is so peaceful that it's more like a vacation … until they're attacked by a villain with an unfathomable Quirk! His power is eerily familiar, and it looks like Shigaraki had a hand in the plan. But with All Might retired and citizens' lives on the line, there's no time for questions. Deku and his friends are the next generation of heroes, and they're the island's only hope.
plot:
My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising is a 2019 Japanese animated superhero film based on an original story featuring the characters of Kōhei Horikoshi's manga My Hero Academia. Produced by Bones and distributed by Toho, the second film in the franchise was directed by Kenji Nagasaki from a script by Yōsuke Kuroda. Daiki Yamashita and Nobuhiko Okamoto lead the voice cast, with Yoshio Inoue as the villain Nine, Mio Imada as Slice, Tomoyo Kurosawa as Mahoro and Yuka Terasaki as Katsuma.

Heroes chase the League of Villains as they transport a life-support capsule, and when Endeavor wrecks their truck, the villains turn out to be clones. The capsule's occupant, Nine, escapes in the crash and rejoins his gang. Experiments by Daruma Ujiko gave Nine a copy of All For One's Quirk, letting him hold several Quirks besides his own weather manipulation, but they also worsened a terminal illness that only a rare cell activation Quirk can cure. Meanwhile, U.A. High's Class 1-A is sent to remote Nabu Island on a work program, where Izuku Midoriya, holder of One For All, and his rival Katsuki Bakugo befriend young Katsuma, who dreams of being a hero, and his protective older sister Mahoro. After stealing the siblings' father's Quirk and finding it incompatible with Nine's blood type, the villains descend on the island, cutting off all escape and communication. Nine discovers that Katsuma has the Quirk he needs and overpowers Izuku and Bakugo, but is forced to withdraw after overusing his abilities. Learning why Katsuma is targeted, the class evacuates the islanders and separates Nine from his followers, defeating them one by one. Nine, boosted by a Quirk-enhancing drug, overwhelms the remaining students and threatens to destroy the island, until Izuku transfers One For All to Bakugo and fights with its remnants, and together they defeat him. As reinforcements arrive, All Might finds that One For All has stayed with Izuku because the transfer was interrupted. Tomura Shigaraki kills the weakened Nine, the class helps repair the island, and Izuku, who like Bakugo has lost the memory of the transfer, assures Katsuma that he too can become a hero.

Released in Japan on December 20, 2019, and in North America on February 26, 2020, the film grossed $30 million worldwide. It received positive reviews, with a 90% Rotten Tomatoes rating. A third film, World Heroes' Mission, followed in 2021.

title: Embattled
overview: The eldest son of a ruthlessly tough MMA champion must fight his way out of the abusive cycle his father has continued.
plot:
Embattled is a 2020 American sports drama film directed by Nick Sarkisov from a screenplay by David McKenna, based on a story by Frank Ragen. Stephen Dorff stars as Cash Boykins, a reigning mixed martial arts champion styled largely after Conor McGregor, with Darren Mann as his son Jett, Elizabeth Reaser as his ex-wife Susan, Colin McKenna, the screenwriter's son, as his younger son Quinn, Donald Faison, Karrueche Tran and Saïd Taghmaoui.

Cash, himself raised by an abusive father, is the WFA lightweight and welterweight champion, a foul-mouthed bruiser who despises any hint of weakness. He abandoned his family after Quinn was born with Williams syndrome, a rare genetic disorder, and he once abused both Susan and Jett. While Cash lives in a luxurious mansion in Birmingham, Alabama, with his new wife, Jade, and their young son, Susan works as a waitress to support her boys, and 18-year-old Jett has become Quinn's devoted caregiver. Jett also wants to become a fighter, and Cash, recently returned to his life, begins training him, but his tough love quickly turns cruel, as when he throws a deliberate cheap shot at his son while sparring in front of the whole gym. Cash openly scorns Quinn and treats him as a son he would rather not have.

Around the main story run subplots about Jett's romance with a classmate, Keaton, and his attempt to set up his mother with Quinn's teacher, Mr. Stewart, a wheelchair-using army veteran. Cash, meanwhile, is fighting the league's power brokers, who deny fighters health insurance and retirement benefits and discourage unionization. Repressed memories of Cash's abuse resurface in Jett as violence, and the tensions finally pit father and son against each other in a pay-per-view bout. The build-up brings press conferences and training with Claude, the only man ever to have beaten Cash, before the two Boykins men settle their history in the cage.

The film was shot in Birmingham from September to November 2018. IFC Films acquired it in July 2020 and released it in theaters and on demand on November 20, 2020; it grossed about $32,000 in the United States and Canada. Reviews were mixed to positive, with a 71% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 56. The Los Angeles Times called it an exciting, scrappy brawler and a moving family drama, while RogerEbert.com's Robert Daniels praised the fight scenes and its critique of fighters' rights but found it clichéd and its message about violence suspect.

title: Brothers by Blood
overview: Peter and Michael, raised on the streets of Philadelphia, are the children of Irish mob members, forever linked by the crimes of their fathers. 30 years later, Michael now runs the criminal organization and lusts for more power, his dangerous antics frequently held in check by his cautious cousin Peter. Haunted by the death of his sister, whose passing destroyed both his parents, Peter is caught between the dreams of childhood and the realities of his life as an enforcer. His only reprieve is a local boxing gym, a sanctuary that is quickly threatened as Michael’s desire for control escalates.
plot:
Brothers by Blood, originally titled The Sound of Philadelphia, is a 2020 crime drama written and directed by the French novelist and filmmaker Jérémie Guez, based on Pete Dexter's 1991 novel Brotherly Love. A Belgian, French and American co-production involving Killer Films, Brookstreet Pictures, Gapbusters and RTBF, it stars Matthias Schoenaerts and Joel Kinnaman, with Maika Monroe, Paul Schneider, Ryan Phillippe, Nicholas Crovetti, Felix Scott, James Nelson-Joyce and Antoni Corone.

In Philadelphia, cousins Peter (Schoenaerts) and Michael (Kinnaman) grew up as the sons of Irish mobsters, bound together by the crimes of their fathers. Thirty years later, Michael leads the family's criminal organization and craves more power, while the cautious Peter, who works as his enforcer, tries to keep his reckless cousin in check. Peter is emotionally numb, still haunted by the death of his sister, which destroyed both his parents; flashbacks with the young Peter (Crovetti) reveal a painful accident, a catatonic mother and a vengeful father (Phillippe). In the opening scene he calmly steps off a rooftop while joking with Michael and their friend Jimmy (Schneider), and survives the fall. His only refuges are a local boxing gym, where he looks out for a young fighter, and Jimmy's sister Grace (Monroe), whose return to the neighborhood hints at romance. As the Italian mob expands its territory, Michael decides to fight back, and other figures urge Peter to rein him in. Torn between loyalty and self-preservation, Peter is drawn toward an inevitable confrontation with his cousin. Guez keeps most of the violence off screen, using long takes and an understated ending that departs from the novel.

Schoenaerts was cast in 2018 for a shoot planned in Philadelphia, and Kinnaman, Phillippe, Schneider and Monroe joined in early 2019; filming began in New York in March 2019. A premiere planned at the Tribeca Film Festival in April 2020 was cancelled because of the pandemic, and the film instead premiered at the Deauville American Film Festival on 8 September 2020. Vertical Entertainment acquired US rights, retitled it and released it on 22 January 2021. Reviews were largely negative, with 25% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 41; Variety praised the brooding, Method-style performances of the two leads but found the slow, oblique storytelling hard to follow.

title: My Spy
overview: A hardened CIA operative finds himself at the mercy of a precocious 9-year-old girl, having been sent undercover to surveil her family.
plot:
My Spy is a 2020 American action comedy film produced and directed by Peter Segal from a screenplay by Jon and Erich Hoeber. It stars Dave Bautista as a CIA operative who falls under the control of a precocious nine-year-old girl, played by Chloe Coleman in her film debut, with Kristen Schaal, Parisa Fitz-Henley and Ken Jeong in supporting roles. Released in Australian cinemas by STX Entertainment in January 2020, it was bought by Amazon Studios after the COVID-19 pandemic closed theaters and premiered on Prime Video in June 2020.

JJ, a former Army Ranger recently recruited by the CIA, wrecks his first big assignment in Pripyat, a plutonium deal between the Russian mafia and a terrorist named Hassan, through sheer lack of subtlety. Even so, his boss David Kim sends him with Bobbi, an eager tech operator who idolizes him, to watch the family of Victor Marquez, a French arms dealer who wants to sell plans for a miniaturized nuclear bomb to Hassan. Victor lost the plans to his brother David, who hid them before Victor murdered him, and the CIA suspects that David's American widow Kate and their daughter Sophie, who have moved back to Wicker Park in Chicago, may unknowingly have them. JJ and Bobbi set up a surveillance post in the family's apartment building, but Sophie quickly finds one of their hidden cameras, traces the signal and confronts them. She blackmails JJ into spending time with her, helping her navigate life at her new school and teaching her the basics of espionage as she struggles to fit in, and she works to bring him and her mother together. The unlikely friendship grows into something like a family, until Kim discovers that JJ has become personally involved with his targets and pulls him off the case, Kate learns the truth about him, and Victor arrives in Chicago to take back the plans, putting Sophie in danger and forcing JJ to prove himself.

The film received mixed reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it has a 49% approval rating based on 127 reviews, with a consensus that it plugs Bautista into the "charismatic action star meets cute kid" formula with generally painless but mediocre results, and Metacritic gives it a score of 46 out of 100. A sequel, The Eternal City, was released in July 2024.

title: Dragon Quest: Your Story
original_title: ドラゴンクエスト ユア・ストーリー
overview: Luca follows in his father's footsteps to rescue his mother from evil Ladja. Finding the heavenly hero who wields the Zenithian sword is his only hope.
plot:
Dragon Quest: Your Story is a 2019 Japanese computer-animated fantasy film based on the Dragon Quest video game series, adapting the storyline of the 1992 game Dragon Quest V. Produced with live-action actors in the voice roles, it features Takeru Satoh, Kasumi Arimura, Haru, Kentaro Sakaguchi and Takayuki Yamada. Toho released it in Japan on August 2, 2019, and Netflix made it available internationally on February 13, 2020. It was the last film scored by series composer Koichi Sugiyama before his death in 2021.

When Queen Mada of Gotha is abducted by monsters, her husband King Pankraz travels the world to rescue her, taking along their young son Luca. On the journey Luca befriends a girl named Bianca and obtains both a Golden Orb and a sabrecat cub he calls Purrcy. After Prince Harry of Coburg is also kidnapped, father and son give chase, but the sinister Bishop Ladja kills Pankraz and enslaves the two boys. Ten years later Luca and Harry escape. Reunited with a grown Purrcy and his father's loyal retainer Sancho, and accompanied by a friendly slime named Gootrude, Luca learns that Ladja seeks to free the demonic Grandmaster Nimzo and needs Mada's Zenithian bloodline to open a portal to the Demon World. Legend says a hero will seal it, and Pankraz believed that hero was Luca.

Luca's quest for the Zenithian Sword takes him to Mostroferrato, where he defeats a monster terrorizing the town and becomes engaged to the nobleman's daughter Nera, before realizing that Bianca is the one he loves. They marry and have a son, Alus, but Ladja turns the couple to stone. Eight years later Alus revives his father and proves to be the true Legendary Hero. In the final battle, as the portal is sealed, the world freezes and a computer virus reveals that Luca is in fact a player immersed in a virtual reality simulation of the game. Gootrude turns out to be an anti-virus program and helps Luca destroy the intruder and restore his adventure.

Before release, fans criticized the casting of famous actors instead of professional voice actors and the decision not to use Akira Toriyama's character designs. After release, the twist ending, which many viewers felt mocked players' attachment to the game, became the focus of fierce backlash among Japanese audiences.

title: Hillbilly Elegy
tagline: Inspired by a true story three generations in the making.
overview: An urgent phone call pulls a Yale Law student back to his Ohio hometown, where he reflects on three generations of family history and his own future.
plot:
Hillbilly Elegy is a 2020 American biographical drama directed by Ron Howard from a screenplay by Vanessa Taylor, based on JD Vance's 2016 memoir, who later became the 50th vice president of the United States. It stars Amy Adams as Vance's mother, Bev, and Glenn Close as his grandmother, Mamaw, with Gabriel Basso as the adult JD, Owen Asztalos as young JD, Haley Bennett as his sister Lindsay, Freida Pinto as his girlfriend Usha, and Bo Hopkins in his final film role as Papaw.

The story moves between two periods. In 2011, JD is a student at Yale Law School, working several jobs to pay his way and hoping to land a summer internship, when his sister calls to say that their mother has overdosed on heroin. He drives back to his hometown of Middletown, Ohio, to deal with the crisis, while trying to make it back in time for a crucial job interview.

Through flashbacks, the film recalls JD's childhood in the late 1990s, as the son of a family with roots in Appalachian Kentucky. His mother, Bev, struggles with addiction and violent mood swings, which bring a series of boyfriends, the loss of her job for stealing pills at work and terrifying outbursts. JD, falling into bad company as a teenager, finds stability when his tough, foul-mouthed grandmother Mamaw takes him in and pushes him to work hard at school and make something of his life. Encouraged by her, he goes on to join the Marine Corps and later college. In the present, JD struggles to find his mother a place in rehab and must decide how much of himself he can give to his family without sacrificing the future he has worked so hard to build.

The film explores poverty, addiction and family loyalty in working-class America, centering on the bond between three generations.

Given a limited theatrical release on November 11, 2020, before streaming on Netflix from November 24, Hillbilly Elegy was poorly received, with 24 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 38. Close received Academy Award, Golden Globe and SAG nominations, and the film was nominated for Best Makeup and Hairstyling, but it also earned three Golden Raspberry nominations.

title: The Menu
overview: A couple travels to a coastal island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.
plot:
The Menu is a 2022 American comedy horror film directed by Mark Mylod and written by Seth Reiss and Will Tracy. It stars Ralph Fiennes as celebrity chef Julian Slowik, Anya Taylor-Joy as Margot, Nicholas Hoult as Tyler and Hong Chau as the maître d' Elsa, with Janet McTeer, Judith Light, Reed Birney and John Leguizamo.

Wealthy foodie Tyler brings his date, Margot, to Hawthorn, an exclusive restaurant on a private island run by Slowik. The other guests include food critic Lillian Bloom and her editor, wealthy regulars Richard and Anne Liebrandt, a faded movie star and his assistant, three businessmen working for Slowik's investor, and Slowik's alcoholic mother. Elsa notes that Margot was not Tyler's original guest. As dinner progresses, the courses become increasingly disturbing: tortillas are laser-etched with each guest's secrets, a sous-chef kills himself, Richard has a finger cut off when he tries to leave, the investor is drowned, and Slowik lets himself be stabbed by an employee he once harassed. The chef announces that everyone, guests and staff alike, will die by the night's end, punished for exploiting or corrupting his art.

Because Margot was not invited, Slowik asks her to choose whether to die with the staff or the guests. She reveals that she is an escort, while Slowik exposes that Tyler knew of the plan and hired her only because Hawthorn does not seat solo diners. Humiliated after cooking a mediocre dish, Tyler hangs himself. Sent to fetch a barrel from the smokehouse, Margot kills Elsa in a struggle, calls for help on a radio and notices a photo of a young, happy Slowik flipping burgers. A rescuing "Coast Guard officer" turns out to be one of the cooks. Margot then complains that she is still hungry and orders a simple cheeseburger and fries, which Slowik joyfully prepares; after one bite she asks for it to go, and he lets her leave. For the s'mores-themed dessert, the guests are dressed as marshmallows and Slowik sets the restaurant ablaze, killing everyone inside. Escaping in the boat, Margot finishes her burger and wipes her mouth with the menu.

The Menu premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 10, 2022, and Searchlight Pictures released it on November 18, 2022, in its widest release ever. It grossed $79.6 million worldwide and received positive reviews (88% on Rotten Tomatoes, 71 on Metacritic), and Fiennes and Taylor-Joy earned Golden Globe nominations.

title: Homecoming: A Film by Beyoncé
overview: This intimate, in-depth look at Beyoncé's celebrated 2018 Coachella performance reveals the emotional road from creative concept to cultural movement.
plot:
Homecoming: A Film by Beyoncé is a 2019 American documentary concert film about Beyoncé's headlining performances at the 2018 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival. Beyoncé wrote, executive-produced and directed the film, co-directing with Ed Burke, through her company Parkwood Entertainment. Running 137 minutes, it was released worldwide by Netflix on 17 April 2019, a day after preview screenings at several historically black colleges and universities, including Howard and Texas Southern, and was accompanied by the surprise release of Homecoming: The Live Album, with 36 live tracks and two new recordings.

Beyoncé had originally been booked to headline Coachella in April 2017 but postponed because of her pregnancy with twins. Playing the rescheduled dates on 14 and 21 April 2018, she became the first Black woman to headline the festival, performing a 26-song set before some 125,000 concertgoers in a show quickly nicknamed "Beychella". The film interweaves footage of both weekends, with their ensemble of dancers and guest appearances by her Destiny's Child bandmates Kelly Rowland and Michelle Williams, her husband Jay-Z and her sister Solange, with behind-the-scenes footage of rehearsals and glimpses of her life, including her pregnancy and her return to performing after giving birth. The show itself pays tribute to the culture of historically black colleges, with a full marching band, majorette dancers, a step show and strolling pledges echoing Black Greek life, and opens with her singing "Lift Every Voice and Sing", often called the Black national anthem. Drawing on Black feminism, it samples Black writers and thinkers such as Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie and Malcolm X. Her mother Tina Knowles recalled worrying that Coachella's largely white audience might not understand a show so steeped in Black culture, to which Beyoncé replied that her platform gave her a responsibility to do what was best for the world rather than what was most popular.

Homecoming received near-universal acclaim, and was widely described as one of the greatest concert films ever made; The Washington Post's Chris Richards called it exactly that, and The Atlantic's Spencer Kornhaber considered it a career-defining document. Nielsen reported that it drew more than a million US viewers on its first day. It won the Grammy Award for Best Music Film and Best Music Documentary at the IDA Documentary Awards, and received six Primetime Emmy nominations.

title: Cinderella
tagline: One shoe to rule them all.
overview: Cinderella, an orphaned girl with an evil stepmother, has big dreams and with the help of her Fabulous Godmother, she perseveres to make them come true.
plot:
Cinderella is a 2021 jukebox musical romantic comedy film written and directed by Kay Cannon, based on Charles Perrault's fairy tale. Singer Camila Cabello makes her acting debut in the title role, alongside Nicholas Galitzine as Prince Robert, Idina Menzel as Cinderella's stepmother, Billy Porter as her fairy godparent, Minnie Driver and Pierce Brosnan. The idea of reinterpreting the story came from James Corden, who produced the film through Fulwell 73. Filming began at Pinewood Studios in February 2020 but was suspended because of the COVID-19 pandemic, resuming in August 2020. It mixes pop and rock hits with several original songs.

Ella is an ambitious young woman whose dream is to open her own shop, Dresses by Ella. Prince Robert catches sight of her in passing, disguises himself as a commoner and finds her trying to sell one of her creations at the market, where after some playful banter he buys the dress for three times its price. He invites her to the royal ball, promising that she will meet guests from around the world who might buy her designs. On the night of the ball, Vivian, who has arranged for Ella to marry a vegetable merchant named Thomas, ruins her dress with ink so that only her own daughters, Malvolia and Narissa, can attend. Ella's fairy godparent, Fab G, comes to the rescue, dressing her in a gown of her own design and a pair of glass shoes and turning mice into footmen and a crate into a carriage. At the ball Ella meets Robert's sister, Princess Gwen, who is wearing the dress he bought, and a visiting queen, Tatiana, who offers to take her around the world as her personal dressmaker. When Robert proposes, Ella hesitates, fearing that marriage will mean giving up a dream that is finally within reach, while Robert, whose lifelong ambition has been to assume the throne, struggles with her answer. As midnight strikes and Ella flees, leaving a glass shoe behind, both of them must decide whether love and personal ambition can coexist.

Cinderella was released in select theaters and on Amazon Prime Video on September 3, 2021, to mixed reviews; it holds a 41% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. According to Screen Engine, it was the most-watched streaming film of its opening weekend.
