title: Jarhead: Law of Return
overview: Major Ronan Jackson, an accomplished fighter pilot for the Israel Defense Forces and son of a U.S. Senator, is shot down while flying through Syrian airspace. After miraculously surviving the crash, Jackson is taken captive by a group of Hezbollah militiamen. A squad of elite soldiers, led by Gunnery Sergeant Dave Torres, risk their own lives in the hopes of saving an ally they've never met.
plot:
Jarhead: Law of Return is a 2019 American war action film written and directed by Don Michael Paul and released direct-to-video by Universal 1440 Entertainment on 1 October 2019. The fourth entry in the series that began with Sam Mendes's Jarhead (2005), it is a largely standalone story that pairs United States Marines with Israeli special forces. The film stars Amaury Nolasco, Devon Sawa, Yael Eitan, Amos Tamam, Robert Patrick and Ben Cross, and was shot in Israel and Bulgaria.

The title refers to Israel's Law of Return, which grants citizenship to Jews from anywhere in the world. Under it, Major Ronan Jackson (Sawa), an American-trained F-16 pilot whose mother was Jewish, has emigrated and flies for the Israeli Air Force. Jackson is also the son of a United States senator (Patrick). After a mission he is shot down over Syria and, having survived the crash, becomes the target of an Iranian-backed militia led by a shadowy and ruthless commander known as the Ghost. Because of who his father is, Washington and Jerusalem agree on a joint operation that officially does not exist: a squad of Marines under Gunnery Sergeant Dave Torres (Nolasco) is teamed with a unit of Israeli commandos and a Mossad agent (Eitan) and sent behind enemy lines to bring Jackson out within 36 hours. While the two teams trade barbs and learn to work together, and a Marine general (Cross) argues the case at headquarters, Jackson evades his pursuers alone, armed only with a pistol, hiding in fields and trying to keep his identity from being discovered. The rescue turns into a running series of firefights that ends in sacrifice for members of the squad.

Reviews were largely negative. Roger Moore of Movie Nation found the firefights routine and the details sloppy, mocking a sequence in which militiamen fire over the sunflowers where Jackson is hiding, and judged the film gory and trigger-happy but cut-rate and unsatisfying, with a tone he likened to propaganda. Darren Lucas of Movies Reviews 101 considered it watchable and noted good chemistry within the squad, but felt it brought nothing new to the rescue-mission genre and offered no truly engaging characters, while also criticising its shaky-camera action.

title: Prescription for Love
overview: Claire’s life as a nurse in a busy hospital is complicated by a supervisor who is intent on making her miserable with tedious and extra tasks. Claire’s only relief is the patients she treats, and even that is not always a picnic. On a rare night off, she attends a dance performance and gets trapped in an elevator with a charming man. There is an instant connection between them, but as they are “rescued” from the elevator, they are pulled away from each other before they can exchange names and numbers.
plot:
Prescription for Love, also presented as Prescription for Love: A Cinderella Story, is a 2019 American romantic television film directed by Brian Brough and written by Brittany Wiscombe, produced by Candlelight Media Group and Silver Peak Productions. It stars Jillian Murray as the nurse Claire Abbott and Trevor Donovan as Dr. Luke Taylor, with Jillian Joy, Charla Bocchicchio, Gary Sivertson, Anne Sward and K. Danor Gerald in supporting roles. It runs 88 minutes and is a contemporary reworking of the Cinderella fairy tale.

Claire is a hard-working nurse at a busy local hospital who truly cares about her patients. Her life at work is made miserable by her supervisor, who lingers at the nurses' station, avoids taking care of patients herself and loads Claire with tedious extra tasks, aided by other "mean girl" nurses who try to make her look bad to the bosses. Her only relief is the patients she treats, and even that is not always easy, since one cranky man has no interest in anything the doctors or nurses do for him. On a rare night off, Claire's roommate Lena, a ballet dancer, gives her a ticket to an evening performance, but on the way Claire becomes trapped in a malfunctioning elevator with a charming man and a waiter. They miss the entire show, spending hours talking, and feel an instant connection, but in the bustle of their rescue they are pulled apart before they can exchange names or numbers. Soon afterwards the hospital's new doctor arrives, and Claire realizes that he is Luke, the man from the elevator. Luke cannot stop thinking about the woman he met that night, yet he fails to recognize her in her nurse's scrubs and, focused on his first days in the job, is brusque with her, while the supervisor reprimands Claire for supposedly making advances towards him. When an evening event is held at the hospital and Claire is assigned to work through it, some of her grateful patients find her a dress and shoes and others volunteer to cover her shift, giving her the chance to attend.

Reviewers treated it as a light, clean, Hallmark-style romance. Rissi JC of RissiWrites found it a darling romance that evoked the Cinderella story without obvious cues, praising Murray as a good Cinderella and a hero who is far from perfect, though she felt the mean-girl subplot went overboard. Patty's 365 Films review liked it, giving it three and a half stars.

title: Clerks III
tagline: They're too old for this shift.
overview: After narrowly surviving a massive heart attack, Randal enlists his old friend Dante to help him make a movie immortalizing their youthful days at the little convenience store that started it all.
plot:
Clerks III is a 2022 American comedy film directed by Kevin Smith and written by Jeff Anderson and Kevin Smith. The movie takes place 20 years after the events of Clerks II.

The story begins with Dante Hicks (Brian O'Halloran), who has just been fired from his job at the Quick Stop convenience store, which is now owned by Randal Graves (Jeff Anderson). Dante is struggling to find a new job and is feeling unfulfilled in life. He decides to take a road trip with his friend Jay (Jason Mewes) to visit their old friend Silent Bob (Kevin Smith), who has just been released from prison.

Upon arrival, they discover that Silent Bob has become a successful businessman and is now the owner of a chain of convenience stores called "Silent Bob's." However, things take a turn when Dante discovers that Randal has been embezzling money from the Quick Stop and has used it to fund his own business ventures.

As Dante navigates this new reality, he also reconnects with other old friends, including Mallory (Jennifer Schwalbach Smith), who is now married to Jay. The group spends their days hanging out at Silent Bob's convenience store, discussing life, love, and everything in between.

Throughout the movie, Kevin Smith pays homage to his previous films, including Clerks II and Mallrats. He also explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and finding one's purpose in life. The film features a mix of humor, heart, and pop culture references that are characteristic of Smith's style.

One of the standout aspects of Clerks III is its cast, which includes many familiar faces from Smith's previous films. The chemistry between the actors is undeniable, and their performances bring depth and nuance to the story.

The movie also features a number of cameos, including appearances by Jason Lee, Ben Affleck, and Marilyn Manson, among others. These cameos add to the film's humor and charm, and help to reinforce its connection to Smith's previous work.

Ultimately, Clerks III is a heartwarming and hilarious exploration of friendship and finding one's place in the world. The movie is full of laughs, pop culture references, and memorable moments that will leave audiences smiling long after the credits roll.

title: A Nun's Curse
overview: A group of travelers are forced to seek shelter inside an abandoned jail where a notorious nun named Sister Monday had once been assigned and was suspected of murdering prisoners.
plot:
A Nun's Curse is a 2020 American supernatural horror film written and directed by Tommy Faircloth and distributed by Uncork'd Entertainment, which released it on 12 May 2020. It stars Felissa Rose as Sister Monday, with Erika Edwards as Ashley-Kae, Kristi Ray as her sister Gabby, Damian Maffei as Gabby's boyfriend Anthony and Gunner Willis as Michael, alongside Michael James Daly, Sean Krumbholz, Jason Vail and Michael Baker. It runs 73 minutes and was promoted with the tagline "She will PREY for you!"

Ashley-Kae, a somewhat odd college student fascinated by history, photography and nuns, has been fixated since childhood on the legend of Sister Monday, a renegade nun once assigned to a jail who was suspected of murdering many of the prisoners in her care, following a suspicious fire that burned a church to the ground, and who vanished before she could be caught. The stories her father told her about the nun terrified her as a child, and she still carries a frightening secret from that time. She sets off for a weekend at her family's vacation cabin with her shallow, bored sister Gabby, Gabby's juvenile, beer-drinking boyfriend Anthony, and Michael, Ashley-Kae's awkward friend who hopes to be more than a friend. When they stop so that Ashley-Kae can photograph an old church, Anthony's car keys go missing, and with no phone signal and a rainstorm rolling in, the group is forced to take shelter for the night in the abandoned jail where Sister Monday once held court. As the four wait out the storm, bickering and joking, the vengeful spirit of the nun begins to pick them off one by one, and the story builds towards a twist.

Reviews were generally favorable. Stuart D. Monroe of Horror DNA found that it subverted the expectations of nunsploitation by avoiding gratuitous blasphemy and nudity, praising its clean, polished look, the chemistry of the cast, Willis's endearing performance and Rose's stern, understated menace, along with a bold turn in its story, though he wished the backstory of the church fire had been developed further. Morbidly Beautiful rated it 3.5 out of 5, calling it a fun, often funny midnight horror film with a creepy atmosphere and bloody deaths that showcased Rose, while noting that its talky middle section lagged.

title: The Main Event
tagline: Big Dreams Need A Little Magic
overview: After discovering a magical mask, an 11-year-old aspiring wrestler enters a competition to become the next WWE superstar by using special powers from a magical mask.
plot:
The Main Event is a 2020 American sports comedy directed by Jay Karas from a screenplay by Larry Postel. Seth Carr stars as Leo, an eleven-year-old who dreams of becoming a WWE wrestler, with Tichina Arnold as his grandmother Denise, Adam Pally as his father Steve and Ken Marino as Frankie Albano; WWE wrestlers Kofi Kingston, The Miz and Sheamus appear as themselves, along with commentators Renee Young and Corey Graves. It was released by Netflix on April 10, 2020.

Leo lives with his father, Steve, and his grandmother Denise, who encourages his love of wrestling, while his mother lives in another city. At school he and his friends are tormented by bullies, and one day, fleeing them on his bike, he hides in a house holding an estate sale, where he finds a box containing a wrestling mask. The man running the sale lets him keep it but asks him not to reveal it to anyone. Leo sees a television advertisement for an upcoming WWE competition and overhears that his father must pay $20,000 on the mortgage or lose the house. When he puts on the mask, it transforms him, deepening his voice, giving him a brash new personality and super strength; online, he reads a legend that only a truly deserving champion can wield its power. Leo overpowers his bullies, impressing Erica, a girl he likes, though he is sent home from school as punishment.

As "Kid Chaos", Leo enters the competition, defeating fellow contender Smooth Operator in the semi-finals to set up a final against the famous wrestler Samson. His new fame pushes away his friends and Erica, and he confides to Denise that he thought the mask would fix everything but things are only getting worse. He apologises to his friends and is forgiven. Before the final, Samson and his manager swap Leo's mask for an ordinary one, and Samson pummels Leo as Steve watches on television and then rushes to the arena. Realising the mask is fake, Leo climbs the cage around the ring and, discovering that Samson is afraid of heights, dares him to look down; Samson faints, and Leo leaps on him to win. Accepting the $50,000 prize, Leo asks that the NXT contract go to Smooth Operator instead, since he is only a child, and WWE promises him a place when he is older. Two weeks later, Leo, confident without the mask, wrestles his bully on the school team as his father cheers him on.

Filmed in Vancouver in mid-2019, the film received mixed reviews, with 29% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 52.

title: The Stronghold
overview: A police brigade working in the dangerous northern neighborhoods of Marseille, where the level of crime is higher than anywhere else in France.
plot:
The Stronghold (French: BAC Nord) is a 2021 French action thriller directed by Cédric Jimenez from a screenplay he wrote with Audrey Diwan. Gilles Lellouche, François Civil and Karim Leklou star as three police officers in Marseille, with Adèle Exarchopoulos, Kenza Fortas and Cyril Lecomte in supporting roles. The story is inspired by a real scandal that shook the anti-crime brigade (brigade anti-criminalité, or BAC) of Marseille's northern districts in 2012. The film premiered out of competition at the 2021 Cannes Film Festival and was released in France by StudioCanal in August 2021.

In 2012, Marseille has one of the highest crime rates in France. Grég Cerva, a veteran officer, and his younger partners Antoine and Yass patrol the city's northern housing projects day and night, making small arrests of street dealers while the drug networks that control the neighborhoods remain untouched. Grég longs to take on the heavily guarded estate that serves as the center of the drug trade, but the area is a fortress run by gangs prepared to kill to defend their territory, and his superiors, bound by politics and the demand for statistics, refuse to give the unit the resources it needs. Every confrontation in the projects leaves the officers outnumbered and humiliated.

The situation changes when a violent incident filmed in the neighborhood attracts media attention, and the brigade's commander gives Grég's team the go-ahead to prepare a major operation. To gather intelligence, Antoine relies on Amel, a young informant who demands payment in hashish rather than money. To keep her cooperation, the officers begin bending the rules, seizing drugs from dealers to pay her. Their raid on the stronghold, a tense and chaotic siege, is hailed as a great success, but soon afterward the officers find themselves accused of corruption by the internal affairs police, and the bonds between the three men and their loyalty to the institution are put to the test.

The film was a box-office success in France and received positive reviews; AlloCiné recorded an average press rating of 3.6 out of 5, with 20 Minutes praising its virtuoso siege sequence and France Info calling it unusually tense. It also sparked political controversy, as some critics accused it of presenting a one-sided view of the police and the northern districts. It received seven nominations at the 47th César Awards, including Best Film, Best Director and Best Actor.

title: Wrath of Man
overview: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.
plot:
Wrath of Man is an action thriller of 2021 directed by Guy Ritchie, who wrote it with Ivan Atkinson and Marn Davies, loosely based on the French film Cash Truck (2004). Reuniting Ritchie with Jason Statham for the first time since Revolver (2005), it stars Statham as a mysterious new armoured-truck guard in Los Angeles, with Holt McCallany as Bullet, Josh Hartnett as Boy Sweat Dave, Jeffrey Donovan as Jackson, Scott Eastwood as Jan, Eddie Marsan as Terry and Andy García in a small role as FBI Agent King.

The story opens with a robbery of a Fortico Security truck that leaves two guards and a bystander dead, and unfolds in four chapters. Five months later, Patrick Hill, known as H, joins Fortico after barely passing his firearms test. When robbers take Bullet hostage during a pickup, H kills them all with chilling precision. FBI agents who question him realise who he really is, but King tells them to leave him alone. Months later, another group of robbers flees the moment they see H, and his colleagues grow suspicious.

The second chapter rewinds to the day of the first robbery. H, a criminal himself, agrees to scout a truck's route with his son Dougie waiting in the car when a different gang hijacks the vehicle nearby; Dougie is shot dead and H is wounded but sees the killer's face. He is in fact Mason Hargreaves, a notorious crime boss, and King gives him a list of suspects, turning a blind eye while H's men work through them. When the hunt fails, his lieutenant Mike guesses that the robbery was an inside job, so H takes a job at Fortico to find the informant; the gang who fled was his own crew, who recognised him. The third chapter reveals the robbers as disgruntled Afghanistan veterans led by their former sergeant Jackson, aided by an inside man who once served under him, with the volatile Jan as the man who shot Dougie. In the last chapter they return on Black Friday weekend to steal close to $180 million from the Fortico depot. Bullet reveals himself as the informant, and the guards are massacred. H kills most of the gang before Bullet shoots him, and Jan then murders Jackson and Bullet and escapes with the money. A phone hidden among the cash leads H to Jan's home, where he shoots him in the same places Dougie was hit, then tells King it is done and walks away.

Delayed by the pandemic, the film opened internationally in April 2021 and grossed $104 million worldwide. Critics found it a fun, action-packed reunion, giving it 67% on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: DC Showcase: Death
overview: Vincent, an artist with unresolved inner demons, meets a mysterious girl who helps him come to terms with his creative legacy… and eventual death.
plot:
In flashbacks, the past of Vincent Omata, a Japanese American man living in Gotham City, is shown.
As a boy, Vincent loves to draw lying on his bedroom floor for hours at a time and dreams of one day becoming an artist. Ignoring his father's criticisms, he enrolls in the fine arts program at Gotham University as an adult. There, his professor deems him not talented enough to succeed and cruelly suggests a career in dentistry instead. Insulted, he drops out and keeps practicing at home. Over time, Vincent's fruitless struggle as an artist causes the deterioration of his relationship, ending in his girlfriend Charlotte walking out on him after six years. Over the years, he still became unsuccessful and toiled at many jobs, but they were all dead ends and still practices at home which is causing havoc on his mental health as he becomes a chain smoker.
In the present, Vincent, now a groundskeeper, is painting the main gate at Arkham Asylum but is fired for his slow pace of work and defiant attitude. He seeks solace in a bar but is tormented by ghosts of his past in the form of fiery demons: his father, his art professor, Charlotte, and his former boss at Arkham that taunt him wherever he goes. At the bar, Vincent encounters a pale woman in black clothes and gothic makeup. Immediately enamored with her, Vincent expresses a desire to paint her portrait, but the woman explains she has to go and exits the bar to meet Pedro, an employee who has collapsed and been taken away by emergency vehicles.
Vincent staggers home to a decrepit apartment that has an easel with a blank canvas and is cluttered with unfinished paintings. He shoots up on the couch and falls into a deep sleep, only waking to the sound of a crash. Vincent looks out his window to find the woman being yelled at by two strangers. Vincent defends her from the window, but when he goes outside to help, he finds her alone, the two people are revealed as victims of the recent car crash outside. The woman offers to see Vincent's work, and he brings her up to his apartment.
Inside, Vincent is shy about his unfinished canvases, and his demons ridicule him. The woman remarks that he is gifted, but there is a spark missing from his work that was lost long ago. Vincent explains about his childhood spent on his bedroom floor drawing, and how it felt like time stopped when he was creating. He again mentions painting her portrait, explaining that he sees something special in her and She graciously agrees to pose for him. As Vincent prepares to paint, the demons tirelessly try to distract him, but he ignores them. While he paints, the demons begin to die, burning out one by one. When he is finished, Vincent is amazed with his work until he realizes that it is still evening, everyone is frozen in their tracks and time has stopped.
It is revealed that the mysterious woman is Death of the Endless and that Vincent died from a heroin overdose hours ago.

title: Spirit Untamed
overview: Lucky Prescott's life is changed forever when she moves from her home in the city to a small frontier town and befriends a wild mustang named Spirit.
plot:
Spirit Untamed is a 2021 American animated adventure drama film produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures. The movie is directed by Karen Gilchrist and written by Sergio Pablos, Carlos Saldanha, and others.

The story follows Spirit (voiced by Isabela Moner), a wild mustang mare who lives in the American West with her mother, Rain (voiced by Jaclyn Henzie). Spirit's life is marked by freedom and adventure, but she begins to feel restless as she grows older. She longs for more than just running free in the open plains.

One day, Spirit meets a young boy named Lucky (voiced by Luke Brandon Wilson), who has been separated from his family during a wagon train journey. Spirit takes pity on Lucky and decides to help him find his way back home. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile Native American tribes, and ruthless horse traders.

As Spirit and Lucky travel together, they develop an unlikely friendship. Spirit learns about the importance of family, loyalty, and trust from Lucky, while Lucky gains a new appreciation for the beauty and power of nature through Spirit's guidance.

However, their journey is threatened by a rival horse trader named Butch (voiced by Timothée Chalamet), who seeks to capture and exploit wild mustangs like Spirit. Butch is determined to add Spirit to his collection, but she refuses to be caught.

As the stakes grow higher, Spirit and Lucky find themselves in a desperate bid for freedom. They use their combined skills and ingenuity to outsmart Butch's men and protect each other from harm.

In the end, Spirit and Lucky successfully evade capture and reach the safety of a nearby sanctuary. However, Spirit realizes that she must make a difficult choice between her love for Lucky and her desire to return to the wild. In a heartwarming conclusion, Spirit decides to stay with Lucky's family, finding a new sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the movie, the animation is stunning, capturing the beauty and majesty of the American West. The voice cast delivers strong performances, bringing depth and emotion to their characters. The story is both thrilling and heartwarming, exploring themes of friendship, loyalty, and self-discovery.

Overall, Spirit Untamed is a captivating animated adventure that celebrates the spirit (pun intended) of the wild mustangs and the power of human connection.

title: Pets United
overview: When Roger (a Robin Hood-esque, stray dog) and Belle (an elegant yet spoilt pet cat) are thrown together amidst the chaos of a robot take-over of their home city, they must push all their preconceptions aside in order to survive, as they embark on a high-stakes, action-packed adventure.
plot:
Pets United is a 2019 animated comedy film written and directed by Reinhard Klooss, a standalone sequel to his 2010 film Animals United. Its English voice cast features Patrick Roche as Roger, a stray blue heeler, Natalie Dormer as Belle, a pampered Siamese cat, Eddie Marsan as Frank Stone and the Mayor, Jeff Burrell as Ronaldo, an Italian-accented poodle, Harvey Friedman as Walter, a pug, and Ian Odle as Sheriff Bill, a robot policeman.

Robo City was created by its mayor to be a clean, crime-free utopia where humans, animals and robots live in harmony: people enjoy a perfect city, pets are pampered by their owners, and robots are programmed to serve them all. The exception is the strays. Roger, a Robin Hood-like dog who long ago lost his owner, has earned a reputation as "the Thief of Robo City", though he steals only what he needs and shares food with other strays in the alleys. One day, while scavenging, he is caught by Belle, who treats him with contempt, and he befriends Bob, a talkative robot built to have feelings. Then the mayor, deciding that Robo City is too perfect for its imperfect inhabitants, uses his robots as an army of enforcers to throw everyone out, turning the city into a ghost town. With no owner to take him out, Roger is left behind, along with a group of pets, Belle among them, whose owners could not collect them before the evacuation. Roger considers the pets spoiled snobs, while they look down on his mangy coat and criminal past, but to survive they must set aside their prejudices and work together to escape robots programmed to destroy anyone left in the city. Their adventures bring them face to face with wild animals from the zoo, a giant spider-like robot and a huge metal-crushing machine called the Jaw. As Roger repeatedly risks himself to save them, the pets come to respect his street-smart survival skills and learn that there is more to life than being pampered, while the ever-optimistic Bob persuades other robots to ignore the mayor's orders, and his armored henchman Boris turns against him. It emerges that Frank Stone is Roger's long-lost owner and that the mayor is his evil cyborg double, and the allies band together to save the city.

The film premiered in China on 8 November 2019 and grossed about $4.4 million worldwide. Netflix added it to its service in the United States on 11 September 2020, and it was panned by critics; Roger Moore of Movie Nation gave it 1.5 stars out of 4.

plot:
How to Train Your Dragon: Homecoming is a 2019 animated short film produced by DreamWorks Animation and directed by Tim Johnson. A holiday special set before the epilogue of How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World (2019), it features the voices of Jay Baruchel as Hiccup, America Ferrera as Astrid, Craig Ferguson as Gobber and Christopher Mintz-Plasse as Fishlegs, with Gerard Butler credited as Stoick. It aired on NBC and was released on DVD on December 3, 2019.

Ten years after the dragons left the Vikings of New Berk to live in the Hidden World, the villagers are preparing to celebrate the winter holiday of Snoggletog. Hiccup and Astrid discover that their young children, Zephyr and Nuffink, have developed a fear of dragons after reading some of Hiccup's late father Stoick's old books, which portray the creatures as monsters. Worried that their children will inherit the same hatred of dragons that their ancestors once held, Astrid suggests reviving the Snoggletog Pageant, a play that tells the story of how Vikings and dragons made peace. Gobber eagerly agrees, seeing it as an opportunity to remind New Berk's youth of Stoick's legacy. He casts himself as Stoick and Tuffnut as Hiccup, while the real Hiccup builds a mechanical costume of Toothless.

Meanwhile, in the Hidden World, Toothless draws a picture of Hiccup and New Berk in the sand for his mate, the Light Fury, and their three children, the Night Lights. Curious, the young dragons secretly fly to New Berk while their parents sleep, and they sneak around the village as the residents prepare for the show. They glimpse Hiccup but retreat when they mistake his Toothless costume for their father. Toothless and the Light Fury race after them in a panic, and when they find their children, the dragon family stays to watch the pageant from a distance.

The performance succeeds in giving the children of New Berk a newfound appreciation for both Stoick and the dragons. Returning home, Hiccup and Astrid find a glowing crystal from the Hidden World and an empty fish bowl, and they run outside in time to see Toothless and his family flying away. Inspired, Astrid proposes that they return the favor by taking their family to visit Toothless in the Hidden World.

Common Sense Media gave the special four stars out of five, calling it a heartwarming addition to the saga. It won Best Animated Special Production at the 47th Annie Awards.

title: Yes Day
tagline: For 24 hours, kids make the rules.
overview: A mom and dad who usually say no decide to say yes to their kids' wildest requests — with a few ground rules — on a whirlwind day of fun and adventure.
plot:
Allison and Carlos Torres are married with three children: Katie, Nando, and Ellie. When they first met, they were adventurous and said yes to everything. However, once having children, they feel they must say no to protect them.
One evening, they are called into a parent-teacher conference at school where they discover Katie and Nando have both submitted homework calling their mom a dictator. Allison expresses frustration that her children perceive her this way and tells Carlos that she feels he makes her play the role of "bad cop" with their children. Mr. Deacon, a school employee and father of six, overhears and shares with them that he maintains order in his house by having a 'yes day' from time to time: one 24-hour period where the parents cannot say no, within reason.
Carlos and Allison present the idea to their family, telling them that if they don't get into trouble, do their chores, and keep their grades up, they can have a yes day as a reward. Katie makes a wager with Allison that if her mom makes it through Yes Day, Katie will go to the music festival Fleek Fest with her mother. If she doesn't make it, Katie will be allowed to go with a friend, Layla. The children eventually manage to earn a yes day and put together a list of five activities for the day. The first three are Ellie dressing her parents in crazy outfits and requesting that they don't look at anything with a screen on it all day, ordering a massive $40 sundae that is free if they can eat it all in 30 minutes (they do), going through a car wash with the windows down, and entering a capture-the-flag competition, where each family member leads a group; the goal is for one team to catch the others, throwing balloons filled with Kool-Aid at their opponents. Allison wins the game for her team, winning the children's approval. Carlos, however, is tempted to drop out of Yes Day, but ultimately decides he can't bear to disappoint his family.
The fourth event is a trip to Six Flags Magic Mountain. When Katie steps away, Allison sees texts on her daughter's phone from Layla indicating she and Katie will be hanging out with older boys at Fleekfest. Allison tells her that the wager is off and she's going to Fleekfest with her, not Layla. Hurt, Katie storms off. In an attempt to win a pink gorilla for Katie as an apology, Allison and Carlos get into a fight with another park-goer and are arrested. The children sneak away. Katie goes to Fleekfest with Layla but quickly becomes uncomfortable being alone with older boys, and her friend abandons her. Nando stages a "nerd party" at the house as the final big event, but it quickly gets out of control when Ellie accidentally sets off a foam explosion inside the house that was meant for the backyard. Meanwhile, Katie's phone dies while trying to contact her siblings and she panics. With help from H.E.R., who is performing at the event, Allison finds Katie and they reconcile. H.E.R. is moved and invites them on stage for a song.

title: Cliff Walkers
overview: In the puppet state of Manchukuo in the 1930s, four Communist party special agents, after returning to China, embark on a secret mission. Sold out by a traitor, the team find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides.
plot:
Cliff Walkers (Chinese: 悬崖之上), released earlier in English as Impasse, is a 2021 Chinese spy thriller directed by Zhang Yimou from a screenplay by Quan Yongxian. Set in the early 1930s in Manchukuo, the puppet state Imperial Japan established in northeastern China, it stars Zhang Yi as Zhang Xianchen, a former journalist turned Communist agent, Qin Hailu as his wife and comrade Wang Yu, Zhu Yawen and Liu Haocun as the young lovers Chu Liang and Xiao Lan, Yu Hewei as Zhou Yi, an agent embedded among the enemy, Ni Dahong as the security chief Gao Bin and Lei Jiayin as a Communist agent turned traitor.

Four agents returning to China from abroad parachute into a snowbound forest outside Harbin on a covert mission code-named Utrennya, Russian for "dawn." Their aim is to extract a former prisoner who can reveal to the world the atrocities committed by the Japanese army, including the human experiments of Unit 731. Prepared to die rather than betray their cause, each carries a suicide pill in a matchbox marked in Russian. On landing they split into two pairs, separating the married couple and the young lovers so that no one is distracted by personal attachment; Xianchen and Yu promise that whichever of them survives will send for their children.

Their mission is compromised from the start. A local contact, broken by electric-shock torture and drugs after witnessing the execution of his comrades, has betrayed the operation, and the people waiting to meet one pair are enemy agents posing as allies. The pair recognize the trap and escape, and the Japanese try to use one team to draw out the other. As the agents make their way through the snowy streets of Harbin, they can never be sure who is working for the enemy, while Zhou Yi works covertly on their behalf from inside the enemy's security apparatus.

Filmed between December 2019 and May 2020 in Xuexiang National Forest Park, with a score by Jo Yeong-wook, the film was released in China and the United States on 30 April 2021 and was selected as China's submission for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. Critics were generally favorable, with an 80% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, which called it stylish and exciting, and a Metacritic score of 64; RogerEbert.com called it one of Zhang's coldest but most alluring films.

title: Holiday Rush
overview: After his sudden firing, a popular radio DJ moves in with his aunt, bringing along his four spoiled children, and a plan to return to the airwaves.
plot:
Holiday Rush is a 2019 American Christmas romantic comedy-drama directed by Leslie Small and written by Sean Dwyer and Greg Cope White. Romany Malco stars as a widowed radio DJ who loses his job just before the holidays, with Sonequa Martin-Green as his producer and friend Roxy, La La Anthony, Deon Cole, Stormi Maya and Tamala Jones. The film was released on Netflix on November 28, 2019.

Rashon "Rush" Williams is the popular host of the leading hip-hop morning show on WMLE, a radio station in Pittsburgh. Since the death of his wife Paula, he has raised their four children, Jamal and his three younger sisters, Mya and the twins Evie and Gabby, with the help of his aunt Jo. Just after Thanksgiving, as Rush and Roxy prepare to propose becoming part owners of the station, their boss Malcolm reveals that WMLE has been bought by the national media company CamCom. A corporate executive, Joss, announces a new pop format and that Rush will be replaced.

At home, the family celebrates Jamal's acceptance into Harvard, and Rush cannot bring himself to admit to the children that he has lost his job and has no savings. When he finally explains that drastic changes are coming, the spoiled children react badly. Roxy suggests that they buy WBQL, a small station where they once worked that has gone off the air, using her retirement savings, and Aunt Jo contributes 45,000 dollars in cash. To raise his share, Rush puts the family's large house up for sale, and they move back into Jo's modest home, where they lived before he became famous.

CamCom pressures Malcolm to stop advertisers from buying airtime on the new station, so Rush and Roxy respond with billboards promoting a commercial-free Christmas, infuriating the corporation. A home video of Paula found among the old decorations brings back painful memories, especially for Jamal.

On the eve of their return to the airwaves, Rush and Roxy admit their feelings for each other over a romantic dinner. The girls are delighted, but Jamal, angry about the family's changed circumstances and convinced that he can no longer afford Harvard, runs away. Rush finds him in his late mother's favourite spot in the park, and Jamal confesses how hard it is to live in the house without her, before accepting his father's new relationship.

Rush promises to find a way to pay for Harvard, finally sells the house at a lower price, and a former WMLE colleague invests in WBQL, allowing it to broadcast over Christmas and beyond.

title: The Addams Family 2
overview: The Addams get tangled up in more wacky adventures and find themselves involved in hilarious run-ins with all sorts of unsuspecting characters.
plot:
The Addams Family 2, also titled The Addams Family 2: Road Trip, is a 2021 animated supernatural black comedy based on Charles Addams's characters and a sequel to The Addams Family (2019). Directed by Greg Tiernan and Conrad Vernon and written by Dan Hernandez, Benji Samit, Ben Queen and Susanna Fogel, it features the voices of Oscar Isaac, Charlize Theron, Chloë Grace Moretz, Nick Kroll, Javon Walton, Wallace Shawn, Snoop Dogg, Bette Midler and Bill Hader.

At a school science fair, Wednesday Addams demonstrates an experiment that uses the DNA of her pet squid Socrates to "improve" Uncle Fester, with the side effect that he slowly begins to mutate. Her work catches the eye of the scientist Cyrus Strange. At home, Gomez fears his children are growing away from him and Morticia and plans a cross-country family vacation. Before they leave, a lawyer named Mr. Mustela claims that Wednesday was switched at birth and may not be an Addams, a claim the parents dismiss.

Pursued by Mustela and a henchman named Pongo, the family travels across the United States, visiting Niagara Falls, Sleepy Hollow, Miami, where Cousin Itt joins them, San Antonio and the Grand Canyon. When Fester recalls juggling newborn babies in the delivery room on the day Wednesday was born, Gomez and Morticia's doubts grow, and Wednesday overhears them. She captures Mustela and learns he works for Cyrus, who suggests he is her real father and invites her to his home in Sausalito. A DNA test on Gomez's hair appears to confirm the claim, and she slips away from the family, followed by Lurch and then the others.

Cyrus reveals he has been trying to create human-animal hybrids and wants to use Wednesday's superior formula. When she refuses to test it on her family, Lurch and Pongo, who knew each other from an asylum, free the Addamses. Cyrus is transformed into a hybrid monster, admits he faked the DNA results, and dies after a fight with Fester, who has fully mutated. Wednesday restores Fester using a necklace containing the family's blood, and the family heads home together.

The film grossed $120 million worldwide but received poor reviews, with 28% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 37.

title: 32 Malasana Street
overview: Malasaña neighborhood, Madrid, Spain, 1976. While political turmoil ravages the streets all over the country, the Olmedo family arrives in the big city and settles into their new apartment. They soon discover that they are not the only ones roaming its corridors.
plot:
32 Malasana Street (Spanish: Malasaña 32) is a 2020 Spanish supernatural horror film directed by Albert Pintó and written by Ramón Campos, Gema R. Neira, Salvador S. Molina and David Orea. Produced by Bambú Producciones with Atresmedia Cine and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures España, it stars Begoña Vargas, Iván Marcos, Bea Segura, Sergio Castellanos and José Luis de Madariaga, with Javier Botet, María Ballesteros and Concha Velasco. It was released in Spain on 17 January 2020.

In 1976, during Spain's transition to democracy after Franco, the Olmedo family moves from the countryside to a large, cheap, old-fashioned apartment at number 32 on Manuela Malasaña Street in Madrid. The household includes Manolo and Candela, her children Pepe, a young man with a stutter, and seventeen-year-old Amparo, five-year-old Rafael and the children's elderly grandfather Fermín, who suffers from dementia. The family hides a secret: Manolo is actually the brother of Candela's husband, who abandoned them, and the couple must conceal their relationship from the conservative society of the time.

While Manolo and Candela start new jobs, the children stay at home, and strange events begin from the first night. One morning, while Rafael is alone, the television switches on by itself and a puppet in the shape of an old woman invites him to play, and the boy vanishes. The police show little interest in the case. Amparo suffers persistent nausea, Pepe exchanges notes across the courtyard with a mysterious woman named Clara, and a terrifying presence, a long-haired old woman, begins to show itself throughout the apartment. After Amparo rescues her traumatized brother from inside a clock, the family flees to a hotel, while Candela seeks the help of a medium. Investigating a clue, Amparo tracks down an elderly woman who once lived in the building and learns the tragic story of its former resident, whose family kept her hidden away because of who she was, and whose restless spirit has developed an obsession with motherhood that now threatens Amparo.

Critical reception was mixed. Pablo Vázquez of Fotogramas gave it three stars, calling it an honest collection of scares, while Eulàlia Iglesias of El Confidencial found it relied on cheap frights. Several reviewers compared it to James Wan's films and to Paco Plaza's Verónica. Made for about 3 million euros, it was released theatrically in Spain by Warner Bros. and later reached international audiences through streaming.

title: Cruel Fixation
overview: A recent widow is glad when her son finds a new friend. But it soon becomes clear that he's after a different type of companionship. Will their attraction be her undoing? And what secrets is hiding?
plot:
Cruel Fixation is a 2019 American psychological thriller television film directed by Damián Romay for Sunshine Films and distributed by MarVista Entertainment. It premiered on the Lifetime network in October 2019 under the title Sinister Seduction. The film stars Kristina Klebe as a widowed mother, Tanner Buchanan as the teenager who insinuates himself into her family, and Sebastian Cabanas as her son, with Carson Rowland, Megan Ashley Brown, Susan Gallagher, Tommi Rose, Keith Hudson and Michael Houston King in supporting roles. It runs about 90 minutes.

Sharon Elliott (Klebe) runs her own real estate business and is raising her teenage son Anthony (Cabanas) alone after the mysterious murder of her husband Mark (King). Since his father's death Anthony has withdrawn from her and become socially isolated, struggling to fit in at school. Sharon is relieved and grateful when Dylan Warren (Buchanan), one of the most popular boys at the school, befriends Anthony and becomes a steadying presence for him. Dylan also becomes a sympathetic listener for Sharon herself, who confides in him about her conflicting feelings toward her late husband: Anthony grieves an idealised version of his father, while Sharon remembers Mark as a self-centred man who was hard to be married to. As Dylan spends more and more time at the house, Sharon begins to suspect that his interest lies with her rather than with her son. She does not realise that she and Dylan are bound by a dark connection from her past, or that his friendship with Anthony is part of a scheme of revenge against her, and she must uncover the truth before it destroys the family she has left.

Writing for Vocal, one Lifetime reviewer saw the film as a variation on one of the channel's most familiar premises, a vulnerable woman letting a secretly dangerous man into her life, but rated it highly for its well-developed characters, the emotionally charged scenes between mother and son, and an ending that avoids the usual Lifetime conventions in favour of a more realistic note. The review singled out Klebe's performance as well as the subtle menace and believable charm Buchanan brings to Dylan. Viewer reactions on IMDb were more divided, with several criticising the script and the supporting performances.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
tagline: Witness the beginning of a new dynasty.
overview: Superhero duo Scott Lang and Hope Van Dyne, together with Hope's parents Hank Pym and Janet Van Dyne, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures, and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought was possible.
plot:
Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania is a 2023 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics characters Scott Lang / Ant-Man and Hope van Dyne / Wasp. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is the sequel to Ant-Man (2015) and Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018) and the 31st film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, opening the franchise's Phase Five. Peyton Reed directed from a screenplay by Jeff Loveness. Paul Rudd and Evangeline Lilly return in the title roles, alongside Jonathan Majors as Kang the Conqueror, Kathryn Newton, David Dastmalchian, Katy O'Brian, William Jackson Harper, Bill Murray, Michelle Pfeiffer, Corey Stoll and Michael Douglas.

Some time after the Avengers' victory over Thanos, Scott is enjoying life as a celebrity and the author of a memoir, living happily with Hope. His teenage daughter Cassie has become an activist helping people displaced by the Blip, which has strained their relationship. During a visit to Hope's parents, Hank Pym and Janet van Dyne, Cassie reveals a device she has built to send signals into the Quantum Realm. Janet, alarmed, tries to switch it off, but the signal has already been received, and a portal pulls all five of them into the subatomic world.

Separated on arrival, Scott and Cassie fall in with a band of native rebels resisting the realm's ruler, while Hope, Hank and Janet travel to a sprawling city where an old acquaintance of Janet's, Lord Krylar, reveals he now serves a conqueror named Kang. Janet is finally forced to admit what she kept secret for decades: during her years trapped in the realm she met Kang, a powerful exiled man who claimed he wanted to escape, and she helped strand him there after discovering his true nature. Kang's forces, led by the cybernetically altered M.O.D.O.K., who turns out to be the former villain Darren Cross, capture Scott and demand his help in retrieving a power source that would let Kang escape and threaten the multiverse.

The film grossed about $476 million worldwide, but it received mixed to negative reviews. Critics praised Majors's menacing performance and Rudd's charm but criticized the visual effects, the script and the film's role as a setup for later Marvel installments rather than a satisfying story on its own.

overview: A group of astronauts living in the haunting emptiness of deep space struggle to cope after Earth suffers an extinction-level event.
plot:
3022 is a 2019 American science fiction film directed by John Suits and starring Omar Epps, Kate Walsh, Miranda Cosgrove and Angus Macfadyen, with Jorja Fox also in the cast. Set aboard a space station in the distant future, it follows a crew that suffers severe psychological strain and considers abandoning its mission after witnessing what appears to be the destruction of Earth. The story is told through a series of flashbacks and flash-forwards.

In 2190, the space station Pangea serves as a refueling stop for ships heading to Europa One, humanity's first space colony, and is staffed by crews serving ten-year shifts. Four American astronauts begin their term: Captain John Laine, engineer Jackie Miller, doctor Richard Valin and Lisa Brown. At first they get along well, and Laine and Miller fall in love, but as the years pass the isolation wears them down; by the fifth year Laine suffers night terrors and Valin is ready to declare the crew mentally unfit to continue. Then a massive explosion sends shockwaves through the station. Brown is gravely injured and later dies, repeated attempts to contact Earth go unanswered, and the station's instruments find only an asteroid field where the planet used to be. Miller, desperate to find her daughter, tries to leave in the station's escape pod, but the pod is lost in the attempt, and the survivors are left with failing life support and dwindling hope. Months later, as Laine and Miller plan a way to stretch their oxygen and Valin sinks into despair, a shuttle drifts past carrying three unconscious astronauts from the International Space Station, led by Captain Diane Ures, played by Fox, with two French crewmates. Their arrival at first renews everyone's spirits, but the extra mouths mean Pangea's resources will run out within a month, and the newcomers carry dark secrets about what they saw and what they did to survive, setting the two crews on a collision course.

The Hollywood Reporter remarked that, considering the obvious budget limitations, the film's special effects and physical production were convincing. In 2020 the film found a new audience during the COVID-19 pandemic, becoming the ninth most popular title overall on Netflix in March of that year.

title: How I Became a Superhero
overview: Paris 2020. While superheroes have assimilated into the Parisian society, they discover a new drug that gives themselves personal superpowers to mere mortals. Lieutenants Moreau and Schaltzmann are investigating the case with the support of two ex-superheroes, Monte Carlo and Callista. They'll do whatever it takes to dismantle the traffic. But Moreau's past resurfaces, and the investigation becomes more complicated.
plot:
How I Became a Super Hero (Comment je suis devenu super-héros) is a 2020 French superhero film co-written and directed by Douglas Attal, adapted from Gérald Bronner's 2007 novel. Produced by Artémis Productions, Trésor Films and Shelter Prod with Warner Bros. France, it stars Pio Marmaï, Vimala Pons, Benoît Poelvoorde, Leïla Bekhti and Swann Arlaud, with Léonie Souchaud, Camille Japy, Gilles Cohen and Clovis Cornillac.

In a version of Paris where people with superpowers are part of everyday life, Lieutenant Gary Moreau (Marmaï), once the police liaison to the disbanded hero team the Royal Pack, investigates super-crimes. Paired with Cécile Schaltzmann (Pons), a newcomer from the financial brigade, he looks into a wave of incidents caused by a drug that grants temporary powers to ordinary people, such as a bullied teenager who takes revenge using fire. Moreau's friend Monte Carlo (Poelvoorde), a retired Royal Pack hero living with Parkinson's disease, points him toward an old villain, who turns out to have been killed and drained of blood to make the drug. Moreau also notices Lily (Souchaud), a schoolgirl whose electrical powers are just emerging.

The trail leads to Naja (Arlaud), the leader of a gang that kidnaps people with powers and turns their blood into narcotics. After the gang frees one of its dealers from a police station, it abducts Lily and her mother. Callista (Bekhti), a former Royal Pack heroine with precognitive visions who now runs a rehab program, reluctantly joins the investigation after two of her young patients die of overdoses. Moreau, who has hidden his own telekinetic powers for years, is captured and shot but survives. His friends then reveal his secret: while using his powers on a mission, he accidentally caused the explosion that killed Gigaman, Lily's father, and the guilt led him to give them up. Tracing Naja to a disgraced psychiatrist who once erased his childhood mind-control powers, the team storms his hideout. Moreau defeats the overdosing Naja and rescues Lily, and he emerges as a new hero, nicknamed Titan.

First announced at Comic Con Paris in 2015, the film closed the 2020 Deauville American Film Festival. It was subsequently sold to Netflix, which released it worldwide on 9 July 2021. title: Pieces of a Woman
overview: When a young mother's home birth ends in unfathomable tragedy, she begins a year-long odyssey of mourning that fractures relationships with loved ones in this deeply personal story of a woman learning to live alongside her loss.
plot:
Pieces of a Woman is a 2020 drama directed by Kornél Mundruczó from a screenplay by Kata Wéber, partly based on their stage play. Vanessa Kirby stars as Martha, a woman who loses her baby during a home birth, with Shia LaBeouf as her partner Sean, Ellen Burstyn as her mother Elizabeth, Molly Parker as the midwife Eva, Sarah Snook, Iliza Shlesinger, Benny Safdie and Jimmie Fails. Martin Scorsese and Sam Levinson served as executive producers, and Howard Shore composed the score. It premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2020, where Kirby won the Volpi Cup for Best Actress, and was released by Netflix in January 2021.

Martha and Sean, a Boston couple, are expecting their first child. Sean, a construction worker helping to build a bridge across a river, resents Martha's mother, Elizabeth, a wealthy and domineering Holocaust survivor who has bought them a minivan. When Martha goes into labor at home, their regular midwife is unavailable and sends a colleague, Eva. The birth, filmed in a single continuous take of about twenty minutes, is long and painful. When the baby's heart rate drops, Eva tells Sean to call an ambulance. Martha gives birth to a girl who at first seems healthy, but the baby soon turns blue and dies despite Eva's attempts to revive her.

In the following months, the couple's grief drives them apart. At the coroner's office, Sean is desperate to know what went wrong, while Martha is reluctant to learn the details. They are told the cause of death has not been determined but that the baby suffered from a lack of oxygen, and Eva is charged with criminal negligence. Martha withdraws into silence, returns to work and refuses to talk about her loss, while Sean, a recovering alcoholic, relapses and begins an affair with Martha's cousin Suzanne, the lawyer handling the case. Elizabeth pressures her daughter to testify against Eva to secure justice. As the months pass and the bridge Sean is building nears completion, Martha must decide how to face the trial, her mother's expectations and her own grief.

Pieces of a Woman received generally positive reviews, with particular acclaim for Kirby's performance and the virtuoso birth sequence, although some critics found the rest of the film less compelling. Kirby was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress.

title: Seance
overview: At an elite boarding school for girls, six friends jokingly engage in a late night ritual, calling forth the spirit of a dead former student who reportedly haunts their halls. Before morning, one of the girls is dead, leaving the others wondering what they may have awakened.
plot:
Seance is a 2021 supernatural horror slasher film written and directed by Simon Barrett, known as the screenwriter of You're Next and The Guest, in his feature directorial debut. It stars Suki Waterhouse as Camille Meadows, with Madisen Beaty, Inanna Sarkis, Ella-Rae Smith, Stephanie Sy, Djouliet Amara, Jade Michael, Seamus Patterson and Marina Stephenson Kerr. Set in an exclusive boarding school, the film blends ghost story and murder mystery.

One night at the Edelvine Academy for Girls, a clique led by the cruel and popular Alice plays a prank on their classmate Kerrie by staging an appearance of the Edelvine Ghost, the legend of a student who once took her own life at the school. Shaken, Kerrie returns to her room, where she glimpses a figure watching her; moments later the girls hear her scream and find that she has fallen to her death from her window.

Soon afterward, a new student, Camille Meadows, arrives to take Kerrie's place and is assigned her old room, where strange things begin to happen. After a fight with Alice and her friends, Bethany, Yvonne, Rosalind and Lenora, Camille and her roommate Helina are given detention with the group in the library, where Alice persuades them to hold a séance to contact Kerrie. To everyone's surprise, a spirit answers and warns them that they will be murdered. That same night Lenora vanishes, and the school assumes she has run away, but a blood-drawn symbol in her room suggests otherwise. As more girls die in apparent accidents, Camille, Helina and the remaining members of the clique must determine whether they are being hunted by a vengeful ghost or by a very human killer, while Camille hides secrets of her own.

Barrett plays with the conventions of the boarding-school ghost story before turning the film into a slasher mystery with an unexpected climax.

Seance was released by RLJE Films on May 21, 2021. Reviews were mixed: it holds 47 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus said Barrett has filmmaking flair but not enough to lift a somewhat pedestrian story, while IndieWire's Kate Erbland noted that it grows more convoluted as it goes on.

title: Trauma Center
tagline: The enemy is closer than you think
overview: Lt. Wakes is a vengeful police detective determined to solve the murders of his partner and an informant, and joins forces with a witness injured during the shootings. After the killers pursue the witness across the abandoned floor of a hospital, she confirms Wakes's worst fears.
plot:
Trauma Center is a 2019 American action thriller directed by Matt Eskandari from a screenplay by Paul Da Silva. Nicky Whelan stars as Madison Taylor, a young woman hunted through a hospital by two corrupt police officers, with Bruce Willis as the police lieutenant assigned to protect her. The supporting cast includes Tito Ortiz, Texas Battle, Catherine Davis, Tyler Jon Olson, Lala Kent and Steve Guttenberg. The film was produced by Randall Emmett and George Furla's Emmett/Furla Oasis Films, among others, and released by Lionsgate's Grindstone Entertainment Group.

The story is set in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Detective Pierce and Sergeant Tull, two crooked cops, murder an accomplice in a warehouse because his phone holds evidence against them. Madison, who has moved to Puerto Rico and works long hours to support her teenage sister Emily after their mother's death, finishes a shift at the coffee shop where she works and stumbles on the body of Tony Martin, the partner of Lieutenant Steve Wakes, who had been investigating the warehouse killing. Caught in the crossfire, she is wounded, and the bullet that remains lodged in her leg becomes the only piece of evidence that can tie the two killers to the murder.

Madison wakes up in hospital, where Wakes asks her to help his investigation and, for her own safety, has her moved to an isolation ward in an empty wing of the building. Pierce and Tull realize she is the key to tracing the crime back to them and come to finish the job. Trapped overnight in the locked-down ward, Madison desperately calls Wakes for help, but with the lieutenant mostly failing to keep her safe she must use the meagre resources of the under-stocked unit to evade and fight off the two men in a long game of cat and mouse if she is to get out of the hospital alive.

Trauma Center received a limited theatrical release in the United States on December 6, 2019. Reviews were largely negative. Writing in the Los Angeles Times, Noel Murray described it as essentially Die Hard in a hospital and praised Whelan's Willis-worthy performance, but felt that Willis's few scenes were a distraction and that the confined setting was a cost-saving measure rather than a creative opportunity. Blu-ray.com called it short but hopelessly bland, while Film Threat considered it an undemanding piece of fun for fans of the star. On Rotten Tomatoes, only a small minority of critics' reviews are positive.

title: The Stranger by the Shore
tagline: It's nothing special—we're just in love.
overview: Abandoned after coming out, Shun befriends Mio just before he has to move. Years later, Mio returns with a confession. How will Shun feel?
plot:
The Stranger by the Shore (Japanese: Umibe no Étranger) is a 2020 Japanese animated romantic drama directed by Akiyo Ohashi and animated by Studio Hibari, adapted from L'étranger de la Plage, the debut boys' love manga by Kanna Kii, published in English as Seaside Stranger. Fuji TV produced the film as part of its Blue Lynx label for boys' love anime. Kii, a former animator, supervised the production and designed the characters and Mina Kubota composed the music. Taishi Murata voices Shun Hashimoto and Yoshitsugu Matsuoka voices Mio Chibana, reprising their roles from an earlier drama CD, with Yū Shimamura as Sakurako and Kanae Itō and Sayaka Nakaya as the couple Eri and Suzu.

Shun is a gay novelist who has settled on a small island in Okinawa after being cut off by his family in Hokkaido when they learned of his sexuality. There he meets Mio, a high school student who has lost his mother and lives with relatives. When Shun reaches out to him, the boy's prickly reaction stirs painful memories of Shun's estrangement from his parents, yet the two gradually become close. Before anything can develop, Mio reveals that he must move away to the city, promising to keep in touch.

Three years later Mio, now an adult, suddenly returns to the island and declares that he is in love with Shun. Shun is attracted to him but holds back, wracked with guilt at the idea of depriving the younger man of a so-called normal life and doubting that Mio understands what being gay will mean. Complications arrive with Sakurako, Shun's childhood friend and former fiancée, whose arranged wedding ended when Shun came out to his parents during the ceremony and who still loves him. She comes to the island to persuade him to return to Hokkaido because his father is in poor health. Shun is determined to stay with Mio, but Mio urges him to go home and make peace with his family. Realizing that Mio's feelings are sincere and his advice is right, Shun decides to return to Hokkaido and asks Mio to go with him.

The film opened in Japanese cinemas on 11 September 2020, and Funimation began streaming it in North America and other territories in July 2021. Reviews were mixed to positive. Anime News Network gave it a B-minus, feeling that it needed more time to develop its characters, especially Mio, but offered tantalizing glimpses of a satisfying love story, while The Japan Times rated it 2.5 out of 5, arguing that the adaptation lost some of the strength of the excellent manga.

title: Supernova
overview: Sam and Tusker, partners of 20 years, are traveling across England in their old RV visiting friends, family and places from their past. Since Tusker was diagnosed with early-onset dementia two years ago, their time together is the most important thing they have.  As the trip progresses, however, their ideas for the future clash, secrets come out, and their love for each other is tested as never before. Ultimately, they must confront the question of what it means to love one another in the face of Tusker’s illness.
plot:
Supernova is a 2020 British romantic drama written and directed by Harry Macqueen. It stars Colin Firth as Sam and Stanley Tucci as Tusker, a couple who have been together for two decades, with Pippa Haywood, Peter MacQueen and James Dreyfus in supporting roles. The film is an intimate two-hander about love, memory and the approach of loss.

Sam, a concert pianist, and Tusker, a writer, are long-term partners and amateur astronomers who set off in their old campervan across England toward the Lake District. The trip is meant to revisit places that have mattered to them, to reconnect with friends and family, and to bring Sam to what he says will be his final concert. The journey carries a heavy undercurrent, however: Tusker has been diagnosed with early-onset dementia, and his condition is steadily worsening. He is struggling to finish a new book and refuses to let Sam read it.

Along the way the couple bicker and tease each other with the ease of people who have shared a life, but the strain of the illness keeps breaking through. When Tusker wanders off with their dog and becomes disoriented, Sam is badly shaken, though he tries to hide his fear. They camp beside a lake they first visited at the beginning of their relationship and then stay with Sam's sister Lilly, who gently urges him to consider professional care. During the visit, a surprise gathering of friends brings both joy and sorrow, and Sam stumbles upon a discovery that reveals how Tusker has been privately planning to face the future on his own terms. The two men are forced into a painful confrontation about choice, dignity and what it means to care for someone you love.

Macqueen keeps the drama understated, relying on long conversations, landscapes and the quiet chemistry between the two leads rather than on melodrama.

The film premiered in competition at the San Sebastián International Film Festival in September 2020 and was released in the United States by Bleecker Street in January 2021 and in the United Kingdom by StudioCanal in June 2021. It was well received, with about 90 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 73, and the performances of Firth and Tucci were especially praised.

title: The Card Counter
tagline: He's Playing the Hand He Was Dealt.
overview: William Tell just wants to play cards. His spartan existence on the casino trail is shattered when he is approached by Cirk, a vulnerable and angry young man seeking help to execute his plan for revenge on a military colonel. Tell sees a chance at redemption through his relationship with Cirk. But keeping Cirk on the straight-and-narrow proves impossible, dragging Tell back into the darkness of his past.
plot:
William Tell is a gambler who taught himself how to count cards during an eight-year stint in military prison. Seeking to avoid attention—either from fame or from casino bouncers—Tell's gambling philosophy is to bet small and win modestly. Despite gambling nearly every day, he avoids scrutiny by never staying in a casino hotel. He lives out of two small suitcases and exclusively stays in motels, where he removes any decor and covers the furniture in plain sheets secured with twine. At a casino, Tell encounters La Linda, an acquaintance from the gambling world. She runs a stable, a group of gamblers who are backed by investors for a portion of their winnings. She offers to stake Tell but he refuses, unwilling to be burdened by the responsibility.
In Atlantic City, a security-industry convention is being held in the same building as the casino. Tell slips into a seminar held by retired Major John Gordo, but decides to leave almost immediately. On the way out, he is recognized and confronted by a young man, Cirk Baufort, who slips him his name and number. After a nightmare about torture in a prison camp, Tell calls Cirk and agrees to meet.
Cirk knows Tell's true identity: PFC William Tillich, a soldier who was tried and convicted for his role in the prisoner abuse at Abu Ghraib. Cirk explains that his father, Roger, was also at Abu Ghraib; like Tell, he was dishonorably discharged and served time, but the experience led him to drug addiction and made him violently abusive. Cirk's mother left the family, and Roger eventually killed himself. Gordo trained Tillich and the elder Baufort in "enhanced interrogation techniques" but as he was involved as a "civilian consultant" avoided charges or culpability. Blaming Gordo for what happened to his family, Cirk is planning to capture, torture and kill him for revenge and seeks Tell's help. Tell refuses but offers to take Cirk along as he gambles in an attempt to help the young man avoid a violent life.
At their next stop, Tell informs La Linda that he is interested in making an arrangement. He expresses a desire to go on the World Series of Poker (WSOP) tour in order to win enough money to help Cirk cover his debts and start a new life, after which Tell will retire. After early WSOP matches, Tell makes money but loses to Mr. USA, an obnoxious Ukrainian player who has taken on a jingoistic American persona. He bonds with Cirk and feels a growing attraction to La Linda but avoids getting too close as he continues making money gambling.
At a qualifying round in Panama City, Cirk discloses that he still plans to kill Gordo. Tell takes Cirk back to his motel, confronting the younger man with a harsh interrogator persona. He presents Cirk with $150,000 from his gambling winnings, enough for Cirk to pay off his and his mother's debts and return to college. He insists Cirk return to his mother and forget about Gordo, threatening violence if he does not comply; Cirk leaves with the money.

Willy's Wonderland is a 2021 American horror comedy film directed by Zach Cregger and written by Cregger and Matthew Berkowitz. The movie stars Nicholas Hoult, Jay Baruchel, and Ryan Hansen.

The story begins with Arkin (Nicholas Hoult), a former convict who has just been released from prison after serving five years for a crime he didn't commit. He is hired to work at Willy's Wonderland, a struggling family-friendly restaurant in the middle of nowhere. The owner, Phil (Jay Baruchel), is desperate to save his business and offers Arkin a job with a promise that he will be able to spend time with his estranged father.

Upon arrival, Arkin discovers that the restaurant has been taken over by a group of violent and sadistic animatronic animals, including a giant bear, a rabbit, and a snake. The animatronics were created by Willy (Ryan Hansen), the former owner's son, who was obsessed with revenge against his father for abandoning him.

As Arkin tries to navigate his new job and reconnect with his father, he soon realizes that the animatronics are not just malfunctioning machines, but are actually alive and determined to kill anyone who enters the restaurant. The animatronics begin to hunt down and murder the employees, including Phil's daughter, making it clear that Willy has a personal vendetta against them.

Arkin teams up with a janitor named Delilah (Krysta Rodriguez) to survive the night and uncover the truth behind the animatronics' creation. Along the way, they discover that Willy was driven mad by his father's abandonment and created the animatronics as a twisted form of revenge.

As the night wears on, Arkin and Delilah face off against the animatronics in a series of gruesome and hilarious battles. The movie builds up to a climactic showdown between Arkin and Willy, who is revealed to be the mastermind behind the animatronic killings.

In the end, Arkin emerges victorious, but not without scars. He manages to defeat Willy and destroy the animatronics, saving the restaurant and its employees. The movie ends with Arkin reflecting on his experience and realizing that he has found a new sense of purpose in life.

Overall, Willy's Wonderland is a fun and entertaining horror-comedy that pays homage to classic '80s movies like Friday the 13th and Child's Play. With its over-the-top violence, witty humor, and memorable characters, it's sure to delight fans of the genre.

The Princess Switch: Switched Again is a 2020 American Christmas romantic comedy film directed by Mike Rohl and produced by Brad Krevoy, the second installment in The Princess Switch trilogy. Vanessa Hudgens plays three look-alike roles: Stacy, now Princess of Belgravia; Margaret Delacourt, who is about to become Queen of Montenaro; and Margaret's scheming cousin, Lady Fiona Pembroke. Sam Palladio plays Stacy's husband, Prince Edward, Nick Sagar plays Stacy's best friend Kevin, Suanne Braun plays Margaret's assistant Mrs. Donatelli, Mia Lloyd plays Kevin's daughter Olivia and Lachlan Nieboer plays Count Antonio Rossi.

Two years after the events of the first film, Margaret unexpectedly inherits the throne of Montenaro after the king's death and his son's abdication. Overwhelmed by her new responsibilities, she has ended her relationship with Kevin, who now runs his Chicago bakery with his daughter Olivia. Stopping in Chicago on her way to the Christmas coronation, Stacy finds Kevin miserable and persuades him to come to Montenaro, even as her own marriage to Edward is strained by her devotion to royal duty. Kevin and Margaret reunite while decorating the palace for Christmas, but she remains preoccupied with royal affairs, and her charming chief of staff, Count Antonio, courts her and plants doubts in Kevin's mind about whether a commoner could ever be worthy of a queen. Meanwhile Margaret's cousin Fiona, an immature and greedy aristocrat who has squandered her family's fortune, hatches a plan to impersonate Margaret, be crowned queen and loot the royal treasury, with the help of her servants Reggie and Mindy. To give Margaret and Kevin time together, Stacy and Margaret switch places once more, and while the couple spend an afternoon at a Christmas park, Fiona's accomplices kidnap Stacy, believing her to be Margaret, and Fiona takes her place at the palace. With three identical women now in play, Margaret and Edward race to rescue Stacy and unmask the impostor before the coronation, while Antonio pursues schemes of his own.

The film was released on Netflix on November 19, 2020, and received mixed reviews, holding a 56% rating on Rotten Tomatoes; Variety's Dennis Harvey wrote that what it was really selling was Yuletide. The trilogy concluded with The Princess Switch 3: Romancing the Star.

overview: Two Brooklyn siblings' summer in a rural Oahu town takes an exciting turn when a journal pointing to long-lost treasure sets them on an adventure, leading them to reconnect with their Hawaiian heritage.
plot:
Finding ʻOhana is a 2021 American family adventure film directed by Jude Weng in her feature debut and written by Christina Strain. It stars Kea Peahu as Pili, a young geocaching enthusiast, and Alex Aiono as her older brother Ioane, with Lindsay Watson, Owen Vaccaro, Kelly Hu as their mother Leilani, Branscombe Richmond and Ke Huy Quan, whose appearance marked his return to acting. Described during development as an adventure in the spirit of The Goonies, it was produced by Ian Bryce after Netflix acquired the project in 2019.

Pili and her brother Ioane, known as E, are Hawaiian siblings raised in Brooklyn. Pili, an avid geocacher, wins a place at a summer camp, but instead the family travels to the island of Oʻahu with their mother to help her father, Kimo, who is struggling with health and financial problems. Bored and homesick, Pili discovers an old diary in her grandfather's studio, kept by the quartermaster of a ship whose crew mutinied and hid a treasure on the island centuries earlier.

Together with Casper, a nerdy local boy, Pili decides to follow the clues in the journal to find the treasure, which could save her grandfather's home. E, who has been dismissive of his Hawaiian heritage, joins the search along with Hana, a local girl he likes. The four venture into a network of caves, facing collapsing tunnels, flooded passages and dangerous traps. When they finally reach the treasure, Hana realizes that it is a sacred offering protected by the Night Marchers, the ghosts of ancient warriors, and the siblings' quest becomes a journey of reconnection with their family, culture and the meaning of ʻohana. An encounter with the spirits brings the family a final moment with the children's late father, and they decide to make Hawaiʻi their home.

The film celebrates Hawaiian culture, family and heritage, combining adventure with themes of identity and belonging.

Finding ʻOhana premiered on Netflix on January 29, 2021. It received generally favorable reviews, with 81 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 69.

title: The Legend of Tomiris
tagline: The queen born to magnify the steppe.
overview: This is the story of the life of the great queen of the steppe - legendary Tomiris. She is destined to become a skillful warrior, survive the loss of close people and unite the Scythian/Saka tribes under her authority.
plot:
The film is based on the story of Herodotus about the death of the Persian king Cyrus the Great during the war with the Massagetae, which was commanded by the queen Tomyris.
The story begins with a short biography of Tomyris's father, king Spargap, who is involved in the war between the clans of the Saka-Massagetae. His daughter, Tomyris, is born, but her mother, Bopay, dies in childbirth. Spargap raises his daughter and teaches her how to use a sword and ride a horse, as well as other nomadic skills. Tomyris also learns the hardships of camp life.
Sometime later, Kavaz and Kurtun agree to a compact with the neighboring Khwarazmians, whom Spargap has been raiding. After he ridicules them for their attempts, they assassinate him and kill the royal household, with only Tomyris surviving the massacre. She takes refuge in the forest and vows to avenge the death of her father. After several years she succeeds with her revenge, returns to her homeland where she is proclaimed a queen, and marries the son of a neighboring tribal chief, who is her ally.
Years later, Persian king Cyrus the Great tricks Tomyris's husband and one of her sons into his capital city, inviting them to discuss political issues that arose between his Achaemenid Empire and the Massagetae. Cyrus wanted to subdue the Massagetae and turn them into his vassals. Tomyris's husband and son are killed in Cyrus's palace by the latter's order. Tomyris learns this through her adopted son, who secretly followed the Massagetae to the Persian capital.
Persians offer the Massagetae a treaty of peace via the marriage of Cyrus to Tomyris. Tomyris turns down the offer, and warns Cyrus against any intrusion, but Cyrus marches towards Jaxartes at the head of his army. In the ensuing war the Massagetae defeat the Persians, inflicting heavy losses, with Cyrus also killed in the final battle.
