title: The Voyeurs
tagline: How far will you go for one more look?
overview: When Pippa and Thomas move into their dream apartment, they notice that their windows look directly into the apartment opposite – inviting them to witness the volatile relationship of the attractive couple across the street. But what starts as a simple curiosity turns into full-blown obsession with increasingly dangerous consequences.
plot:
The Voyeurs is a 2021 American erotic thriller film written and directed by Michael Mohan. Shot and set in Montreal, it stars Sydney Sweeney and Justice Smith as a young couple who become obsessed with the lives of the neighbors they can see across the street, played by Ben Hardy and Natasha Liu Bordizzo. It was produced by Greg Gilreath and Adam Hendricks through their Divide/Conquer banner and was released by Amazon Studios on Prime Video in September 2021.

Pippa and Thomas move into their first apartment together and discover that their windows look straight into the loft opposite, where a photographer works and lives with a woman. Half joking, they nickname the pair Brent and Margot. Pippa, a trainee optometrist who feels neglected by Thomas, buys binoculars and starts watching the neighbors closely, seeing "Brent" bring models home while "Margot" is away. Thomas knows a trick for eavesdropping with a laser and a reflective surface, so the couple slip into the neighbors' Halloween party and Pippa leaves a mirror behind. They overhear a fight in which the woman accuses the man of cheating and he turns violent. Soon afterwards the woman, whose real name is Julia, turns up at Pippa's optical shop, and the two become friendly; Pippa learns that the husband is a well-known photographer named Seb. Unable to stop herself, Pippa uses Julia's wireless printer to expose his affairs, which leads Thomas to accuse her of being far too invested in strangers' lives. When the couple later appear to witness a death in the apartment across the way, guilt drives Pippa and Thomas apart, yet Pippa keeps watching Seb and eventually lets herself be drawn into his world, only to find that the game of watching and being watched is far more calculated than she had assumed.

The film received mixed reviews. Critics frequently compared it, mostly unfavorably, to earlier voyeuristic thrillers such as Rear Window and Body Double; it holds a 45% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 54 out of 100, indicating "mixed or average reviews". Its viewership on the streaming service nevertheless exceeded Amazon Studios' expectations.

title: The Protégé
overview: Rescued as a child by the legendary assassin Moody and trained in the family business, Anna is the world’s most skilled contract killer. plot:
The Protégé is a 2021 action-thriller film directed by Martin Campbell and written by Michael Finch, Miles Chapman, and Daniel Casey. The movie stars Michael Fassbender, Maggie Q, Abbie Cornish, and Jeremy Irons.

The story follows a legendary assassin named John (Michael Fassbender), who is known for his exceptional skills in the art of killing. He has been working alone for years, taking on high-paying jobs from wealthy clients. However, when he discovers that one of his targets is actually a young woman named Kukulkan (Abbie Cornish) who is being hunted by a ruthless crime lord named Boss (Jeremy Irons), John decides to take her under his wing and teach her the ways of the assassin.

As they embark on their mission together, John and Kukulkan form an unlikely bond, with John becoming a mentor to Kukulkan. However, as they delve deeper into the world of espionage, they realize that Boss is not just any ordinary crime lord, but a highly skilled and ruthless adversary who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Boss has a personal vendetta against John, who had previously thwarted one of his plans. The stakes are raised when Kukulkan's past comes back to haunt her, and she is forced to confront her own demons in order to survive.

Throughout the film, the action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, with Fassbender delivering a performance that showcases his impressive physicality and acting range. Maggie Q also shines as the tough-as-nails Sarah, who becomes embroiled in John's world and finds herself drawn into the conflict between him and Boss.

The film's climax features an epic showdown between John and Boss, with Kukulkan playing a crucial role in the outcome. In the end, John emerges victorious, but not without scars, both physical and emotional. As he looks out over the city, it is clear that his work as an assassin is far from over.

Overall, The Protégé is a gripping action-thriller that explores themes of mentorship, loyalty, and redemption. With its talented cast, slick action sequences, and intricate plot, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

title: The Unforgivable
tagline: No one walks free of their past
overview: A woman is released from prison after serving a sentence for a violent crime and re-enters a society that refuses to forgive her past.
plot:
The Unforgivable is a 2021 American crime drama film directed by Nora Fingscheidt and written by Sarah Burgess. The movie stars Sandra Bullock, Jon Bernthal, and Viola Davis.

The story revolves around Ruth Slater (Sandra Bullock), a woman who has just been released from prison after serving 18 years for the murder of her husband's mistress. Ruth is determined to rebuild her life and reconnect with her estranged daughter, Faith (Julia Long). However, she faces numerous challenges as she tries to reintegrate into society.

Ruth lands a job at a local nursing home, where she meets a new colleague, Nona (Viola Davis), who becomes a source of support and guidance. As Ruth navigates her new life, she also encounters a series of obstacles, including a hostile landlord, a difficult boss, and a complicated relationship with Faith.

Throughout the film, Ruth's character is revealed through a series of flashbacks that show her past mistakes and the events leading up to her imprisonment. The film also explores themes of redemption, forgiveness, and personal growth as Ruth tries to make amends for her past wrongdoings.

As the story unfolds, Ruth faces a series of challenges that test her resolve and force her to confront her demons. Along the way, she meets a new love interest, John (Jon Bernthal), who becomes a source of comfort and support.

The film's title, The Unforgivable, refers to Ruth's past crime, which is considered unforgivable by many people. However, as the story progresses, it becomes clear that forgiveness is not always easy or straightforward. Ultimately, the film suggests that true forgiveness requires effort, understanding, and a willingness to confront one's own flaws and mistakes.

The Unforgivable received widespread critical acclaim for its performances, particularly from Sandra Bullock and Viola Davis. The film was praised for its nuanced exploration of complex themes and its thoughtful portrayal of a flawed but ultimately redeemable protagonist.

title: The Ice Road
tagline: This mission is on thin ice.
overview: After a remote diamond mine collapses in far northern Canada, an ice road driver must lead an impossible rescue mission over a frozen ocean to save the trapped miners.
plot:
The Ice Road is a 2021 American action thriller written and directed by Jonathan Hensleigh. Liam Neeson stars alongside Laurence Fishburne, Benjamin Walker, Amber Midthunder, Marcus Thomas, Holt McCallany, Martin Sensmeier, Matt McCoy and Matt Salinger. Influenced by Henri-Georges Clouzot's 1953 film The Wages of Fear, it follows a team of truck drivers hauling vital equipment across frozen lakes to save workers trapped in a collapsed mine.

When an explosion at a diamond mine in northern Manitoba traps 26 miners, the clock starts ticking on any rescue. In North Dakota, trucker Mike McCann and his younger brother Gurty, an Iraq War veteran living with PTSD and aphasia, lose their jobs after Mike punches a co-worker for mocking Gurty. They travel to Winnipeg and join a rescue convoy led by veteran driver Jim Goldenrod, who has been hired to deliver heavy wellheads needed to reach the miners. The team also includes Tantoo, a young Indigenous driver whose brother is among the trapped men, and Varnay, an insurance actuary representing the mining company, Katka.

The journey across the thawing ice road proves deadly. Goldenrod's truck breaks down and he is lost when the ice gives way, and the survivors soon discover that the accident was no misfortune: Varnay has been sabotaging the convoy on behalf of Katka's general manager, who wants to avoid the company being held responsible for the disaster. After Varnay leaves Mike and Gurty for dead and abducts Tantoo, the brothers fight their way back through avalanches, cracking ice and armed contractors. Mike eventually kills Varnay, but Gurty dies saving the last truck on a collapsing bridge. Mike and Tantoo reach the mine in time to free the miners, and the corrupt manager is fired and arrested.

The film was shot in and around Winnipeg, including Gimli and Île-des-Chênes, in February 2020. Netflix acquired the US rights for $18 million and released it on June 25, 2021, when it became the most-streamed film on the service in its debut weekend; Amazon Prime Video released it in the United Kingdom. Reviews were mixed, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting a 44% approval rating from 89 critics and a consensus describing it as a predictable downhill trundle despite Neeson's continued appeal as an action hero. A sequel, Ice Road: Vengeance, was released in June 2025.

title: Don't Look Up
overview: Two American astronomers attempt to warn humankind about an approaching comet that will wipe out life on planet Earth.
plot:
Don't Look Up is a 2021 American satirical science fiction film directed by Adam McKay from a screenplay by McKay and David Sirota, based on the 2018 novel of the same name by Diamond Ken Smith. The movie stars Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence as two astronomers trying to warn the world about an impending comet impact.

The story begins with Dr. Randall Mindy (DiCaprio), a low-level astronomer at South Boston University, who discovers that a massive comet is on a collision course with Earth. He shares his findings with his colleague, Dr. Kate Dibiasky (Lawrence), and together they try to alert the government and the media about the impending disaster.

However, their warnings fall on deaf ears as politicians and media outlets are more interested in sensationalizing the story for ratings and clicks than taking it seriously. The comet's impact is predicted to be catastrophic, causing widespread destruction and potentially wiping out humanity.

As the comet draws closer, Mindy and Dibiasky try to find a way to get their message heard by the world. They enlist the help of a washed-up talk show host, Brie Evantee (Meryl Streep), who agrees to broadcast their warnings to her audience. However, even this plan is hijacked by the media's desire for ratings, and Dibiasky becomes a reluctant celebrity.

Meanwhile, Mindy's relationship with his girlfriend, Dr. Rachel Drayton (Cate Blanchett), begins to fray as she tries to balance her own career ambitions with her growing concern about the comet. The couple eventually breaks up, leaving Mindy feeling isolated and disconnected from the world around him.

As the comet hurtles towards Earth, Mindy and Dibiasky's warnings become increasingly desperate and urgent. They try to find a way to deflect or destroy the comet, but their efforts are met with bureaucratic red tape and corporate interests that prioritize profits over people.

The film builds towards a climactic finale as the comet makes its final approach. In a last-ditch effort, Mindy and Dibiasky team up with a group of eccentric billionaires, including Captain Dick Todd (Rob Morgan), to launch a private rocket into space in an attempt to deflect the comet.

In the end, the plan succeeds, but not without significant collateral damage and loss of life. The film ends on a bleak note, with Mindy and Dibiasky reflecting on the futility of their efforts and the world's continued apathy towards the dangers of climate change and existential threats.

Throughout the film, McKay uses satire to critique the media's role in shaping public opinion, the failures of government bureaucracy, and the complacency of wealthy elites. The movie is a scathing commentary on our society's inability to confront the harsh realities of climate change and its devastating consequences.

title: Scream
overview: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a new killer has donned the Ghostface mask and begins targeting a group of teenagers to resurrect secrets from the town’s deadly past.
plot:
Scream is a 2022 American slasher film written by James Vanderbilt and Guy Busick, with Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett directing. The fifth instalment of the Scream series and a sequel to Scream 4 (2011), it is the first not directed by Wes Craven, who died in 2015 and to whom it is dedicated. Melissa Barrera and Jenna Ortega play the sisters Sam and Tara Carpenter, alongside Jack Quaid, Mikey Madison and Dylan Minnette, with Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and David Arquette returning as Sidney Prescott, Gale Weathers and Dewey Riley.

Twenty-five years after the original Woodsboro murders, teenager Tara Carpenter is attacked by a new Ghostface and hospitalised. Her estranged older sister Sam returns from Modesto with her boyfriend Richie and meets Tara's friends Wes, Liv, Amber and the twins Chad and Mindy Meeks-Martin. After Vince, the nephew of original killer Stu Macher, is murdered, Sam confides to Tara that she has been haunted by visions of Billy Loomis, who she learned as a teenager was her biological father, a discovery that broke up their parents' marriage and drove her away from home. Sam and Richie turn to Dewey, now divorced from Gale, who warns Gale and Sidney. Mindy reasons that the killer is staging a "requel", targeting a new generation while using Sam's link to Billy to draw in the survivors of the past.

Ghostface murders Wes and his mother, Sheriff Judy Hicks, and attacks Tara and Richie at the hospital; the sisters escape, but Dewey is killed trying to finish off the masked killer. Sidney and Gale arrive and follow Sam to a party at Amber's house, Stu's old home and the scene of the first massacre. There Amber shoots Liv and is unmasked as Ghostface, and Richie, revealed as her accomplice, stabs Sam. The pair, fans of the Stab movies who met online, explain that they were disgusted by the latest instalment and set out to inspire a new one based on real killings, with Sam as their scapegoat. In the fight that follows, Gale shoots Amber, who falls onto a lit stove, and Sam, guided by a vision of Billy, kills Richie. When the burned Amber attacks again, Tara shoots her dead. Gale opts to write a tribute to Dewey instead of a book about the killers.

Released by Paramount Pictures on January 14, 2022, the film grossed $138 million worldwide on a $24 million budget. Reviews were generally positive (76% on Rotten Tomatoes), praising its direction, cast and tribute to Craven. A sequel, Scream VI, followed in 2023.

title: Plane
tagline: The crash was only the beginning.
overview: After a heroic job of successfully landing his storm-damaged aircraft in a war zone, a fearless pilot finds himself between the agendas of multiple militias planning to take the plane and its passengers hostage.
plot:
Plane is a 2023 American action thriller written by Charles Cumming and J. P. Davis and directed by Jean-François Richet. Gerard Butler stars as a commercial pilot who must team up with a suspected murderer after an emergency landing in hostile territory, with Mike Colter, Yoson An, Tony Goldwyn and Daniella Pineda in supporting roles.

Brodie Torrance, a Scottish former RAF pilot, captains Trailblazer Airlines Flight 119 from Singapore to Honolulu by way of Tokyo. Among the fourteen passengers is Louis Gaspare, a fugitive wanted for homicide who is being extradited to Canada in the custody of an RCMP officer. Told by a superior not to change course over the South China Sea despite a severe storm, Brodie flies on until lightning knocks out the avionics, and turbulence kills a flight attendant and the officer. Brodie and his co-pilot, Samuel Dele, manage to put the aircraft down on a road on Jolo, a remote island in the southern Philippines controlled by rebels. In New York, the airline's crisis manager, David Scarsdale, learns that local authorities will need a full day to respond and hires a team of private mercenaries to go in.

Brodie heads into the jungle with Louis, a former French Foreign Legionnaire. At a deserted warehouse he reaches the airline and his daughter by phone before killing a rebel who attacks him, and Louis dispatches the others; the pair learn that the militants kidnap foreigners for ransom. By the time they return, the rebel leader Datu Junmar has seized the passengers and crew, executing a couple who tried to run. Brodie and Louis capture two looters, force them to reveal where the base is, and leave a note for rescuers. They break into the camp and get the hostages onto a bus, but when more rebels close in, Brodie stays behind as a diversion and is about to be executed when the mercenaries arrive. Everyone retreats to the plane; while the pilots restart the aircraft, Louis and the mercenaries hold off the attackers. Louis stays behind and disappears into the jungle with a bag of ransom money, and Junmar is killed by the landing gear as the plane takes off. Brodie lands the crippled plane on nearby Siasi and calls his daughter to say he is coming home.

Shot in Puerto Rico after passing from Lionsgate to Solstice Studios and back, Plane was released by Lionsgate on January 13, 2023. It grossed $74.5 million worldwide and received generally favourable reviews, with 78% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 62.

title: Dear Zoe
overview: Tess enlists her biological father - a lovable slacker from the wrong side of the tracks - and the charming juvenile delinquent next door to help her come to grips with the death of her little sister.
plot:
Dear Zoe is an American drama of 2022 directed by Gren Wells from a screenplay by Marc Lhormer and Melissa Martin, adapted from Philip Beard's novel of 2005. Sadie Sink stars as Tess DeNunzio, a grieving teenager in Pittsburgh, with Theo Rossi as her father Nick, Kweku Collins as her neighbour Jimmy Freeze, Jessica Capshaw as her mother Elly, Justin Bartha as her stepfather David and Vivien Lyra Blair as her younger half-sister Em.

Sixteen-year-old Tess lives with her mother, stepfather and Em. Her three-year-old half-sister Zoe was killed by a hit-and-run driver on the day of the September 11 attacks, while Tess was meant to be watching her. Since then she has helped David look after Em while Elly battles depression, and in family therapy she feels shut out of her parents' grief. When she learns that her mother has been carrying on an emotional affair with a much younger grocery clerk, Tess breaks down and moves in with her biological father, a German Shepherd breeder living in poorer Braddock, though she feels guilty about leaving Em behind.

Tess cares for one of Nick's puppies and he drives Em home from school so the sisters can still meet, but a hymn at church brings back 9/11 and sends her fleeing in tears. She is drawn to Jimmy, a neighbour Nick warns her to avoid, and realises that her father sells drugs from his truck. Jimmy starts climbing through her window at night; he talks of his mother's death and his time in a correctional facility, and they fall in love while working summer jobs at the Kennywood amusement park. Weekly calls with Elly help mother and daughter heal. On Tess's seventeenth birthday, Nick and Jimmy are both arrested, revealing that Jimmy deals with her father. That night Tess finally tells Jimmy the truth: she missed the bus, ran indoors to watch the news of the attacks, and came back to see Zoe step off the curb into the path of a car. Jimmy still loves her. Tess returns home, weeps on the spot where Zoe fell and reconciles with her mother, David and Em.

Shot in Pittsburgh with a mostly local crew in late 2019, after the novel had been optioned since 2010, the film was released in select cinemas and on demand on 4 November 2022. It holds 71% on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Wander
overview: After getting hired to probe a suspicious death in the small town of Wander, a mentally unstable private investigator becomes convinced the case is linked to the same 'conspiracy cover up' that caused the death of his daughter.
plot:
Wander is an American thriller of 2020 directed by April Mullen from a script by Tim Doiron, following two conspiracy theorists drawn into a murder investigation in the desert Southwest. Aaron Eckhart stars as Arthur Bretnik, with Tommy Lee Jones as his friend Jimmy Cleats, Katheryn Winnick as the mysterious Elsa Viceroy, Heather Graham as his lawyer Shelly Luscomb, Raymond Cruz as Sheriff Luis Santiago and Brendan Fehr as FBI agent Nick Cassidy.

Bretnik, a mentally fragile former detective turned private investigator, has never recovered from the death of his daughter in a car crash. As a detective he once examined a corpse whose chest seemed to have burst open from within, a body later stolen from the morgue. Now he and Cleats host a conspiracy podcast. A listener, Elena Guzman, hires him to look into her daughter Zoe's death in the small New Mexico town of Wander, which she is convinced was murder disguised by a cover-up. Convinced he is being followed, Bretnik tails two men in an old Jeep, discovers they are moving a woman's body, and finds an underground laboratory where captives are implanted with microchips. With Cleats, he learns that his clients' names were false; the woman who hired him attacks him, then dies when her chip explodes, and the two bury her in the desert. Before raiding the lab to film evidence, Bretnik mails an envelope.

The story jumps ahead to Bretnik being arrested by Cassidy after a shoot-out. Under questioning he recounts how Cleats was shot in the lab, how Elsa, apparently a CIA operative, and Santiago enlisted him to assassinate the chips' inventor, Victor Canton, and how Elsa gunned down the others, including Santiago, before letting Bretnik kill Canton. Shelly then tells him that his medication can cause delusions, that the garage was empty and derelict, and that Cleats's decapitated body was found in his car. Awaiting commitment, Bretnik is visited by Elsa and a living Cleats, who reveal that he was used all along to tie up loose ends and take the blame. In the institution he digs into his chest with a stolen pen and pulls out a microchip, laughing, while his envelope of photographs reaches Shelly.

Shot in Carrizozo and Ruidoso, New Mexico, in 2019, the film was released by Saban Films in December 2020. Critics praised Eckhart but not the twisting story, giving it 32% on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Benny Loves You
overview: Jack, a man desperate to improve his life, throws away his beloved childhood plush, Benny. It’s a move that has disastrous consequences when Benny springs to life with deadly intentions!
plot:
Benny Loves You is a 2019 British horror comedy written, directed, edited and produced by Karl Holt, who also plays the lead role. The cast includes Claire Cartwright, George Collie, James Parsons, David Wayman and Lydia Hourihan. A low-budget entry in the killer-toy subgenre, the film premiered at the Buenos Aires Rojo Sangre festival in November 2019 before playing other genre festivals and reaching wider release.

After a brief prologue in which a discarded teddy bear takes violent revenge on the spoiled girl who replaced it, the story turns to Jack, a toy designer in his mid-thirties who still lives with his parents and relies on them for nearly everything. On his 35th birthday they die in a freak accident, and months later Jack is struggling to cope with the bills, the upkeep of the house and an estate agent pressing him to sell. At work he is overshadowed by Richard, a smug rival who has won the Designer of the Year award, and after a string of failed ideas his boss Ron demotes him to a lower-paid job.

Resolving to finally grow up, Jack decides to sell the house and packs away his childhood toys, reluctantly throwing out Benny, the plush bear he loved as a boy. Benny, however, has other plans. The bear destroys Jack's other toys and begins killing anyone he sees as a threat to his friend, leaving Jack to clean up the gory aftermath and dodge two bumbling police officers. Jack strikes a bargain with Benny to stop the killings, and the toy's presence unexpectedly inspires new designs that impress Ron. At the same time Jack begins a romance with Dawn, a technology consultant at his company. Benny's jealousy and enthusiasm for violence keep escalating, however, and Jack is forced to decide how far he will go to protect the people in his new life from his old best friend.

The film was well received for a micro-budget production. It holds a favorable score on Rotten Tomatoes, whose critics' consensus described it as a zany, enjoyably macabre and clever horror comedy with a lovable villain. Anton Bitel of Sight and Sound highlighted its comic treatment of a hero who has to put childish things behind him.

title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent

overview: Creatively unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, Nick Cage must accept a $1 million offer to attend the birthday of a dangerous superfan. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when Cage is recruited by a CIA operative and forced to live up to his own legend, channeling his most iconic and beloved on-screen characters in order to save himself and his loved ones.
plot:
The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent is a 2022 American action comedy directed by Tom Gormican, who co-wrote it with Kevin Etten. Nicolas Cage stars as a fictionalized version of himself, alongside Pedro Pascal as Javi Gutiérrez, Sharon Horgan, Lily Mo Sheen, Tiffany Haddish, Ike Barinholtz and Neil Patrick Harris.

Nick Cage's career is stalling after he misses out on several major roles, and he is plagued by visions of "Nicky", his younger, more successful self, while years of neglect have strained his bond with his ex-wife, Olivia, and daughter, Addy. After losing a coveted part and embarrassing himself at Addy's birthday party, he announces his retirement and accepts his agent's offer of $1 million to attend the birthday of Javi, a billionaire fan in Mallorca. Though irritated at first by Javi's neediness, Nick warms to him over a shared love of movies such as The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari and Paddington 2. CIA agents Vivian and Martin then tell Nick that Javi, who they say is an arms dealer, has kidnapped María Delgado, the daughter of a Catalan politician, to force her father out of an election. Doubtful but willing, Nick plants cameras in Javi's compound and announces their film partnership as a pretext to stay and search for María. After an LSD-fueled misadventure, they decide their movie should be about their friendship. When Javi brings Nick's family to the villa, they rebuff Nick's apology.

Javi's cousin Lucas is revealed as the real arms dealer and María's kidnapper; he warns Javi that Nick is working with the CIA and demands that he kill him. Neither man can go through with it, and when Lucas's men attack, they discover Addy has been abducted too. At the CIA safe house, Martin is found dead and Vivian dies holding off Lucas's men. Nick and Olivia pose as a criminal couple to approach Lucas and, though he sees through it, escape with Addy and María, racing for the American embassy as Javi stays behind to delay him. When Lucas corners Nick, Addy throws him a knife and he kills Lucas, a moment that becomes a scene in the film Nick and Javi later complete. At its premiere, Nick congratulates Javi and goes home with his family to watch Paddington 2.

The film premiered at South by Southwest on March 12, 2022, and Lionsgate released it on April 22. It grossed $29.1 million against a $30 million budget. Reviews were positive, with 87% on Rotten Tomatoes and 68 on Metacritic, praising Cage and Pascal's chemistry.

title: La Casa
overview: Responding to an urgent call for help, a police officer becomes trapped by the evil spirits of a cursed house.
plot:
La Casa (The House) is a 2020 Chilean horror film directed by Jorge Olguín, the Chilean filmmaker who has devoted more of his career to horror and fantasy than any other in his country, known for films such as Ángel Negro (2000) and Caleuche: el llamado del mar (2012). It was his sixth feature. The film stars Gabriel Cañas as Corporal Arriagada, a carabinero, with Camila Carreño, Carol Campos, Carlos Cortez and Felipe Silva Rodríguez in the cast. It runs about 73 minutes and opened in Chilean cinemas on 30 January 2020.

The film is inspired by the urban legend surrounding the Casona Dubois in the Santiago district of Quinta Normal, now a cultural centre, where most of it was shot. According to the legend, a French engineer and his wife who settled there in the early twentieth century turned to witchcraft to conceive a child; the baby was born deformed, the father killed it and the mother took her own life, and the house has been considered cursed ever since. Title cards at the start inform the audience of this history. The story is set in 1986, during the military dictatorship. In the middle of the night Arriagada receives an urgent call: neighbours report someone inside the old mansion, crying for help. Arriagada, who that same day has committed an atrocity of his own by beating a woman labelled a subversive to death, goes to investigate, calling for reinforcements that will take time to arrive. Once inside he cannot find his way out, and the violent spirits of the family begin to torment him, including a bloodied woman who appears and vanishes, until a final twist ties the haunting to his own guilt and to the repression of the regime. Olguín shot the film quickly as an apparent single real-time take, following Cañas through the dark, labyrinthine house lit largely by his flashlight, with only a handful of actors inside the mansion.

Olguín described the film as "a great lie to tell a great truth." Reception was mixed. Patricia Reyes of La Tercera highlighted its sound design and its blend of the political context with horror, and Edgardo Viereck Salinas of Cine y Literatura considered it the director's best work, a powerful portrait of guilt under Pinochet. Reid Ramsey of Cinematary praised Cañas's physically demanding performance and the practical effects but found the scares repetitive and the concept better suited to a short film.

title: No Sudden Move
overview: A group of criminals are brought together under mysterious circumstances and have to work together to uncover what's really going on when their simple job goes completely sideways.
plot:
In 1954 Detroit, Michigan, gangster Curt Goynes, in need of cash to leave town, is recruited to threaten a family as part of a blackmail scheme, along with gangsters Ronald Russo and Charley. The recruiter, Doug Jones, sends them to the house of GM accountant Matt Wertz, where they are to hold the family hostage while sending Wertz to his office to retrieve a document from his boss's safe. Finding the safe empty, a desperate Wertz brings fake documents to Jones, then returns home, where Charley prepares to execute the entire family, to the surprise of Goynes and Russo. Not wanting to be part of a massacre, Goynes shoots and kills Charley.
Jones phones the house, having discovered the documents are fake, and orders Goynes to kill Russo and the family. Sensing something amiss, Goynes ignores the order and leaves with Russo, instructing the family to tell the police that Charley broke into their home and that Wertz killed Charley in self-defense. The police detective, Joe Finney, is skeptical of the family's story. Once the police leave, Goynes, Russo, and Wertz go to Wertz's boss's home in Ohio and retrieve the real document, which turns out to be plans for a new car part. Goynes and Russo discover they have a high bounty placed on their heads and make plans to ascertain what the document is worth by arranging a meeting with Frank Capelli, the mob leader who contracted the blackmail scheme, and whose wife Vanessa has been having an affair with Russo. Meanwhile, Goynes contacts mob leader Aldrick Watkins, who wants him dead, and arranges to clear himself by giving Watkins part of the eventual payment.
Goynes and Russo meet with Capelli. Goynes deduces that the value of the document vastly exceeds the amount they considered it was worth. Jones arrives and pulls a gun, showing that he and Capelli have been planning to turn on Goynes and Russo. In the resulting shootout, Jones is killed. Capelli flees, only to be caught by Goynes and Russo, who extract the name of his contact: Naismith, a Studebaker executive. Goynes calls Naismith and arranges to sell him the document for $125,000. Capelli escapes, but when he returns home, the battered Vanessa shoots and kills him and then departs with a suitcase with $31,000 in cash. Seeking a bigger payday, Goynes and Russo return to Wertz's boss's home and make him call a more senior contact, arrogant automobile manufacturer's association executive Mike Lowen. Goynes and Russo meet with Lowen at a downtown hotel, where he pays them $375,000 to return the document. It is revealed to be plans for a catalytic converter. Lowen is seeking to conceal its existence from the public to avoid government pressure on the car companies to implement pollution controls.
After Lowen leaves, Goynes and Russo split the money but are interrupted by Watkins and his men, who have already retrieved the $125,000 from Naismith.

title: My Best Friend's Christmas
overview: When Ashley Seever returns home for the holidays hoping to reconnect with her high school sweetheart Grant, she soon meets his new girlfriend. In an attempt to escape the embarrassment, she and her best friend Liam fake their own holiday romance…but when her fake feelings for Liam start to turn real, Ashley will have to choose what her heart really wants this Christmas.
plot:
My Best Friend's Christmas is a 2019 American Christmas romantic comedy television film written and directed by Jake Helgren, who co-wrote the screenplay with Blaine Chiappetta, and produced by his company Ninth House Films. It stars Breanne Hill, Colton Little and Tanner Novlan, with Masiela Lusha, Beth Broderick and Trevor Eve in supporting roles. Acquired by Showtime as one of the network's first original Christmas films, it was released in December 2019 and premiered on the Showtime Women channel on 3 December. It runs about 90 minutes.

Ashley Seever (Hill), a cheerful party planner, travels back to her hometown for the holidays, hoping to rekindle her romance with her high school sweetheart, Grant Hines (Novlan). Her plans fall apart when she discovers that Grant is now dating Bella Vega (Lusha), a famous social media influencer. Embarrassed and unwilling to admit defeat, Ashley persuades her colleague and best friend, Liam Marsh (Little), to pose as her boyfriend for the season, and the pair stage a holiday romance in front of Grant and Bella, while Ashley's parents, Sheila (Broderick) and Winston (Eve), look on. As the pretence continues through the festivities, Ashley and Liam begin to realise that their feelings for each other may be more than an act, and Ashley has to decide whether she still wants the man she came home for or the friend who has been beside her all along.

In an interview with Gas Mask Magazine ahead of the premiere, the Texas-born Helgren described the film as a fun Christmas spin on My Best Friend's Wedding, built around a sweet party planner who returns home to revive an old flame and asks her best friend to play her fake boyfriend to avoid embarrassment. He said the team was excited that Showtime had liked the film enough to make it one of its first original Christmas acquisitions.

The film received little professional critical attention. Audience reviews on IMDb were largely negative, calling the story predictable and criticising the dialogue, the leads' chemistry and a soundtrack that some found loud enough to drown out the dialogue; Colton Little's performance was among the few elements viewers singled out for praise, while one reviewer was surprised to find the veteran British actor Trevor Eve in the cast.
